## Screen: Person editor (dialog `editor`, `editorBody()` panel.ts:3758-4234)

### Purpose
Create or edit a person: identity, phone, active flag, custom profile fields/groups/photo, onboarding template, validity and
timing, PIN, cards (manual, station reader capture, USB reader), door permissions per station and lock.

### Entry point
"Add user" (users tab, v4 overview), row "Edit", `details-edit` from `wiskey-user-details`, `edit-person` from permission
directory. `edit(user?)` (1099-1143) builds the `Draft`:
- New person: `employee_no = String(100000000 + (random uint32 % 900000000))` (random 9-digit, `crypto.getRandomValues`),
  `display_name ""`, `active true`, `pin_configured false`, `confirm_pin ""`, `cards []`, `assignments {}`,
  `identity_locked false`, `valid_from/valid_until null`, `timed false`.
- Existing: `{...structuredClone(user), confirm_pin: "", timed: !!user.valid_from}`.
- If `access_timing_policy` exists, `access_timing_draft = clone(policy.schedule)`; `_timingEnforcement =
  user.access_timing_policy.mode ?? "draft"`.
- `permission_overrides ??=` derived from assignments (`enabled → "allow"`, else `"deny"`).
- `_editorPolicyRevision = profile_settings.revision`; `refreshDraftPermissions()`.
- Validity input zone: first assigned station that still exists, else first lock-enabled station, else "" (HA zone).
- `_editorBaseline = JSON.stringify(draft)` (for "save first" checks).

### Layout & visual notes
Dialog `editor-dialog`, title `edit_user`/`add_user`. Body: `editor-summary` (icon, name or `new_person_heading`,
`editor_intro`), `<form id="user-form">` with `save_hint`, then:
1. **fieldset editor-person** (`person_details`): name (`required autofocus maxlength=32`), employee_id (`required
   pattern="[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}" maxlength=32 dir=ltr`, **disabled when `identity_locked`** + note `employee_locked`), phone
   (`type=tel autocomplete=tel dir=ltr maxlength=32 placeholder="05X-xxx-xxxx"`, value re-formatted on input by
   `mobileDisplay`), active checkbox.
2. **profileEditor()** (2161-2272), only when `profile_settings` exists and has photo/fields/groups enabled: onboarding template
   select + "onboarding_apply" (new person only; applies template `profile` and `group_ids`, clears overrides); one control per
   enabled field — `select` (with legacy value option `profile_legacy_value`) or input (`maxlength=100`, `type=date` for valid
   date fields, `inputmode=decimal` for numbers, `datalist` of options), `required` only for new person; groups checkboxes
   (`profile_groups`); `hikvision-user-photo`; `profile_local_hint`.
3. **editorActions()** (2273-2304), existing person only (`user_more_actions`): "audit_show_user" (sets `_auditUser`, closes,
   goes to `audit` tab) and **delete** (danger). Both require an unmodified draft (`editorAction`, 2134-2146) else
   `profile_save_first`.
4. **fieldset editor-validity** (`validity`): `user_timing_converted` note; mode select `always` (permanent) | `period` |
   `weekly` | `dates` (last two disabled without capability `user_timing_draft`). Choosing weekly/dates creates
   `access_timing_draft = {mode, timezone: default_zone.name ?? "UTC", days: weekly ? ["Monday"] : [], dates: [], periods:
   [{start: "00:00", end: "24:00"}]}` and sets enforcement to `ha` if `user_timing_enforcement` else `draft`. With a timing
   draft: enforcement select (`user_timing_enforcement`: `ha` | `native`, placeholder `user_timing_choose_enforcement` when
   draft) when capability present; `<hikvision-user-timing>`; readback details per station from `timing_readbacks` (mode,
   synced/pending, checked_at, valid range); note `user_timing_current` / `user_timing_outer_validity`. When `timed`:
   "clock_validity_basis" select (UTC `__utc__`, HA zone `""`, or each station with its clock zone); "user_timing_single_day"
   date input (`min 2000-01-01 max 2037-12-30`) that fills from = day 00:00, until = next day 00:00; `valid_from` / `valid_until`
   `datetime-local` inputs (required); `validity_hint`. Else "permanent".
5. **fieldset editor-pin**: legend `pin · configured|not_configured`; `pin_private`; `pin_mode_blocked` when any enabled
   assignment's station has `capabilities.pin_writable === false` (then PIN inputs and buttons disabled); inputs new_pin and
   confirm_pin (`type=password inputmode=numeric autocomplete=new-password pattern=[0-9]* maxlength=128`); live availability
   region (`aria-live=polite`): `pin_checking` / `pin_available` / `pin_conflict` / `pin_check_failed`; buttons
   "generate_unique_pin", "remove_pin" (only if `pin_configured`; sets `draft.pin = null` → status "remove_pin" +
   "keep_pin" undo); `pin_physical` note.
6. **fieldset editor-cards**: per card — label (maxlength 64); card number: read-only masked for saved cards, or required input
   `pattern=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ maxlength=32 dir=ltr` for new; checkbox "active · normal_card"; remove (danger). "+ add_card" adds
   `{label:"", card_no:"", card_type:"normalCard", enabled:true}`. "capture_card" button (existing, unmodified person only) →
   capture dialog; hint `capture_from_editor_hint` / `capture_save_user_first`. `<wiskey-usb-card-input>` adds reviewed cards.
7. **fieldset editor-assignments** (`assignments`): "select_all_stations", "clear_stations" (set allow/deny for all
   lock-enabled stations), "permission_reset_all" (clear overrides), counter `selected_stations: N`; `group_permission_hint`;
   per station: checkbox (disabled if `!lock_enabled`; toggling sets override allow/deny), name, online badge, `station_access`
   / `camera_only` + lock name; permission source label `permission_denied` / `permission_personal` /
   `permission_inherited · <group names>` / `permission_none`; "permission_reset" (inherit) when overridden; per-lock checkboxes
   when enabled and station has >1 locks (unchecking the last lock sets deny); sync badge of the assignment.
Footer: **cancel**, **save** (`type=submit form=user-form value=save`), **save_sync** primary (`value=sync`, label `wait` while
busy); both submits disabled while busy or `_pinStatus === "in_use"`.

Permission model (1158-1195): enabled for a station iff override `allow`, or (no `deny` and at least one enabled group in
`draft.group_ids` whose `station_ids` includes the station). Enabled assignments default `allowed_locks: [1]`.

### Validations (in `save()`, 1317-1417, order)
1. If `timed`: `readValidity()` converts the local inputs in the chosen zone (`fromLocalInput`; keeps previous instant if the
   field is unchanged) — errors `clock_invalid_local | clock_ambiguous | clock_nonexistent`.
2. `pin !== confirm_pin` → `pin_mismatch`.
3. `pin` set and `_pinStatus === "in_use"` → `pin_conflict`.
4. `timed` and missing/`from >= until` → `invalid_validity`.
5. `profileError(profile_settings, draft.profile, previousProfile)` → `profile_required` / `profile_value_invalid` (only fields
   whose value changed are checked for existing persons; `profile-fields.ts`).
6. `approveDuplicateCandidate()` (1271-1316), only if capability `identity_lifecycle` and command `users/duplicate_check`:
   sends last-4 digit suffixes of enabled cards; `blocking` → error `lifecycle_employee_conflict`; `total > 0` → native
   `confirm(lifecycle_duplicate_confirm with {count})`.
7. Browser-native `required`/`pattern` constraints on inputs apply because submit goes through a `<form>`.

### Save payload (1355-1415)
```ts
data = {
  employee_no, phone: draft.phone ?? "",
  // only if capability "user_timing_draft":
  access_timing_draft: draft.access_timing_draft ?? null,
  // only if capability "user_timing_enforcement":
  access_timing_policy: draft.access_timing_draft && enforcement !== "draft"
     ? { mode: enforcement /* "ha"|"native" */, schedule: draft.access_timing_draft,
         bindings: previous policy bindings if same mode else {} }
     : null,
  display_name, active,
  valid_from: timed ? valid_from : null, valid_until: timed ? valid_until : null,
  // if profile_settings present:
  permission_overrides: draft.permission_overrides ?? {},
  door_permissions: { [station_id]: allowed_locks[] } /* enabled assignments only */,
  access_policy_revision: _editorPolicyRevision,
  // else:
  assignments: draft.assignments,
  cards: draft.cards.map(c => ({ ...(c.id ? {id: c.id} : {card_no: c.card_no}), label, card_type, enabled })),
  pin?: string | null   /* only when draft.pin !== undefined; null = remove PIN */,
  profile?, group_ids?, photo?  /* only with profile_settings, when defined */
}
```
Sent as `users/update {user_id, revision, data, sync_now}` or `users/create {data, sync_now}`; `sync_now = (submitter value ===
"sync")`. Success notice `saved_sync` / `saved`; dialog closes. Backend `USER_FIELDS` (`websocket.py:45-64`) also accepts
`user_type`; unknown keys → `invalid_fields`.

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type PIN | READ (availability check; no state change) | `hikvision_intercom/users/pin_check` `{user_id: string /* "" for new */, pin: string /* ^\d{1,128}$ */, api_contract: 1}` → `{available: boolean}` | debounced 350 ms; stale results ignored | panel.ts:1210-1244 |
| Generate unique PIN | READ (returns a random currently-free 6-digit PIN; not reserved — "final writes recheck") | `hikvision_intercom/users/pin_generate` `{user_id, api_contract: 1}` → `{pin: string}` | disabled when blocked/removing/checking/busy; fills both PIN fields | panel.ts:1245-1270 |
| Remove PIN / keep PIN | client draft (`pin = null` sent on save) | — | only if configured | panel.ts:4008-4035 |
| Duplicate check (pre-save) | READ | `hikvision_intercom/users/duplicate_check` `{user_id, data: {employee_no, display_name, phone, card_suffixes: string[] /* 4 digits */}, api_contract: 1}` → `{matches: {...,reasons: string[], card_matches}[], total, truncated, blocking, privacy}` | native confirm if matches | panel.ts:1271-1316 |
| Save (create) | **CONFIG-WRITE** (WisKey storage; device writes follow via reconciliation when `sync_now` or periodic) | `hikvision_intercom/users/create` `{data, sync_now: boolean, api_contract: 1}` → public `Person` | validations above | panel.ts:1404-1416 |
| Save (update) | CONFIG-WRITE (storage + device via sync; `sync_now` only requests sync if desired device fields changed) | `hikvision_intercom/users/update` `{user_id, revision, data, sync_now, api_contract: 1}` → `Person` | revision conflict → `revision_conflict` | panel.ts:1404-1416 |
| Timing policy mode `native` / `ha` | CONFIG-WRITE; `native` = schedule written to the station as a native access schedule; `ha` = HA-side enforcement (see Open questions). Not a door-open actuation. | part of users/create/update | capability gated | panel.ts:1361-1375 |
| Delete person | CONFIG-WRITE (storage tombstone + device deletions queued on all target stations incl. offline) | `hikvision_intercom/users/delete` `{user_id, revision, api_contract: 1}` → `{accepted: true}` | native `confirm(confirm_delete with {count} = assigned + revocation stations)`; draft must be unmodified | panel.ts:1418-1431, 2290-2300 |
| Change history for person | READ (navigates to audit tab with focus) | — | draft unmodified | panel.ts:2278-2289 |
| Add/remove/edit card rows | client draft | sent on save | — | panel.ts:4039-4108 |
| USB card reader input | client (child emits `card-reviewed`) | child-owned | — | panel.ts:4121-4138 |
| Capture card from station | opens capture dialog (PHYSICAL — see next screen) | — | existing, unmodified person | panel.ts:4109-4120 |
| Convert timing to validity | client (`timingValidity()`) | — | only an exact contiguous date interval | panel.ts:954-982 |
| Change validity basis zone | client | — | may error `validity_zone_changed_invalid` | panel.ts:996-1031 |

### Notes / quirks
- `refreshValidityZone()` runs on every overview refresh while the editor is open and re-expresses the typed range if the
  station/HA zone rules changed.
- Unsaved-change detection compares `JSON.stringify(draft)` with the baseline and the two validity inputs.
- Profile photo changes are embedded as `data.photo` in the same save.

## Screen: Card capture dialog (dialog `capture`, panel.ts:1432-1630)

### Purpose
Put a selected intercom's card reader into "collect card" mode, read one presented card, then add it (masked) to the person.

### Entry point
Editor "capture_card" (existing person, unmodified draft). `openCapture(user)` picks the first online lock-enabled station and
loads its reader capabilities.

### Layout
Person name + employee number; `capture_hint`; selects: station (online lock-enabled only; disabled once started),
reader (`0` = `capture_default_reader`); error alert `t(error)`; `capture_revision_changed` alert when the person's revision
changed; status line `capture_state_<state>` (states: `choose` (client), `preparing`, `waiting`, `captured`, `error`,
`applying` (server), `unconfirmed` (client)); when captured: masked number + technology, label input (maxlength 64),
`capture_targets: <assigned station names>`; `capture_limits`. Footer: "capture_start" (state choose), "capture_save"
(captured), "capture_again" (error/captured → re-reads capabilities), close.

### Server facts (`access/enrollment.py`)
Session TTL 120 s (`SESSION_SECONDS`), max 3 sessions (`MAX_SESSIONS`), one per station (`capture_station_busy`),
`reader_id` 0..8; collection timeout 70 s; device calls `GET /ISAPI/AccessControl/capabilities`,
`GET /ISAPI/AccessControl/CaptureCardInfo/capabilities?format=json`, then `GET /ISAPI/AccessControl/CaptureCardInfo?format=json[&readerID=n]`
(`client/capture.py:79-123`); card public shape `{masked_number: "•••• 1234", technology, reader_id}`; confirm re-checks
revision and duplicate card, then `async_update` with the new card (`card_type: "normalCard"`) — sync is requested
(default `sync_now=True`). Error codes: `manager_closed, capture_not_found, capture_unsupported, revision_conflict,
invalid_fields, capture_station_busy, capture_limit, capture_reader_invalid, capture_timeout, capture_failed,
capture_applying, capture_not_ready, card_conflict`.

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Read reader capabilities | READ (device GET) | `hikvision_intercom/cards/reader_capabilities` `{station_id, api_contract: 1}` → `{readers: number[], card_min, card_max}` | — | panel.ts:1447-1476 |
| Start capture | **PHYSICAL** (puts the station's card reader into capture mode for up to 70 s / 120 s session) | `hikvision_intercom/cards/capture_start` `{station_id, user_id, revision, reader_id, api_contract: 1}` → `{session_id, station_id, user_id, revision, state, error, card}` | disabled without readers or stale revision; if the dialog was closed meanwhile, immediately sends `capture_cancel` via **raw `hass.callWS`** (no contract envelope) | panel.ts:1484-1517 |
| Poll status | READ | `hikvision_intercom/cards/capture_status` `{session_id}` (+`api_contract:1` if in contract) → same session shape | every **1000 ms** while `preparing`/`waiting` | panel.ts:1518-1544 |
| Save card | CONFIG-WRITE (storage + queued device write of the card) | `hikvision_intercom/cards/capture_confirm` `{session_id, label, api_contract: 1}` → `Person` | native `confirm(capture_confirm_prompt {name})`; failure → state `unconfirmed` | panel.ts:1545-1559 |
| Cancel (close / reselect / detach) | PHYSICAL-cleanup (ends capture mode; backend treats as read-exempt) | `hikvision_intercom/cards/capture_cancel` `{session_id}` → `{cancelled: true}` | automatic in `clearCapture()` | panel.ts:1432-1438 |

## Screen: CSV import dialog (dialog `csv`, panel.ts:1631-1906) and CSV export

### Purpose
Bulk create/update people from a UTF-8 CSV with column mapping, preview (per-row plan, capacity projection, errors) and
token-bound apply.

### Layout
`csv_hint`; file input (`.csv,text/csv`) and mode select (`create` = `csv_create_only`, `upsert` = `csv_update_existing`);
after inspect: file name and `<details open class="csv-mapping">` with one select per CSV header mapping to a target
(`csv_ignore_column` or a target key); "csv_template" downloads `wiskey-users-template.csv` (BOM + header of all targets);
`<details>` `csv_format` explains columns, lists group ids and station ids, examples `{"STATION_ID":true}` and
`["000099990001"]`. Preview: counts (`plan_create`, `plan_update`, `bulk_unchanged`); capacity details per station
(users/cards/pins now → projected / max, warning style); errors (`csv_line N: column: t(code)`) + "csv_download_errors"
(`wiskey-import-errors.json` with `{errors: [{line, column, code}]}`); per row: name, `bulk_<operation>`, line, employee id,
changed field labels, PIN configured, card count, stations, groups, profile values, permission overrides, timing policy mode +
timezone, `csv_revocation` warning when `access_removed`. Footer: "csv_preview" (needs content) and primary "csv_apply"
(needs token, no errors, create+update > 0).

CSV targets (`csvTargets()`, 1723-1739): `employee_no, display_name, phone, active, valid_from, valid_until, stations, pin,
cards, group_ids, permission_overrides, access_timing_policy, profile:<field_id>...`.

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Choose file | READ (server parses headers only) | `hikvision_intercom/users/csv_inspect` `{csv: string, api_contract: 1}` → `{headers: string[], mapping: Record<string,string>}` | client: size ≤ 262 144 bytes (`csv_too_large`), strict UTF-8 (`csv_invalid_encoding`) | panel.ts:1644-1673 |
| Preview | READ (dry run on a repository copy) | `hikvision_intercom/users/csv_preview` `{csv, column_map: Record<string,string>, mode: "create"\|"upsert", api_contract: 1}` → `CsvPreview` | — | panel.ts:1674-1686 |
| Apply | CONFIG-WRITE (storage + device sync of affected stations; may revoke access) | `hikvision_intercom/users/csv_apply` `{csv, column_map, mode, review_token, api_contract: 1}` → (manager result) | native `confirm(csv_confirm {count})`; on error preview cleared | panel.ts:1687-1714 |
| Export CSV | READ | `hikvision_intercom/users/csv_export` → `{csv}`; downloads `hikvision-users.csv` | via `run()` | panel.ts:1715-1722 |

## Screen: Import existing device records (dialog `import`, panel.ts:1907-1942, 4235-4310)

### Purpose
List person records found on a station's inventory and adopt them into WisKey, map them to an existing central person, ignore
them, or delete them from the device.

### Layout
`import_hint`; station select (lock-enabled stations; default first online lock-enabled) + "refresh"; `loading` /
`no_records`; per row `article.import-row`: display name, status `already_managed` (user_id set) or `ignored`, employee id,
PIN configured, masked card list, `import_error` (danger), and for unmanaged rows buttons: primary **adopt** or
**map_existing** (when a central person has the same employee number; disabled with import error or missing token),
**ignore/unignore**, **delete** (danger; same disable rules).

### Data model — `Inventory` (types.ts:192-201).

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load inventory (open / station change / refresh) | READ (device scan: identity, capabilities, full inventory; refreshes cached inventory) | `hikvision_intercom/stations/inventory` `{station_id, api_contract: 1}` → `Inventory[]` (600 s wait) | via `run()` | panel.ts:1915-1922 |
| Adopt | CONFIG-WRITE (storage ownership/binding + sync requested for the person) | `hikvision_intercom/users/adopt` `{station_id, employee_no, review_token, api_contract: 1}` | native `confirm(confirm_adopt)` | panel.ts:1923-1942 |
| Map to existing central person | CONFIG-WRITE (storage + device re-sync to central credentials) | `hikvision_intercom/users/adopt` `{station_id, employee_no, review_token, user_id, revision, api_contract: 1}` | `confirm(confirm_map)` | panel.ts:1923-1942 |
| Delete from device | CONFIG-WRITE (**device**: removes person and cards from the station) | `hikvision_intercom/users/delete_unmanaged` `{station_id, employee_no, review_token, api_contract: 1}` | `confirm(confirm_unmanaged_delete)` | panel.ts:1923-1942 |
| Ignore / unignore | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage only) | `hikvision_intercom/users/ignore` `{station_id, employee_no, ignored: boolean, api_contract: 1}` → `{accepted: true}` | none | panel.ts:4280-4297 |

Backend: `async_adopt` verifies `review_token` equals a fresh device fingerprint (`review_stale`), rejects unsupported records
(`device_user_missing, schedule_unverified, unmanaged_lock, unsupported_credentials, pin_device_managed,
local_validity_needs_conversion`) (`access/manager.py:909-983`).

## Screen: Devices / stations (tab `devices`, `devicesView()` + `stationSettings()`, panel.ts:3305-3523)

### Purpose
Per-intercom management page: identity/technical data, relay mapping with per-relay test release, counts, capability
observations, clock, and (via children) door opening programs, public codes and technical settings.

### Entry point
Nav `devices` (top-level in WisKey 04 as "Doors / דלתות"; otherwise Tools card "devices"/"Intercoms"); "station details"
buttons from overview variants set `_deviceFocus`.

### Layout
- Toolbar `<h2>devices</h2>` + link `settings` (HA integration page).
- `device_selection` select: legacy appearances include "all" (show every station stacked); access/WisKey show exactly one
  station (focused or first).
- `article.station.station-config.device-station` per shown station:
  - Header: name, model (or `not_observed`); buttons **rescan** (disabled while busy, scanning or not loaded) and primary
    **sync_now** (station).
  - When `modern` (appearance `modern` or any access/WisKey): station tab bar `nav.station-tabs` with
    `["overview", "programs", "public_codes", "settings"]` labels `station_tab_*` (Overview / Opening schedules / Public codes /
    Settings; he: סקירה / תוכניות פתיחה / קודים ציבוריים / הגדרות); state `_stationTabs[station.id]` default `overview`.
  - Tab **overview** (always shown in legacy): card "station_details" (online badge; dl model, firmware, address = host,
    last_seen, last_poll ms; `station_access`/`camera_only`; link `configure`); card "technical_relays" for physical relays
    1 and 2: `configured`/`not_configured` badge, name · API id, a relay release button and per-relay release feedback;
    metrics managed_users / pending_users / integrated_locks; WisKey 04 shortcuts to `programs` and `public_codes` tabs;
    `scanning` status, `scan_failed: t(scan_error)`, `t(last_error)`.
  - Tab **programs**: `<wiskey-door-programs .hass .station>` (modern only; legacy gets it inside station-technical "all").
  - Tabs **settings** and **public_codes**: `<hikvision-station-technical .mode=${tab} ...>` (legacy: `.mode="all"` always
    visible).
  - Tab **settings** also shows two `<details class="device-extra">` (open in `current`): clock (`clockView()`: source + zone,
    device time, checked, skew + time mode, `clock_stale`/`clock_read_failed`, embedded compact
    `hikvision-clock-settings`, **clock_refresh** button) and capabilities (`capabilityDetails()`: observed flags for
    `call_status, snapshot, video_channel, user_info, card_info, event_query` with ✓/?; integrated locks
    "physical_lock N → API id"; event stream/history state and history-until; dl last_reconciliation, last_scan,
    users `user_count / max_users`, cards `card_count / max_cards`, unmanaged; `inspection_hint`).

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rescan | READ on device (identity, capabilities, inventory; updates in-memory cache; no reconciliation) | `hikvision_intercom/stations/rescan` `{station_id, api_contract: 1}` → `{accepted: true}` (600 s wait); notice `scan_complete` | `run()` (stations manage) | panel.ts:3374-3379 |
| Sync now (station) | CONFIG-WRITE (device reconciliation for that station) | `hikvision_intercom/sync/station` `{station_id, api_contract: 1}` → `{accepted: true}` | `run()` | panel.ts:3380-3386 |
| Relay N release | PHYSICAL | `stations/test_unlock {station_id, lock}` | overview/stations manage; no confirm | panel.ts:3453 |
| Clock refresh | READ on device (re-reads device time; updates in-memory clock state) | `hikvision_intercom/stations/clock_refresh` `{station_id, api_contract: 1}` → clock public | per-station in-flight guard; not via `run()`; backend requires **management manage** | panel.ts:1032-1046, 1071-1076 |
| Switch station tab / device | client | — | — | panel.ts:3350-3403 |
| Programs / public codes / technical / clock settings | delegated to children (door programs = PHYSICAL (scheduled) per other part) | (children) | — | panel.ts:3490-3496, 1066-1070 |

## Screen: Sync (tab `sync`, `syncView()`, panel.ts:3524-3757)

### Purpose
Per-person × per-station synchronization matrix, recent sync operations, diagnostics download, "sync all", and pending
removals (deleted people, revocations, card/PIN removals) with inspection.

### Entry point
Tools card "sync"; WisKey 04 pending-sync stat button. Area stations.

### Layout
- Heading `sync` + `sync_intro`; buttons "download_sync_diagnostics" and primary "sync_all".
- `<details class="sync-operations">` (`sync_operations_title`, hint): table of `overview.sync_operations` (max 200, filtered by
  station and attention = `pending|failed`): name (or `operation_removed_user`), device, `operation_<state>`, queued, verified,
  id.
- Filters: search (name/employee), station select (all or one), checkbox `sync_attention_only`.
- Status line `user_results: shown / total · devices: N`.
- Matrix table (`table-wrap matrix`): header per station with optional ⓘ `sync_reference` details and `last_error`; row per
  person (name button → person details, optional ⓘ user `sync_reference`); cell: button with `badge(sync_state ?? "pending")`
  → conflict review (disabled when busy or station offline), plus `sync_error_details` collapsible with `t(last_error)`; `—`
  when unassigned. Empty: `sync_no_matches` or `no_sync`.
- `pending_removals` box: `no_pending_removals`, or per tombstone: employee id, per unconfirmed target station → name, badge
  (`stations[id].sync_state ?? "delete_pending"`), **inspect**, **sync_now** (station); per revocation: person · station,
  badge, **inspect**; card removals (`cards`) and PIN removals (`retired_pin`) as text lines with pending station names.

### User actions

| Sync all | CONFIG-WRITE (device) | `hikvision_intercom/sync/all` | `run()` (stations manage client-side; backend requires **users manage**) | panel.ts:3565-3571 |
| Cell / Inspect → conflict review | READ (device read) | `conflicts/review` (see next screen) | `run()` | panel.ts:3706-3710, 3740, 3742 |
| Sync now for a pending-removal station | CONFIG-WRITE (device) | `sync/station {station_id}` | `run()` | panel.ts:3740 |
| Filters | client | — | — | panel.ts:3613-3641 |

## Screen: Conflict review / resolve (dialog `review`, panel.ts:1943-1998, 4311-4492)

### Purpose
Side-by-side comparison of WisKey's desired ("central") record and what the station actually holds, for one person on one
station, with explicit resolution: push central state to device, import device state into central, or confirm a pending
deletion.

### Entry point
Sync matrix cells, pending removals "inspect", audit tab `review-user` event. `inspect(userId, stationId)` sets `_dialog =
"review"` and runs `conflicts/review` via `run()`.

### Layout
Station name + "review_refresh" (re-inspect); `review_hint`; `review_timestamp` + desired revision + applied revision;
last reconciliation; assignment badge + `last_error`; `review_revision_changed` alert when stale; `review_inactive` note when
the person is inactive; `div.review-fields`: for each of `presence, display_name, user_type, validity, door_rights, pin, cards,
schedule, privileged, other_credentials` a section (class `changed` when in `differences`) with status
(`not_verified` / `review_different` / `review_same`) and two columns `central_state` / `device_state` (values via
`reviewValue()`: validity shown in station zone when device `time_type === "UTC"`, else raw with `review_local`; door rights
mapped API id → lock name); `review_plan` (person operation `plan_<person>`, PIN plan, cards add/remove/update);
`review_impact` + list of affected stations with online badges; action-blocked reasons (`t(reason)`).
Footer: when `deletion_pending` → danger **resolve_delete**; else **device** ("Import device state") and primary **central**
("Use central state"); each disabled when busy, stale, or `actions[x].allowed` false.

Staleness (`reviewStale()`, 4311-4325): `invalidated` flag (set after `review_stale`/`revision_conflict` errors); for deletion,
the tombstone target must still be pending; otherwise the person's current revision must equal `review.revision`.

### Data model — `Review`, `ReviewState` (types.ts:202-246); backend builder `access/manager.py:1030-1115`.

### User actions

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Review / refresh | READ (device read of one person; returns fingerprint `review_token`) | `hikvision_intercom/conflicts/review` `{user_id, station_id, api_contract: 1}` → `Review` (600 s) | `run()` | panel.ts:1943-1954 |
| Use central state | CONFIG-WRITE (**device** overwritten to match central; sync requested) | `hikvision_intercom/conflicts/resolve` `{station_id, user_id, review_token, revision, direction: "central", api_contract: 1}` → `Person` | native `confirm(confirm_central)`; token must match fresh device fingerprint | panel.ts:1955-1998 |
| Import device state | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage updated from device; then sync to all assigned stations) | same with `direction: "device"` | `confirm(confirm_device)` | panel.ts:1955-1998 |
| Confirm removal of reviewed record | CONFIG-WRITE (device deletion continues) | `hikvision_intercom/conflicts/resolve_deletion` `{station_id, user_id, review_token, api_contract: 1}` → `{accepted: true}` | `confirm(confirm_remove_reviewed)` | panel.ts:1955-1998 |

Backend reasons returned in `actions.*.reason`: `deletion_not_pending, ownership_missing, user_not_found,
device_user_missing`, import errors (see Import screen), validation codes.

### Backend `overview` projection (reference; `websocket.py:264-375`)
- Base = `get_manager(hass).public()` (users, stations, tombstones, revocations, card_removals, pin_removals, sync_operations …).
- Per station adds: `entities` (camera/lock + `call_status` sensor, `online`/`ringing` binary sensors, `lock_<n>`), `clock`,
  `observations`, `integrated_locks`, `event_status`, `online`, `call_state` (coordinator `normalized` or `"unavailable"`),
  `last_seen`, `last_poll_ms`, `last_access`, `model`, `firmware`, `host`.
- Adds `appearance_settings`, `default_zone = {kind:"iana", name: hass.config.time_zone}`, `media_settings`,
  `profile_settings`, `access` (policy; admins get all areas `manage`), `user_count`, `api = contract(allowed commands)`,
  `version`.
- Redaction for non-admins: users area `none` → `users = []`, `user_count = 0`; users and events both `none` →
  `profile_settings = null`; stations `none` → station keys `host, model, firmware, capabilities, observations, clock,
  event_status, last_poll_ms` removed.
- `api.commands` = every `COMMANDS` key the caller may run (+ `authorization/session`); `api.capabilities` =
  `employee_phone, talk_mode, event_portraits, sync_tracking, user_timing_draft, user_timing_enforcement, whatsapp_templates,
  panel_permissions, shared_appearance, user_directory_query, operations_query, intercom_tts, identity_lifecycle,
  operational_readiness` (`api_contract.py:7-22`); `version: 1`, `min_client: 0`.

## Helper modules (frontend)

- **api-contract.ts** — see "protectedHass" above. `CLIENT_API = 1`. Client `reads` set (20-70) differs from backend
  `READ_COMMANDS` (see Open questions).
- **request.ts** — `boundedRequest`, `ScopedRequests` (above).
- **user-filters.ts** — `UserFilters {group?, profile?: Record<string,string>, station, rights, state, credential, sort}`;
  `defaultFilters() = {station:"", rights:"", state:"", credential:"", sort:"employee"}`; `matchingUsers(users, query,
  filters, now)`: group membership; profile equality; text contains in `"<name> <employee_no> <phone>"`, or phone-digit match
  (query matches `^[+0-9 ()-]+$` with ≥ 3 digits), or 4-digit card suffix of `masked_number`; station/rights/state/credential
  rules identical to backend `user_directory.py:107-176`; sort by numeric-aware employee_no or name (`name_desc` reversed),
  tie-break by id.
- **phone.ts** — `mobileDisplay(value)`: strips non-digits, `00972`/`972` prefix → `0`; if `^05[0-9]{8}$` formats
  `05X-XXX-XXXX`, else returns the input unchanged.
- **time.ts** — `DisplayZone`; `UTC_ZONE`; `offsetAt(ms, zone)` (IANA via Intl; `device` zones via DST rule arrays
  `[month, week, weekday, second]`); `offsetLabel` → `UTC±HH:MM[:SS]`; `formatTime(value, locale, zone)` → locale string +
  `" · UTC±HH:MM"`, `"—"` for values without explicit offset; `localInput(value, zone)` → `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`;
  `fromLocalInput(value, zone)` → ISO UTC, throws `clock_invalid_local | clock_ambiguous | clock_nonexistent`;
  `resolveLocalInput(value, zone, known)` keeps the known instant when the displayed value is unchanged.
- **timing-validity.ts** — `timingPreview(draft, date, time)` (dates 2000..2037, periods ≤ 8, non-overlapping, `24:00` allowed
  as end; throws `invalid_user_timing`); `timingValidity(draft)`: only `mode "dates"`, 1..64 unique dates, no weekdays,
  intervals must be exactly contiguous → `{start, end}` else `user_timing_not_continuous` / `invalid_validity`.
- **profile-fields.ts** — `validProfileValue(field, value)`: empty ok unless required; select must be an option; number
  `^-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})(?:\.[0-9]{1,8})?$`; date strict `YYYY-MM-DD` real date; `profileError(policy, values, previous?)`
  → `profile_value_invalid | profile_required | ""` (skips disabled fields and unchanged values).
- **download.ts** — `downloadText(content, filename, type = "text/csv;charset=utf-8")` via Blob URL, revoked after 1 s.
- **dialog-viewport.ts** — `fitDialogViewport(dialog)` (above).
- **icons.ts** — `icon(name)`: inline 24×24 stroke SVG (`class="ui-icon"`, stroke-width 1.7, `aria-hidden`), names: `phone,
  hangup, microphone, speaker, fullscreen, media_options, tools, appearance, overview, users, devices, events, sync,
  operations_center, audit, health, schedules, lock, camera, menu, arrow`; unknown names fall back to `overview`
  (so tabs like `clock_options`, `whatsapp_templates`, `camera_wall`, `identity_lifecycle`, `permission_directory`,
  `profile_options`, `access_control` render the overview house icon).
- **live-clock.ts** — `<hikvision-live-clock language zone>`: `role="timer" aria-live="off"`, date + `HH:mm:ss` (h23, `dir=ltr`)
  + zone name; IANA zones only (device zones render as UTC); invalid locale falls back to `en`.

## Open questions

1. **Client-side admin elevation.** `contractHass` returns `hass.user.is_admin = true` whenever an API contract is loaded
   (`api-contract.ts:88-98`), so every child's "admin only" check passes for any WisKey-permitted user. Server permissions
   remain authoritative, but child UIs may show controls a non-admin cannot use (they then fail with `unauthorized`).
   `wiskey-access-control` deliberately receives raw `this.hass` (and the tab additionally requires `_session.is_admin`).
2. **Client gate vs. server permission mismatches** (because `run()` checks the current tab's area, not the command):
   - Sync tab "sync_all": client needs stations manage; server `sync/all` needs users manage.
   - Sync tab / audit "inspect" (`conflicts/review`): client needs manage of the current tab area; server needs users view.
   - Import existing (`stations/inventory`): client needs users manage (users tab); server needs stations view.
   - CSV export: client users manage; server users view.
   - Clock refresh: shown on the devices tab (stations area) with no client gate; server needs management manage.
   - `profile_options` and `camera_wall` map to area `overview` in `tabArea()`, so their tool cards appear for overview
     viewers, while `profiles/settings_get`/`update` need management.
3. **`AuthorizationSession.revision`**: `overview.access` lacks `revision`; after the first refresh `_session.revision` is
   `undefined` despite the TS type.
4. **`api-contract.ts` `reads` vs backend `READ_COMMANDS`** (checked by set difference): the client list additionally contains
   `clock/host_status` and `clock/settings_get`; the backend list has no entries missing from the client list. So the backend
   requires `api_contract` for those two clock reads while the client would still let them through in an incompatible
   session (the backend would then reject with `api_incompatible`). Only matters when `compatible()` is false.
5. **Missing translations** (verified by dumping `i18n.ts`): `action_failed`, `request_too_large`, `unknown_command`,
   `user_not_found`, `station_not_found`, `permissions_unavailable`, `manager_closed`, `capture_state_applying`,
   `capture_state_expired`, `capture_state_cancelled`, `connection_lost` have no en/he entry and render as the key with
   underscores replaced by spaces. `action_failed` is mapped to `release_unconfirmed` for releases only; elsewhere
   (e.g. a failed save) it would show "action failed". Capture error codes (`capture_timeout`, `capture_station_busy`,
   `capture_limit`, `capture_unsupported`, `capture_reader_invalid`, `capture_not_ready`, `capture_applying`,
   `capture_not_found`) are translated. The server session state `applying` has no `capture_state_applying` text.
6. **Card capture cancel race**: when `capture_start` returns after the dialog was closed, cancel is sent through raw
   `hass.callWS` (no `api_contract`, bypassing the proxy allow-list) (`panel.ts:1498-1503`). Backend accepts it because
   `cards/capture_cancel` is read-exempt.
7. **`sync_now` semantics**: "Save" (without sync) still leaves periodic/automatic reconciliation active (notice `saved` says
   so); `sync_now=true` on update only requests sync if device-relevant fields changed (`access/manager.py:738-757`).
8. **Timing enforcement `ha` vs `native`**: the editor sends `access_timing_policy.mode`; what "ha" enforcement does at runtime
   (e.g. toggling device validity on a schedule) is implemented outside this part — needs confirmation from the backend
   access/timing module owner. Classified here as CONFIG-WRITE; it gates access rights, it does not actuate a relay.
9. **`narrow` property** from HA is declared but unused; layout relies on `clientWidth` and container queries.
10. **Unknown `_tab` values** fall through to the events screen (render's final else).
11. `icons.ts` has no dedicated glyphs for several tool tabs; they fall back to the overview icon.
12. `wallView` "ringing" metric counts offline stations with a stale `call_state === "ringing"` (in practice `updated()` sets
    offline stations to `"unavailable"`, so this is likely harmless).
13. The **legacy "current"** overview renders `camera()` for offline stations and always shows call controls (if permitted);
    other variants hide media for offline stations.
14. `users/pin_check`/`pin_generate` are classified server-side as users **manage** although they do not change state.

# WisKey extraction — Part C: cameras, live video, call handling, audio/talk, TTS, door release runtime, media settings, HA entities

Source root R = `wiskey-ref/repo`. Frontend paths are relative to `R/frontend/src/`; backend paths relative to
`R/custom_components/hikvision_intercom/`. All line numbers refer to the files as read (1-based). Facts only.

## 0. Cross-cutting facts used by every screen in this part

### 0.1 How the panel talks to the backend
- Panel commands are sent as `hass.callWS({type: "hikvision_intercom/<command>", ...})` through a proxy
  `contractHass()` (`api-contract.ts:83-126`). The proxy:
  - adds `api_contract: 1` to any command listed in the server contract `commands` list **except** the
    "audio session commands" `audio/send`, `audio/receive`, `audio/mute`, `audio/diagnostics`, `tts/engines`,
    `tts/start` (`api-contract.ts:74-81,116-121`). Those handlers reject any extra field (exact key-set checks),
    so `api_contract` must NOT be sent to them.
  - rejects locally with `{code:"unauthorized"}` a command absent from the contract when capability
    `panel_permissions` is present (`api-contract.ts:108-115`), and `{code:"api_incompatible"}` for non-read
    commands when the contract is incompatible, except "cleanup" commands `audio/stop`, `audio/mute`,
    `cards/capture_cancel`, `events/trace_stop` (`api-contract.ts:82,106-107`).
  - **elevates `hass.user.is_admin` to `true`** for any user once a contract is present
    (`api-contract.ts:88-98`). Every component in this part gates on `hass.user.is_admin`; with the proxy
    this means "user was admitted to the panel"; effective authorization is enforced server-side.
- `hass.connection.subscribeMessage(...)` (used for `audio/start`, `tts/start`, `camera/webrtc/offer`) does **not**
  pass through the `callWS` proxy, so these messages never carry `api_contract`.
- Backend `COMMANDS` handler (`websocket.py:989-1074`): authorizes first (`command_allowed`), then schema,
  then `validate_client(api_contract)` (read commands exempt; `api_contract.py:87-91`, `API_VERSION=1`,
  `MIN_CLIENT=0`), strict `int`/`bool` typing, 64 KiB request cap, per-user `AdminLimiter`. Errors:
  `invalid_fields`, AccessError codes (sent as error `code`), `device_unavailable` (any HikvisionError),
  `action_failed`. Commands that return nothing explicit return `{"accepted": true}` (`websocket.py:986`).
- Permission areas (`panel_permissions.py:289-314`); HA admins always allowed (`:317-339`). Media/call grants:
  - `stations/test_unlock`, `media/signal`, `tts/engines`, `tts/start` → `overview:manage` OR `stations:manage` (`:294-295`)
  - `media/call` → `overview:view` OR `stations:view` (`:296-297`)
  - `media/settings_get`, `media/provider_check` → `management:view` (`_READ_MANAGEMENT`, `:232-255`)
  - `media/settings_update`, `media/provider_discover` → `management:manage` (`_WRITE_MANAGEMENT`, `:256-286`)
  - `audio/start|send|receive|mute|diagnostics` (`audio_api.py:25-29`) → `overview:manage` OR `stations:manage`
  - MSE/RTC HTTP views → `overview:view` OR `stations:view` (`mse_api.py:53-57`, `rtc_api.py:50-54`)
- The global media policy reaches the panel inside the `overview` result:
  `data["media_settings"] = media.public()` (`websocket.py:329-330`), stored as panel `_data.media_settings` and
  passed down as `.media` / `.settings` / `.ttsSettings`. It is replaced after the `media-saved` event
  (`panel.ts:4753-4756`) and on every `overview` refresh. `MediaSettings.update` calls `changed()` which dispatches
  `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED` (`access_runtime.py:49-51,81-82`), making `hikvision_intercom/subscribe` emit
  `{"kind":"refresh"}` (`websocket.py:1094-1106`).

### 0.2 Station fields consumed by these screens (`types.ts:98-143`, built in `websocket.py:264-330`)
`id` (= config entry id), `name`, `online` (runtime present, not closed, coordinator `last_update_success`),
`call_state` (coordinator normalized state, or `"unavailable"` when offline), `lock_enabled`,
`integrated_locks: {physical_index, api_id, name?}[]`, `entities: Record<string,string>` with keys
`camera`, `lock`, `lock_1`/`lock_2`, `call_status`, `online`, `ringing` (`websocket.py:271-281,303-308`),
`observations.snapshot`, `observations.video_channel` (`:283-290`), `clock` (zone used for timestamps).

### 0.3 Playback selection (HLS / WebRTC-RTC / MSE) — one global setting, not per station
`MediaPolicy` (`media-settings.ts:7-17`); defaults `media-settings.ts:18-28` equal backend `DEFAULTS`
(`media_settings.py:14-23`): `transport:"webrtc"`, `webrtc_mode:"rtc"`, `fallback_hls:true`, `go2rtc_url:""`,
`talk_mode:"ptt"`, `tts_engine_id:""`, `tts_language:""`, `tts_phrases:[]`, plus `revision`.
Decision in `IntercomCamera.start()` (`camera.ts:370-495`):
1. `transport === "hls"` → `startHls()` (HA core WS `camera/stream`, `format:"hls"`).
2. `transport === "webrtc"` and `webrtc_mode === "mse"` → `CameraMSE` over the WisKey view
   `/api/hikvision_intercom/mse/{station_id}` (go2rtc behind HA).
3. `transport === "webrtc"` and `webrtc_mode === "rtc"`:
   - `go2rtc_url` non-empty → skip `camera/capabilities`; `CameraRTC` with `AddonSignaling` over the WisKey view
     `/api/hikvision_intercom/rtc/{station_id}`; ICE server `stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478`
     (`camera-rtc.ts:58-59`); first attempt TCP-only (UDP candidates dropped both ways), one retry allowing UDP
     (`camera.ts:471-491`).
   - `go2rtc_url` empty → HA core `camera/capabilities` must list `web_rtc`, then HA core
     `camera/webrtc/get_client_config` + subscription `camera/webrtc/offer` + `camera/webrtc/candidate`
     (HA's own WebRTC provider).
4. Any RTC/MSE failure → HLS if `fallback_hls`, else error screen (`camera.ts:390-417`).
Restart key: `JSON.stringify([transport, webrtc_mode, fallback_hls, go2rtc_url])` — saving talk/TTS fields does
not restart video (`camera.ts:332-340`). The backend views additionally refuse (HTTP 409) when the saved
policy does not match the view (MSE view requires `webrtc`+`mse`; RTC view requires `webrtc`+`rtc`).

### 0.4 go2rtc usage and stream naming (namespace safety)
- WisKey **never registers, names, edits or deletes a go2rtc stream**. Both bridges connect upstream with
  `session.ws_connect(url + "/api/ws", params={"src": source})` where
  `source = runtime.client.settings.rtsp_source()` =
  `rtsp://<url-quoted user>:<url-quoted pass>@<host>:<rtsp_port>/Streaming/Channels/101`
  (`mse_api.py:87-93`, `rtc_api.py:81-87`, `client/client.py:78-82`). Code comment: "go2rtc GetOrPatch accepts
  an RTSP source without persisting configuration" (`mse_api.py:88`, `rtc_api.py:82`). No go2rtc config write
  and no `/api/streams` call exists in the backend (go2rtc is referenced only in `mse_api.py`, `rtc_api.py`,
  `media_api.py`, `media_settings.py`).
- Server selection `provider()` (`media_api.py:26-35`): explicit `go2rtc_url` (with HA's shared aiohttp client
  session), else HA's go2rtc integration object `hass.data["go2rtc"]` (`.session`, `.url`), else
  `AccessError("mse_provider_unavailable")` (this code is raised for the RTC view too).
- `media/provider_check` → `GET <url>/api` (6 s, body cap 8 KiB, JSON `version` must match
  `[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,64}`) (`media_api.py:54-66,69-90`).
- `media/provider_discover` probes only `http://a889bffc-go2rtc-hardware:1984` then `http://a889bffc-go2rtc:1984`
  (`GET /api`, 3 s each) and returns the first reachable one; nothing is saved (`media_api.py:44-53`).
- When `go2rtc_url` is empty and RTC mode is used, video goes through HA core `camera/webrtc/*`; any go2rtc stream
  registration on that path is HA core behaviour (not in this repo).
- Snapshots and HLS do not use go2rtc (HLS uses HA's `stream` component with `stream_source()`).

### 0.5 Snapshots (still previews)
Non-live `hikvision-intercom-camera` renders `<img>` from the camera entity's `entity_picture`
(HA `/api/camera_proxy/<entity>?token=...`), accepted only if same-origin and the path starts with
`/api/camera_proxy/`; appends `_intercom_preview=<tick>` (`camera.ts:668-686`). The tick updates on becoming
visible and every 10 s while visible and the tab is not hidden (`camera.ts:180-187`). Backend
`IntercomCamera.async_camera_image` → `client.async_snapshot()` → `GET /ISAPI/Streaming/channels/101/picture`,
JPEG SOI/EOI validated, 4 MiB cap, cached/coalesced 2 s (`camera.py:28-36`, `client/client.py:331-340`).

---

## Screen: Live camera player (`hikvision-intercom-camera`, `camera.ts`)

**Purpose.** Shows one station's camera: a periodically refreshed still image (preview) or a live video stream
(HLS / WebRTC-RTC / MSE) with a transport badge, a failure screen with Retry, and a diagnostics export. It also
hosts camera-stream audio playback when the audio controls request it.

**Entry points.** `panel.ts:2106-2116` helper `camera(station, live=false)` sets `.stationId`, `.media`
(= `_data.media_settings`), `.hass` (= contract proxy), `.entity` (= `station.entities.camera ?? ""`), `.version`,
`.live`, `.label` (`camera · <name>` or `no_camera`). Non-live (snapshot) in: overview wall `panel.ts:2372`, v4
overview callback `panel.ts:2444`, access overview `panel.ts:2486`, classic station cards `panel.ts:2573`.
Live in the camera dialog `cameraBody()` `panel.ts:4511` and in `wiskey-camera-wall` (`camera-wall.ts:297-305`).

**Layout & visual notes.** Host `display:block; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:12px; background:#172a2d`
(`camera.ts:86-94`); media `object-fit: var(--camera-object-fit, cover)`. Overlays: top-start status badge
`.player-status` showing `MSE` / `RTC` / `HLS` or translated `player_connecting` / `player_recovering`
(`camera.ts:657-666`); top-end Export button (`player_export`). Render states (`camera.ts:626-687`):
- live && tab hidden → text `player_suspended`; live && browser offline → `player_network_offline`;
  live && HA WS disconnected → `player_ha_disconnected`;
- live && failed → error panel (`role=status`): `player_failed`, `player_reason_<reason>`, buttons Retry
  (`player_retry`) and Export;
- no entity / not visible / failed (non-live) → label text only;
- live → `<video autoplay playsinline .muted=!audioEnabled>`; non-live → `<img loading=lazy>` or label.
No confirmation UX (no side-effect actions). Fullscreen is provided by the parent: `.camera-layout`
`requestFullscreen()` / `exitFullscreen()`, error `camera_fullscreen_failed` (`panel.ts:4493-4501`).

**Data model.**
- Props/state (`camera.ts:13-30`): `hass`, `entity: string`, `stationId: string`, `media: MediaPolicy|null`,
  `live: boolean`, `label: string`, `version: string`; state `_tick`, `_visible`, `_failed`, `_mode`
  (`player_connecting|player_mse|player_webrtc|player_hls|player_recovering`), `_fallback`, `_fallbackReason`,
  `_documentVisible`, `_networkOnline`, `_haConnected`.
- Export file `hikvision-playback.json` (`camera.ts:548-584`): `format:"hikvision_intercom.playback"`, `schema:1`,
  `integration_version`, `generated_at`, `started_at`, `first_frame_at`, `stall_recoveries`, `progress`
  (watchdog summary `{decoded_frames_observed, progress_age_ms, active}`), `mode`, `failed`, `fallback_reason`,
  `document_visible`, `browser_online`, `width`, `height`, `camera_audio_enabled`, `media_element_muted`,
  `playback_amplified`, `playback_gain`, `playback_audio_context`, `playback_capture_stream`, `rtc`, `mse`,
  `selected_transport`, `selected_webrtc_mode`, `fallback_allowed`, `active_transport`.
- Failure reasons (i18n `player_reason_*`): `mse_timeout`, `mse_provider_unavailable`, `mse_browser_unavailable`,
  `mse_connection_lost`, `mse_codec_unavailable`, `mse_protocol_error`, `mse_session_changed`,
  `mse_buffer_failed`, `capabilities_timeout`, `capabilities_failed`, `provider_unavailable`,
  `browser_unavailable`, `no_frame`, `signaling_failed`, `connection_failed`, `connection_lost`, `track_ended`,
  `signal_limit`, `hls_timeout`, `hls_failed`, `media_failed`, `playback_stalled`.

**User actions.**

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| View still preview | READ | HTTP GET HA `/api/camera_proxy/<camera entity>` (from `entity_picture`) + `_intercom_preview` | none; automatic, 10 s while visible | `camera.ts:180-187,668-686` |
| View live via HLS | READ | HA WS `camera/stream` `{entity_id, format:"hls"}` → `{url}` (must be same-origin `/api/hls/...`); hls.js `{lowLatencyMode:true, maxBufferLength:12}` or native HLS | none; starts automatically when `live` and visible | `camera.ts:591-625` |
| View live via RTC (HA provider) | READ | HA WS `camera/capabilities` `{entity_id}`; `camera/webrtc/get_client_config` `{entity_id}` → `{configuration, dataChannel?}`; subscribe `camera/webrtc/offer` `{entity_id, offer:<sdp>}`; `camera/webrtc/candidate` `{entity_id, session_id, candidate}` | none | `camera.ts:448-491`, `camera-rtc.ts:53-136` |
| View live via RTC (selected go2rtc) | READ (EXTERNAL: go2rtc pulls RTSP from the station) | HA WS `auth/sign_path` `{path:"/api/hikvision_intercom/rtc/<station>", expires:30}`, then browser WebSocket to the signed path (see Module `rtc_api.py`) | none | `camera-signaling.ts:13-58`, `camera-rtc.ts:57-63` |
| View live via MSE | READ (EXTERNAL: go2rtc pulls RTSP from the station) | HA WS `auth/sign_path` `{path:"/api/hikvision_intercom/mse/<station>", expires:30}`, then binary WebSocket (see Module `mse_api.py`) | none | `camera-mse.ts:38-132`, `camera.ts:422-447` |
| Retry after failure | READ | re-runs `start()` | button in error panel | `camera.ts:635-644` |
| Export playback diagnostics | READ (local file download) | none | none | `camera.ts:542-590` |
| Camera-stream audio on/off (invoked by audio controls) | PHYSICAL-listen per the classification rule (privacy: renders door audio already contained in the video stream); no device command — ambiguous | none; `setPlaybackAudio(enabled)` via parent handler of event `hikvision-playback-audio` | only after an explicit press in the audio controls | `camera.ts:301-322`, `panel.ts:4502-4508` |

**Live/stream lifecycle.**
- Inputs: `IntersectionObserver` → `_visible`; `visibilitychange`; window `online`/`offline`; HA connection
  `disconnected`/`ready` (`camera.ts:173-208`). Any change of connection, policy key, `stationId`, `entity`,
  `live`, `_visible`, `_documentVisible`, `_networkOnline`, `_haConnected` → `stop()`, reset recoveries, then
  `start()` if `live && _visible && entity && documentVisible && online && haConnected` (`camera.ts:323-369`).
  Non-admin → stop (`camera.ts:326-330`).
- `stop()` bumps `generation`, clears start timer, closes RTC/MSE/hls.js, mutes/pauses/unloads `<video>`
  (`camera.ts:209-229`). `disconnectedCallback` also closes the Web Audio graph and restores the audio session
  type (`camera.ts:189-200`).
- Timers: MSE first frame 16 s → `mse_timeout` (`camera.ts:430`); RTC capabilities 10 s → `capabilities_timeout`
  (`camera.ts:448`); CameraRTC first decoded frame 12 s → `no_frame` (`camera-rtc.ts:54`); peer `disconnected`
  → 3 s → `connection_lost` (`camera-rtc.ts:74-79`); HLS 16 s → `hls_timeout` (`camera.ts:594-596`).
- Watchdog `PlaybackWatchdog` (`playback-watchdog.ts`): started at first frame; 1 s interval; progress via
  `requestVideoFrameCallback` or `currentTime`; paused or hidden is never a fault; 12 s without progress →
  stalled (`playback-watchdog.ts:14-49`). `recoverFrozen()`: up to 2 automatic restarts of the same transport
  (`player_recovering`), then HLS fallback if allowed, else fail `playback_stalled` (`camera.ts:515-528`).
- go2rtc RTC path: TCP-only first; the first failure of any kind triggers one retry allowing UDP, a second
  failure goes to fallback (`camera.ts:388-400,489-491`).

**Notes/quirks.**
- Camera audio graph (`camera.ts:242-283,302-322`): `AudioContext` → source (captured `MediaStream` or
  `MediaElementSource`) → gain (32 when enabled, 0 when off) → `DynamicsCompressor` (threshold -8, knee 6,
  ratio 20, attack 0.003, release 0.25) → destination. Comment: the door stations publish an 8 kHz track below
  native audibility. On WebKit sets `navigator.audioSession.type = "playback"` while enabled (`camera.ts:284-300`).
  Availability returned: MSE → codec contains `mp4a.|flac|opus`; RTC → a live audio track; HLS → always true.
- "Images and HLS are obtained exclusively from authenticated Home Assistant camera APIs" (`camera.ts:11`);
  no device credentials or go2rtc address reach the browser.

### Helper: `CameraMSE` (`camera-mse.ts`, not a custom element)
- Codecs offered (`camera-mse.ts:3-4`): video `avc1.640029`, `avc1.64002A`, `avc1.640033`, `hvc1.1.6.L153.B0`
  (only those `isTypeSupported`); audio `mp4a.40.2`, `mp4a.40.5`, `flac`, `opus` (always appended; comment: go2rtc
  repackages the intercom PCMA/PCMU track to FLAC). Uses `ManagedMediaSource` if present else `MediaSource`.
- Flow (`camera-mse.ts:38-132`): sign path (30 s) → same-origin/same-path check → `ws(s)://` → on `sourceopen`
  open WebSocket (`binaryType="arraybuffer"`) → send `{"codecs":[...]}`. Receive text
  `{"type":"mse","value":"video/mp4; codecs=\"...\""}` (≤1024 chars, regex, `isTypeSupported`) → add
  SourceBuffer; binary fMP4 (≤4 MiB each, queue ≤8 MiB) → append; `{"type":"error","code":c}` → fail with `c` if
  known else `mse_connection_lost`; socket close/error → `mse_connection_lost`.
- Buffer policy (`camera-mse.ts:134-155`): live edge − currentTime > 3 s → seek to end−0.5; buffered > 8 s →
  remove up to end−6.
- `summary()` → `{bytes_received, fragments_received, codec, video_decoded, audio_included, closed}` (`:159-168`).

### Helper: `CameraRTC` (`camera-rtc.ts`) and `AddonSignaling` (`camera-signaling.ts`)
- `Signal` union (`camera-rtc.ts:4-8`): `{type:"session",session_id}` | `{type:"answer",answer}` |
  `{type:"candidate",candidate:RTCIceCandidateInit}` | `{type:"error"}`.
- Peer: recvonly video + recvonly audio transceivers (`camera-rtc.ts:88-89`); local candidates queued (≤100)
  until a session id; >256 incoming signals or >100 sent candidates → `signal_limit`; remote candidates without
  `sdpMid`/`sdpMLineIndex` get `sdpMid:"0"` (`camera-rtc.ts:80-168`); a `{type:"error"}` signal →
  `signaling_failed`.
- `summary()` (`camera-rtc.ts:173-189`): `ice_transport` (`tcp`|`auto`), `connection_state`, `ice_state`,
  `provider` (`selected_go2rtc`|`home_assistant`), `started_at`, `first_frame_at`, `video_decoded`,
  `audio_track_received`, `audio_track_live`, `closed`, `failure`, `signaling_messages`,
  `local_candidates_sent`. `diagnostics()` adds `getStats()` inbound-rtp counters (2 s timeout) (`:190-238`).
- `AddonSignaling` (`camera-signaling.ts`): signs `/api/hikvision_intercom/rtc/<station>` (30 s) (13-28); on open
  sends `{"offer": <sdp>}`, emits synthetic `{type:"session",session_id:"addon"}`, sends `{"type":"ping"}` every
  15 s (30-37); accepts only text ≤262144 chars with `type` in `answer|candidate|error`, ignores `pong` (38-49);
  local candidates sent as `{"candidate":"<candidate line>"}` (55-58); close/error → failure.

## Screen: Camera wall (`wiskey-camera-wall`, `camera-wall.ts`)

**Purpose.** A multi-camera live view (budget 4 or 9 streams) where the operator picks cameras, starts/stops
live playback explicitly, saves named layouts in the browser, and can enlarge one camera into the camera dialog.

**Entry point.** Panel tab `camera_wall` (`panel.ts:4713-4724`): `.hass=protectedHass`, `.stations=_data.stations`,
`.media=_data.media_settings`, `.version`, `.suspended=!!this._dialog` (any open dialog pauses the wall);
`@open-station` → sets `_cameraStation` and opens dialog `"camera"` (`panel.ts:4720-4723`). v4 overview exposes
`cameraWall: () => navigate("camera_wall")` gated by `canCameraWall: canView("overview")` (`panel.ts:2437,2472`).

**Layout & visual notes** (`camera-wall.ts:17-61,253-314`). Header `camera_wall` + hint `camera_wall_hint`
("Streams outside the viewport or in a hidden tab stop. Opening a single camera pauses the wall."). Row: select
"Maximum streams" (`4`/`9`), primary Start/Stop button (`camera_wall_start`/`camera_wall_stop`; disabled when
no stations or `suspended`), counter `selected n / limit`. `<details>` "Saved layouts" (select, Load, name input
maxlength 64, Save, Delete, Reload; `role=alert` errors). `<details>` "Choose cameras" with a checkbox per
station that has `entities.camera` (disabled beyond limit). Grid: 2 columns (4-mode) / 3 columns (9-mode);
9-mode → 2 columns ≤1000 px; 1 column ≤600 px. Tile: `<h3>name · online|offline</h3>`, a
`hikvision-intercom-camera` with `.live = active && !suspended`, and an Enlarge button.

**Data model.** `CameraLayout {id: string; name: string; limit: number; stations: string[]}`
(`camera-wall.ts:9-14`). Props `hass`, `stations: Station[]`, `media`, `version`, `suspended`; state `layouts`,
`layoutId`, `layoutName`, `layoutError`, `active`, `limit` (4), `selected: string[]`.
Storage: `localStorage["wiskey:camera-layouts:v1:" + hass.user.id]` (`:113-115`); validation
(`:116-152`): raw ≤50000 chars, ≤20 rows, id/name non-empty ≤64 no control chars, `limit ∈ {4,9}`,
stations unique, ≤limit, each ≤128 chars, unique ids. Optimistic concurrency: write aborts with
`views_changed` if the stored raw value changed since the last read (`:153-177`).

**User actions.**

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Choose stream budget 4/9 | none (UI) | — | trims selection | `camera-wall.ts:262-273` |
| Select/deselect cameras | none (UI) | — | checkbox disabled at limit | `camera-wall.ts:284-289` |
| Start / stop wall | READ (starts/stops live players, see camera player) | per tile, as in `hikvision-intercom-camera` | explicit button; never auto-starts; reset to stopped on user change | `camera-wall.ts:274-280,93-107` |
| Save layout | CONFIG-WRITE (browser localStorage only; not WisKey storage) | — | disabled unless storage ready, name set, selection non-empty, <20 layouts | `camera-wall.ts:178-191,229-234` |
| Load layout | none (UI) | — | always stops playback (`active=false`); `wall_layout_missing` if stations gone | `camera-wall.ts:192-202` |
| Delete layout | CONFIG-WRITE (browser localStorage only) | — | no confirmation dialog | `camera-wall.ts:235-243` |
| Reload layouts | READ (localStorage) | — | — | `camera-wall.ts:244` |
| Enlarge a tile | none (UI) | dispatches `open-station` (detail = station id) | — | `camera-wall.ts:306-310` |

**Live/stream lifecycle.** `active` becomes false on user change, on layout load and in `disconnectedCallback`
(`camera-wall.ts:93-107,195-196,249-252`); tiles are live only when `active && !suspended`. Each tile's player
handles its own visibility/timeouts (see camera player). Backend caps: at most 9 concurrent MSE and 9 concurrent
RTC bridge sockets (HTTP 429) (`mse_api.py:62-63`, `rtc_api.py:59-60`).

**Notes/quirks.** Layouts are per HA user per browser; nothing is stored server-side.

## Screen: Call controls (`hikvision-intercom-call-controls`, `call-controls.ts`)

**Purpose.** Shows which call signals the station advertises and its call state, and lets the operator send
Answer / Reject / Hang-up signals to the door station; shows the device acknowledgement and a post-command state
observation.

**Entry points.** `panel.ts:2094-2105` helper `callControls(station, compact=false, dock=false)`; rendered only if
the user can manage `overview` or `stations`. Props: `.hass=protectedHass`, `.station`, `.compact`, `.dock`,
`.blocked=_callBusy.has(station.id)`, `.onBusy=setCallBusy` (panel-wide per-station lock set, `panel.ts:2089-2093`),
`.onRefreshState` (dock only → enables the dialog's refresh icon, `panel.ts:467-469`). Used: compact in station
cards `panel.ts:2596` and station-activity dialog `panel.ts:4617`; dock inside the camera dialog audio dock
`panel.ts:4521`. Also in the health screen inside a `<details>` "media_signals" (`health.ts:534-539`, props
`.hass`, `.station`, `.blocked=callBusy`, `.onBusy=onCallBusy`).

**Layout & visual notes** (`call-controls.ts:32-111,386-423`). `<section aria-label=media_signals>`; hint
`media_signal_hint` ("Acknowledgement does not confirm an answered call") or `call_compact_hint`; hidden in dock.
Toolbar of buttons from `["answer","reject","hangUp"]` filtered by advertised `call_commands`; in compact/dock
modes only buttons matching the current state are shown (`answer`/`reject` while `ringing`, `hangUp` while
`in_call`). Dock style: round 52 px buttons, answer green `#12853d`, reject/hangUp red `#dc3545`, phone/hangup
icons. Non-dock has a Refresh button (`call_refresh`). Status lines: `call_connection_lost`, `loading` while busy,
error (`role=alert`), result text `callResultText()` = `<ack> · <observation> · call_observed_state: <state>` plus
the time in the station clock zone, `call_refresh_required`. Compact mode renders nothing unless the station is
ringing/in_call or a result/error exists.

**Data model** (`call-controls.ts:8-22`):
```ts
export interface CallResult { command: string; acknowledged: boolean | null; observed_state: string | null;
  observation: string; checked_at: string; physical_result: "unverified"; }
interface CallContext { call_commands: string[]; state: string; checked_at: string; busy: boolean;
  last_result: CallResult | null; }
```
Backend result also contains `before_state` (`client/media.py:163-171`). `observation ∈ {"state_changed",
"unchanged","unavailable"}`; `acknowledged`: `true` = device statusCode 1, `null` = lost response.

**User actions.**

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Read call context (auto on station/state change, or Refresh) | READ (device reads: deviceInfo, callSignal capabilities, callStatus) | `hikvision_intercom/media/call` `{station_id}` → `CallContext` | auto when key `id:online:call_state:compact:haConnected` changes (compact: only while ringing/in_call); client timeout 20 s | `call-controls.ts:185-219,286-325` |
| Answer | PHYSICAL (answers the live call at the station) | `hikvision_intercom/media/signal` `{station_id, command:"answer"}` → `CallResult` | no confirm dialog; enabled only if advertised, state `ringing`, station online, HA connected, not busy/blocked, no refresh pending, `_context.busy` false, `station.call_state === context.state`; client timeout 40 s | `call-controls.ts:326-385` |
| Reject | PHYSICAL (rejects the ringing call; also stops any WisKey audio/TTS session for the station) | same, `command:"reject"` | same guards; dispatches `hikvision-call-ending` `{station}` (bubbles, composed) before sending | `call-controls.ts:342-351` |
| Hang up | PHYSICAL (ends the call; also stops audio/TTS) | same, `command:"hangUp"` | same guards; state must be `in_call`; dispatches `hikvision-call-ending` | `call-controls.ts:339,342-351` |
| Refresh (dialog icon) | READ | `refreshState()` → `media/call` | parent icon enabled via `onRefreshState` | `call-controls.ts:287-289`, `panel.ts:4527-4535` |

**Lifecycle.** Epoch-based cancellation; HA `disconnected` cancels read/signal, sets `call_command_unknown`
(signal) or `call_read_failed` (read) and marks `_refreshRequired` after a signal (`call-controls.ts:146-160`).
After any signal the context is discarded and `_refreshRequired=true` (the user must refresh before the next
signal) (`:366-376`). Closing the view does not cancel a submitted signal; the parent lock is released in
`finally` (`:233-246,377-384`).

**Notes/quirks.** The panel shows call controls only to manage-level users although `media/call` itself needs only
view. The call state shown comes from the overview (`station.call_state`, coordinator polling), and signals are
also gated server-side by a fresh device read.

## Screen: Audio / talk controls (`hikvision-intercom-audio-controls`, `audio-controls.ts`)

**Purpose.** Two-way audio with a door station from the camera dialog: "Start listening" (hear the door),
push-to-talk or toggle talk (speak through the door speaker), microphone selection and local test, live signal
meters, backend diagnostics and export. In dock mode it slots the call controls, door release buttons, refresh and
fullscreen buttons, and (non-v4) the TTS composer.

**Entry point.** Camera dialog body `cameraBody()` (`panel.ts:4509-4562`): `.dock=true`, `.hideTts=v4`, `.v4`,
`.talkMode = _data.media_settings.talk_mode ?? "ptt"`, `.ttsSettings = _data.media_settings`, `.hass`, `.station`;
slot content: `callControls(station,false,true)`, `.camera-door-actions` with `releaseButton(station,true,true)`,
refresh icon (`call_refresh`), fullscreen button (`wall_fullscreen`). The wrapping `.camera-layout` handles
`hikvision-playback-audio` (`panel.ts:4545,4559`). The camera dialog is a native `<dialog>` opened only by user
clicks (Enlarge / camera icon), never automatically on ring (`panel.ts:2377,2463,2497,2576,4722`); its header shows
online/offline and call state (`panel.ts:4591`); its footer is hidden (`panel.ts:4631`).

**Layout & visual notes** (`audio-controls.ts:23-204,909-1067`). Section with `<details class=audio-options>`
(closed in dock) containing hint (`audio_hint` / `audio_toggle_hint`), `wiskey-microphone-input`, and nested
diagnostics `<details>` (signal %, peak %, packets acknowledged, received signal/peak %, backend bytes written,
mic signal bytes, received signal bytes, upload HTTP status, sample time, Refresh diagnostics and Export buttons,
`audio_speaker_unverified`). Session buttons: idle → "Start listening" (`audio_start`, speaker icon); active →
Talk button (`talk-button`, `aria-pressed`, labels `audio_push_to_talk` / `audio_talking` / `audio_begin_talk` /
`audio_end_talk` / `audio_microphone_wait`) and "Stop listening" (`audio_stop`). Status line: `audio_state_<state>`
or `camera_microphone_active`, `· audio_playback_camera` when using the camera stream audio,
`· audio_received_signal: n%`. Dock: meter (0-100) while talking. `audio_https_required` when not a secure
context; error `role=alert`. v4 dock uses theme tokens and 42 px rectangular buttons; ≤600 px no wrap.

**Data model.**
```ts
interface AudioEvent { state: "ready" | "closed"; token?: string; sample_rate?: number; packet_bytes?: number;
  reason?: string; close_confirmed?: boolean | null; }   // audio-controls.ts:12-19
```
Backend `ready` event also carries `format:"hikvision_intercom.audio"`, `max_seconds:180` (`audio_api.py:98-108`).
Props: `dock`, `hideTts`, `v4`, `talkMode: "ptt"|"toggle"`, `ttsSettings`, `hass`, `station`. States:
`_state ∈ idle|opening|listening`, `_talking`, `_micPending`, counters. Export file `wiskey-audio-diagnostics.json`
(`audio-controls.ts:872-907`): `format:"hikvision_intercom.audio_diagnostics"`, `schema:1`, `generated_at`,
`started_at`, `path:"browser_ha_isapi"`, `playback_source` (`camera_stream`|`isapi`), `secure_context`,
`microphone_api`, `state`, `microphone_stage`, `audio_context`, `sample_rate`, `microphone_packets_captured`,
`microphone_packets_acknowledged`, `microphone_packets_dropped_busy`, `microphone_signal_percent`,
`microphone_peak_percent`, `station_signal_percent`, `station_peak_percent`, `backend_sampled_at`,
`backend_refresh_failed`, `receive_packets`, `backend`, `error`, `physical_audibility:"unverified"`,
`recording_saved:false`.

**User actions.**

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start listening — camera stream has audio | PHYSICAL-listen (privacy: door audio audible to operator); no device command, only unmutes the video element | event `hikvision-playback-audio` `{enabled:true}` → `camera.setPlaybackAudio(true)` | button; requires online, HA connected, tab visible | `audio-controls.ts:387-420,309-319` |
| Start listening — no camera audio | PHYSICAL-listen (opens ISAPI two-way audio session on the station; door microphone streamed; silence frames written to the door speaker channel) | subscribe `hikvision_intercom/audio/start` `{station_id}` (exact keys) → events `ready`/`closed`; then loop `hikvision_intercom/audio/receive` `{token}` → `{format, data: base64(800 B μ-law)}` | button; AudioContext must run at 8000 Hz (else `audio_unsupported`); opening timeout 25 s | `audio-controls.ts:421-519,558-599` |
| Hold to talk (PTT) / toggle talk | PHYSICAL (operator voice through the door speaker) | if no session: `audio/start` (talk-only); `getUserMedia({audio:{deviceId?, channelCount:1, echoCancellation, noiseSuppression, autoGainControl}})`; AudioWorklet `hikvision-microphone` produces 800-byte μ-law packets → `hikvision_intercom/audio/send` `{token, sequence, data}` → `{sequence: n+1}` | PTT: pointerdown/Space/Enter press, release on pointerup/cancel/lostcapture/blur/keyup/window blur; toggle: click; requires secure context; microphone permission prompt by browser | `audio-controls.ts:609-704,705-737,1005-1048` |
| Release talk | PHYSICAL-control (stops speaker output; drops queued frames) | `hikvision_intercom/audio/mute` `{token}` → `{}`; talk-only sessions are then closed (unsubscribe) and camera audio restored | automatic on release | `audio-controls.ts:738-788` |
| Stop listening | PHYSICAL-control (closes the device audio session: `PUT .../close`) | unsubscribe of the `audio/start` subscription (HA `unsubscribe_events`); no `audio/stop` command | button; also automatic (see lifecycle) | `audio-controls.ts:796-817,520-530` |
| Refresh diagnostics | READ | `hikvision_intercom/audio/diagnostics` `{token}` → counters | button / auto while diagnostics open (≥2 s spacing) | `audio-controls.ts:818-857` |
| Export diagnostics | READ (local file) | optionally `audio/diagnostics` first | none | `audio-controls.ts:858-908` |
| Microphone select / local test | see `wiskey-microphone-input` | — | — | `audio-controls.ts:916-925` |

**Live/stream lifecycle.**
- `stop()` triggers: document hidden (`visibilitychange`), `pagehide`, `hikvision-call-ending` for the same station
  (sent by Reject/Hang-up), HA `disconnected`, user change/non-admin, connection object change, station offline,
  station change, element removal (`audio-controls.ts:320-373`). Window `blur` releases PTT (`:323-325`).
- Every RPC has a 5 s client timeout; a lost RPC stops the session (never retried) (`:540-557`).
- Receive loop plays packets via `AudioBuffer` 800 samples @8 kHz, 100 ms each, scheduled with ≤300 ms queue
  (`:581-608`); playback suppressed while talking or when using camera audio.
- Send: drops a captured packet if the previous send is still in flight (`dropped` counter); sequence must come
  back as previous+1 else `audio_invalid_packet` → stop (`:705-737`).
- Error codes surfaced: `audio_busy`, `audio_unsupported`, `audio_auth_failed`, `audio_open_unconfirmed`,
  `audio_connection_lost`, `audio_close_unconfirmed` (closed event with `close_confirmed:false`),
  `audio_playback_interrupted`, `audio_worklet_failed`, `audio_microphone_denied`, `mic_selection_unavailable`,
  `audio_microphone_missing`, `audio_microphone_busy`, `audio_microphone_failed`, plus backend `closed` reasons
  (`audio_stopped` is not shown) (`:531-539,681-700,816`).

**Notes/quirks.** When the camera stream carries audio, the ISAPI audio session is opened only while talking
(`backendTalkOnly`), then muted and closed on release (`:625-635,763-778`). The backend still runs its device
receive task in that case (the frontend just does not poll `audio/receive`). `audio/stop` appears in the frontend
cleanup allowlist (`api-contract.ts:82`) but no backend handler exists.

(`microphone-input.ts:257-292`).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| Choose microphone | CONFIG-WRITE (browser localStorage only) | — | disabled while locked | `microphone-input.ts:136-147` |
| Refresh devices | READ | `navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices()` | — | `:148-163` |
| Test microphone | READ (operator's local mic; nothing sent) | `getUserMedia` + AnalyserNode (fft 512, 100 ms meter) | secure context; idle session; auto-stop 60 s, on blur/pagehide/hidden/devicechange | `:180-256,79-86,194` |

## Screen: Intercom announcement / TTS (`wiskey-intercom-tts`, `tts-controls.ts`)

**Purpose.** Type a message (or pick a saved quick phrase) and have Home Assistant TTS speak it through the door
station speaker.

**Entry points.** Non-v4 camera dialog: inside audio controls dock (`audio-controls.ts:1065`, `compact`,
`.settings=ttsSettings`). v4 camera dialog: `<aside class="wk4-camera-tts">` with `compact v4`
(`panel.ts:4548-4556`).

**Layout** (`tts-controls.ts:25-282,481-560`). `<form class="tts-panel">`: title with speaker icon; Stop button
while speaking (`tts_stop`); textarea (maxlength 500, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submits) + primary Send (`tts_send`);
quick-phrase buttons (one per saved phrase; click sets message and submits immediately); counter `n/500`;
alerts `tts_engine_unavailable`, `tts_language_unavailable`, `tts_no_engine`; status with pulsing dot
(`tts_connecting`, `tts_generating`, `tts_speaking`, `tts_completed` success style); error alert. ≤640 px stacks.

**Data model** (`tts-controls.ts:7-22`):
```ts
interface TtsEngine { engine_id: string; name: string; supported_languages: string[]; default_language: string | null; }
interface TtsEngines { default: string | null; engines: TtsEngine[]; }
interface TtsEvent { state: "generating" | "speaking" | "completed" | "closed"; reason?: string;
  duration_seconds?: number; bytes_written?: number; }
```
Backend events also carry `format:"hikvision_intercom.tts"`, `packet_count` (speaking), `physical_result:"unverified"`
(completed) (`audio_tts.py:154-161,196-222`). Engine choice: `settings.tts_engine_id` || engines `default` ||
first engine; language: `settings.tts_language` || HA language (`he`→`iw`) if supported || engine default ||
first supported (`tts-controls.ts:354-366`).

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load engines | READ | `hikvision_intercom/tts/engines` `{}` (exact keys) → `TtsEngines` | on connection change; error `tts_engines_failed` | `tts-controls.ts:368-386` |
| Send announcement / quick phrase | PHYSICAL (audio played at the door speaker) + EXTERNAL (message text sent to the HA TTS provider) | subscribe `hikvision_intercom/tts/start` `{station_id, engine_id, language: string|null, message}` (all six keys incl. `id`,`type` required exactly) → events `generating` → `speaking` → `completed` or `closed{reason}` | no confirmation; disabled while speaking, station offline, no/invalid engine or language, empty message; message trimmed ≤500 | `tts-controls.ts:430-479` |
| Stop announcement | PHYSICAL-control (cancels playback; closes device audio session) | unsubscribe of the `tts/start` subscription | Stop button; also on pagehide, hidden tab, `hikvision-call-ending`, station change, removal | `tts-controls.ts:315-352,399-404` |

**Lifecycle.** `completed`/`closed` are terminal; the component unsubscribes on the next microtask
(`tts-controls.ts:406-428`). Error = event `reason` or `(error).code` of the subscribe call, default
`tts_playback_failed`.
