## Screen: Camera playback and announcement options (`hikvision-media-settings`, `media-settings.ts`)

**Purpose.** Management page for the fleet-wide player settings (transport, RTC/MSE, HLS fallback, go2rtc address),
talk mode (PTT/toggle), TTS engine/language and up to 10 quick phrases.

**Entry point.** Panel tab `media_options` (`panel.ts:4749-4757`): `.hass=protectedHass`,
`.settings=_data.media_settings`; `@media-saved` replaces `_data.media_settings` with `e.detail`.

**Layout & visual notes** (`media-settings.ts:211-397`). `<section class="station" max-width 780px>`: title
`media_options`, scope text `media_scope` ("Applies to every WisKey live player and intercom announcement").
Form: Talk mode select (`ptt`/`toggle`) + hint; Transport select (`hls` "HLS" / `webrtc` "WebRTC / go2rtc"); when
`webrtc`: mode select (`rtc`/`mse`) + hint (`media_rtc_hint`/`media_mse_hint`), checkbox "HLS fallback", URL input
`go2rtc_url` (placeholder `http://go2rtc:1984`, `dir=ltr`) + `media_go2rtc_hint`. Fieldset TTS: engine select
("Home Assistant default engine" + engines; unknown saved value shown as `<id> · tts_engine_unavailable`),
language select ("Automatic language" + engine languages), quick phrases list (text inputs maxlength 160 + Remove),
Add phrase (max 10), invalid alert `tts_phrase_invalid`. Buttons: Save (primary; disabled when busy, stale or
invalid phrases), Reload, "Find installed go2rtc add-on" (`media_discover`), "Check saved go2rtc server"
(`media_provider_check`, only when `webrtc`). Notice line `<notice> <bdi>server</bdi>`; error alert. Busy disables
all inputs. If `settings` absent → `media_load_failed` alert.

**Data model.** `MediaPolicy` (`media-settings.ts:7-17`). Save sends `{revision, values: <all other draft fields>}`.
Client validation: ≤10 phrases, each trimmed non-empty ≤160, case-insensitively unique (`:116-124`).

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load engines | READ | `hikvision_intercom/tts/engines` `{}` | on connection change | `media-settings.ts:97-110` |
| Save global settings | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage `hikvision_intercom.media_settings` only; no device write). Side effect: every open WisKey MSE/RTC bridge socket is terminated (`*_session_changed`) because the revision changes | `hikvision_intercom/media/settings_update` `{revision:int, values:{transport, webrtc_mode, fallback_hls, go2rtc_url, talk_mode?, tts_engine_id?, tts_language?, tts_phrases?}}` (+`api_contract:1`) → `MediaPolicy` | no confirmation; 12 s timeout; errors: `revision_conflict`→`media_conflict` (form becomes stale until Reload), `invalid_fields`→`media_invalid`, else `media_save_unknown` (stale) | `media-settings.ts:146-174` |
| Reload saved settings | READ | `hikvision_intercom/media/settings_get` `{}` → `MediaPolicy` | 10 s timeout; clears stale | `media-settings.ts:129-145` |
| Find installed go2rtc add-on | READ (EXTERNAL network probe of two fixed add-on hostnames from HA); permission is management:manage | `hikvision_intercom/media/provider_discover` `{}` → `{url, version}`; result only placed in the draft | 12 s timeout; notice `media_discovered` | `media-settings.ts:192-210` |
| Check saved go2rtc server | READ (EXTERNAL `GET <go2rtc>/api`) | `hikvision_intercom/media/provider_check` `{}` → `{available:true, source:"explicit"|"home_assistant", server:<url>|"Home Assistant", version}` | 10 s timeout; notice `media_provider_ready`; checks the SAVED setting, not the draft | `media-settings.ts:175-191` |
| Edit draft fields / phrases | none (UI) | — | — | `media-settings.ts:111-128` |

## Screen fragment: Door release buttons (in `panel.ts`, no custom element)

**Purpose.** Momentary release ("open door") of one managed relay of a station, from overview cards, walls, the v4 /
access overviews and the camera dialog.

**Entry points.** `releaseButton(station, primary, compact)` (`panel.ts:2007-2012`) renders one `relayButton` per
`station.integrated_locks[]` (`panel.ts:2013-2023`); only for users who can manage `overview` or `stations`. Used at
`panel.ts:2386` (overview wall), `2445` (v4 overview), `2487` (access overview), `2586` (station cards), `4523`
(camera dialog dock), `4632` (dialog footer, non-camera dialogs). Feedback `releaseFeedback()` (`panel.ts:2024-2044`).

**Layout.** Button with lock icon; label `releasing` while pending, `wall_open` in compact mode with one lock, else
`unlockLabel(station, physical)`; `aria-busy`. Disabled when HA disconnected, station offline, `!lock_enabled`, or
releasing (pending local state OR the HA lock entity state `unlocking`) (`panel.ts:1999-2006,2018`). Feedback box:
`last_release_request · <time>` + message `release_sent` or error code; danger style on error.

| Action | Classification | Command(s)/endpoint | Confirmation/guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Release door relay N | PHYSICAL (door relay release at the station) | `hikvision_intercom/stations/test_unlock` `{station_id, lock: <physical_index int>}` (+`api_contract:1`) → `{"accepted": true}` | **no confirmation dialog**; single click; synchronous per `${station}/${physical}` pending record rejects double clicks; client timeout 30 s; overview refresh afterwards | `panel.ts:2045-2088`, timeout `panel.ts:703-710` |

Error codes displayed (`releaseErrors`, `panel.ts:123-133`): `release_in_progress`, `release_unconfirmed`,
`connection_closed`, `lock_not_managed`, `station_offline`, `device_unavailable`, `rate_limited`, `unauthorized`,
`invalid_fields`; any other → `release_unconfirmed`.

# Backend modules

## Module: `camera.py`
**Responsibility.** HA `camera` platform entity per station. Created only if `profile.snapshot or profile.stream`
(`camera.py:17-18`). `supported_features = STREAM` when `profile.stream` (`:25-26`).
- `async_camera_image` → `client.async_snapshot()` or `None` (`:28-36`) → ISAPI `GET /ISAPI/Streaming/channels/101/picture`.
- `stream_source()` → `rtsp_source()` (credentials embedded) if stream supported (`:38-39`); consumed by HA core
  stream/HLS and HA WebRTC providers.
- unique_id `{entry.unique_id}_camera`, translation_key `camera` (via `entity.py`). No extra attributes.
- Classification: READ.

## Module: `mse_api.py`
**Responsibility.** Admin/permitted-user, same-origin binary MSE bridge from browser to go2rtc; source URL and
credentials never leave HA.

| Endpoint | Input | Output | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/hikvision_intercom/mse/{station_id}` (WebSocket upgrade; `requires_auth=True`, browser uses `auth/sign_path` 30 s) | first client text message within 10 s: exactly `{"codecs": [..]}` non-empty, ≤8 items, each in `CODECS` (`avc1.640029, avc1.64002A, avc1.640033, hvc1.1.6.L153.B0, mp4a.40.2, mp4a.40.5, flac, opus`); any later client message → `mse_protocol_error` | text `{"type":"mse","value":"video/mp4; codecs=\"...\""}` (MIME regex), then binary fMP4 frames (≤4 MiB); on failure text `{"type":"error","code":<code>}` then close | READ (EXTERNAL: go2rtc RTSP pull) | `overview:view` OR `stations:view`, re-checked every 0.5 s | `mse_api.py:39-190` |

**Protocol details.** HTTP errors before upgrade: 403 (permission), 404 (unknown/closed runtime or no stream), 429
(≥9 active MSE sockets), 409 (policy not `webrtc`+`mse`) (`mse_api.py:53-66`). Client WS `max_msg_size=1024`
(`mse_api.py:70`). Upstream: `ws_connect(<go2rtc>/api/ws?src=<rtsp>)`, 10 s connect, `max_msg_size=4 MiB`; sends
`{"type":"mse","value":"<comma-joined codecs>"}` (`mse_api.py:87-95`). Forward loop: each upstream read 12 s timeout; one
text negotiation only; each downstream binary write 3 s timeout (`mse_api.py:97-123`). `watch_owner` ends the session
(`mse_session_changed`) when permission is lost, runtime closed/replaced, or media settings revision changes
(`mse_api.py:130-159`). Error codes: `mse_protocol_error`, `mse_codec_unavailable`, `mse_connection_lost`,
`mse_session_changed`, `mse_provider_unavailable` (provider missing). Remote error text never forwarded
(`mse_api.py:171-178`). HA stop closes all sockets (`mse_api.py:192-201`).

## Module: `rtc_api.py`
**Responsibility.** Authenticated go2rtc WebRTC signaling bridge (view only; recvonly).

| Endpoint | Input | Output | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/hikvision_intercom/rtc/{station_id}` (WebSocket; `requires_auth=True`) | first message within 10 s: exactly `{"offer": "<sdp>"}` validated by `valid_offer` (starts `v=0`, ≤262144, every m-section audio/video with `a=recvonly`, no `sendrecv`/`sendonly`); then `{"type":"ping"}` or `{"candidate":"candidate:..."}` (≤4096, ≤100 candidates); client idle limit 35 s | `{"type":"answer","answer":<sdp>}`, `{"type":"candidate","candidate":{"candidate":<line>,"sdpMid":"0"}}`, `{"type":"pong"}`, `{"type":"error","code":<code>}` | READ (EXTERNAL: go2rtc RTSP pull, WebRTC media from go2rtc to browser) | `overview:view` OR `stations:view`, re-checked every 0.5 s | `rtc_api.py:23-205` |

**Protocol details.** HTTP 403/404/429 (≥9)/409 (policy not `webrtc`+`rtc`) (`:50-63`). Upstream
`ws_connect(<go2rtc>/api/ws?src=<rtsp>)`; sends `{"type":"webrtc/offer","value":<sdp>}`; accepts
`webrtc/answer` (once) and `webrtc/candidate` (≤4096) up to 256 messages; 15 s timeout until answered, unlimited
after (`:84-118`). Client candidates forwarded as `{"type":"webrtc/candidate","value":...}` (`:141-143`).
Error codes: `rtc_protocol_error`, `rtc_connection_lost`, `rtc_signaling_failed`, `rtc_session_changed`,
`mse_provider_unavailable`. Microphone transmission is explicitly excluded ("Only viewing is authorized here").

## Module: `media_api.py` and `media_settings.py`
**Responsibility.** Global fleet-wide playback/talk/TTS preferences (atomic, revisioned) and go2rtc reachability.

| Command | Input | Output | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hikvision_intercom/media/settings_get` | `{}` (read; `api_contract` optional) | `{revision:int, transport, webrtc_mode, fallback_hls, go2rtc_url, talk_mode, tts_engine_id, tts_language, tts_phrases}` | READ | management:view | `media_api.py:40-41`, `media_settings.py:116-117`, `websocket.py:138` |
| `hikvision_intercom/media/settings_update` | `{revision:int, values:dict}` + `api_contract:1` | same as settings_get | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage only) | management:manage | `media_api.py:42-43`, `media_settings.py:119-139`, `websocket.py:139` |
| `hikvision_intercom/media/provider_check` | `{}` + `api_contract:1` | `{available:true, source:"explicit"|"home_assistant", server:<go2rtc_url>|"Home Assistant", version}` | READ (EXTERNAL GET `/api` on go2rtc) | management:view | `media_api.py:54-66`, `websocket.py:140` |
| `hikvision_intercom/media/provider_discover` | `{}` + `api_contract:1` | `{url:"http://a889bffc-go2rtc-hardware:1984"|"http://a889bffc-go2rtc:1984", version}` | READ (EXTERNAL probes; nothing saved) | management:manage | `media_api.py:44-53`, `websocket.py:141` |

**Validation** (`media_settings.py:27-87`): `values` must contain all CORE_FIELDS (`transport`, `webrtc_mode`,
`fallback_hls`, `go2rtc_url`) and only known keys; `transport ∈ {hls,webrtc}`, `webrtc_mode ∈ {rtc,mse}`,
`talk_mode ∈ {ptt,toggle}`, `fallback_hls` bool; `tts_engine_id` "" or `tts\.[a-z0-9_]{1,200}`; `tts_language` ""
or `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}`; `tts_phrases` ≤10, no control chars, trimmed non-empty ≤160, casefold-unique;
`go2rtc_url` ≤512, no chars <33, http/https, host required, no userinfo/query/fragment, path "" or "/", no
backslash, port ≠0; stored with trailing "/" stripped. Missing non-core keys are merged from current values so
an older panel cannot erase them (`:119-131`). Revision mismatch → `revision_conflict`; no-op saves don't bump
revision (`:132-139`).
**Persistence.** HA Store key `hikvision_intercom.media_settings` via `AccessStore`
(`access_runtime.py:81-90`), shape `{"schema":1, "revision":int, "values":{...}}`; corrupt → repair issue
`media_settings_storage_corrupt` and `hass.data[DOMAIN]["media_settings"]=None` (then commands raise
`media_settings_unavailable`, overview `media_settings:null`). Load errors `invalid_storage`.
**Errors.** `invalid_fields`, `revision_conflict`, `media_settings_unavailable`, `mse_provider_unavailable`,
`mse_provider_failed`, `api_incompatible`, `unauthorized`.

## Module: `audio_api.py` (+ `client/audio.py`)
**Responsibility.** Connection-owned operator two-way audio bridge between the browser and the station's ISAPI
TwoWayAudio channel; no recording.

| Command | Input (exact keys) | Output / events | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hikvision_intercom/audio/start` (subscription) | `{id, type, station_id:str≤128}` | result `null`; events `{"format":"hikvision_intercom.audio","state":"ready","token":<32 hex>,"sample_rate":8000,"packet_bytes":800,"max_seconds":180}`; `{"format":...,"state":"closed","reason":<code>,"close_confirmed":bool|null}` | PHYSICAL (opens device audio session; captures door mic — privacy; writes silence to door speaker) | overview:manage OR stations:manage | `audio_api.py:181-219,81-178` |
| `hikvision_intercom/audio/send` | `{id, type, token, sequence:int, data:str}`; `data` = base64 of exactly 800 bytes (string length 1068); `sequence` must equal the server counter | `{"sequence": n+1}` | PHYSICAL (door speaker) | same | `audio_api.py:234-282` |
| `hikvision_intercom/audio/receive` | `{id, type, token}`; one in flight per session | `{"format":"hikvision_intercom.audio","data":<base64 800 B μ-law or "">}` ("" after 2 s without packet) | PHYSICAL-listen (door mic; privacy) | same | `audio_api.py:253-266`, `client/audio.py:310-323` |
| `hikvision_intercom/audio/mute` | `{id, type, token}` | `{}` | PHYSICAL-control (drops queued speech; next 20 ms frame is silence) | same | `audio_api.py:295-297`, `client/audio.py:325-329` |
| `hikvision_intercom/audio/diagnostics` | `{id, type, token}` | `{microphone_packets_accepted, microphone_bytes_written, microphone_signal_bytes_written, total_bytes_written, received_bytes, received_signal_bytes, dropped_receive_packets, upload_http_status, physical_result:"unverified"}` | READ | same | `audio_api.py:283-294` |
| (stop) unsubscribe of `audio/start` | HA `unsubscribe_events` | if not yet running: event `closed` `reason:"audio_stopped"`, `close_confirmed:null`; else task cancel → session close → `closed` event only if subscription still registered | PHYSICAL-control (device `PUT .../close`) | — | `audio_api.py:58-79,130-178` |

**Protocol details.**
- Codec: G.711 μ-law, 8 kHz mono; browser packet 800 bytes = 100 ms; device frame 160 bytes = 20 ms; silence
  byte `0xFF` (`client/audio.py:27-34`). Base64 in both directions.
- Token binding: `uuid4().hex` (32 chars), valid only for the same HA WS connection and while the subscription
  exists, the user is still authorized, and the config entry runtime is unchanged (`audio_api.py:47-56,222-231`).
- Limits: `MAX_SECONDS=180` → `audio_expired`; `IDLE_SECONDS=12` since the last send/receive/mute/diagnostics
  → `audio_idle_timeout` (`audio_api.py:21-22,109-120,298`). Concurrency (`audio_api.py:204-214`): one session
  per station across operator audio AND TTS; max 3 sessions total (audio+TTS); one per HA WS connection;
  violations → `audio_busy`.
- Backpressure: `send` token bucket 10 packets/s, burst 2; outgoing queue 3 → `audio_backpressure`
  (`client/audio.py:297-308`); concurrent `receive` → `audio_backpressure` (`audio_api.py:254-255`); incoming queue
  3, packets older than 0.3 s dropped; outgoing packets older than 0.25 s dropped (`client/audio.py:101-102,262-277,310-321`).
- Session close reasons: `audio_stopped`, `audio_expired`, `audio_idle_timeout`, `audio_connection_lost`, or an
  AudioError code. Last result stored in `hass.data[DOMAIN]["audio_results"][station_id]` (reported by `health/get`)
  (`audio_api.py:140-164`).
**Device interaction (ISAPI, `client/audio.py`).** Channel `/ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels/1`.
`start()` (`:123-146`, 20 s budget): confirm identity (`GET /ISAPI/System/deviceInfo` serial must equal entry
unique_id; `audio_identity_required` if no expected identity); `GET <channel>` and `GET <channel>/capabilities`
validated (`validate_channel`, `:45-67`: id "1", `G.711ulaw` in options and configured, 8 kHz, 64 kbps, line out
and mic not forbidden; no PUT to configuration); `PUT <channel>/open` → `TwoWayAudioSession.sessionId`
(`[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}` else `audio_open_unconfirmed`, not retried). Upload: Digest challenge via empty PUT
(must be 401 else `audio_auth_failed`), then a raw TCP/TLS socket with a persistent unframed
`PUT <channel>/audioData?sessionId=...` (no Content-Length, no chunking), 1600-byte buffers (`:148-204`); the
device answers `HTTP 200` and keeps it open (`:217-231`). Receive: `GET <channel>/audioData?sessionId=...`
streamed, content-type `application/octet-stream` or firmware's `application/octem-strem`, 800-byte packets,
5 s watchdog (`:233-260`). Transmit: every 20 ms writes a 160-byte frame (microphone data or silence), 0.5 s write
timeout (`:262-295`). `close()` (`:331-366`): abort socket (queued speech dropped), confirm identity, `PUT
<channel>/close?sessionId=...` (5 s), `close_confirmed` = statusCode 0/1. No call or door command is ever sent by
the audio module (`client/audio.py:3`).
**Errors.** `unauthorized`, `invalid_fields`, `station_unloaded`, `audio_busy`, `audio_not_started`,
`audio_invalid_packet`, `audio_backpressure`, `audio_connection_lost`, `audio_unsupported`,
`audio_identity_required`, `audio_open_unconfirmed`, `audio_auth_failed`.

## Module: `audio_tts.py` (+ `client/tts_audio.py`)
**Responsibility.** HA TTS synthesis transcoded to μ-law and played through the same ISAPI talk channel.

| Command | Input (exact keys) | Output / events | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hikvision_intercom/tts/engines` | `{id, type}` | `{default: str|null, engines:[{engine_id, name, supported_languages:[...sorted], default_language:str|null}]}` (default engine first, then by name) | READ | overview:manage OR stations:manage | `audio_tts.py:256-269,59-89` |
| `hikvision_intercom/tts/start` (subscription) | `{id, type, station_id:1..128, engine_id:1..128 (must be listed), language:str≤64|null, message:str}`; message whitespace-collapsed, 1..500 chars | result `null`; events (all with `"format":"hikvision_intercom.tts"`): `{state:"generating"}`, `{state:"speaking", duration_seconds, packet_count}`, `{state:"completed", duration_seconds, bytes_written, physical_result:"unverified"}` or `{state:"closed", reason}` | PHYSICAL (door speaker) + EXTERNAL (text to TTS provider) | overview:manage OR stations:manage | `audio_tts.py:272-333,176-253` |
| (stop) unsubscribe of `tts/start` | HA `unsubscribe_events` | playback cancelled; no event after unsubscribe | PHYSICAL-control | — | `audio_tts.py:163-174` |

**Protocol details.** Synthesis: `tts.generate_media_source_id(hass, message, engine, language,
options={"preferred_format":"wav","preferred_sample_rate":8000,"preferred_sample_channels":1,
"preferred_sample_bytes":2}, cache=False)` then `tts.async_get_media_source_audio` with 30 s timeout
(`audio_tts.py:92-123`). WAV must be mono 8000 Hz 16-bit PCM; ≤60 s (streaming 0xffffffff length tolerated);
μ-law encoded and split into 800-byte packets padded with 0xFF (`client/tts_audio.py:39-78`). Playback: open
`AudioSession`, send one packet per 0.1 s, wait 0.15 s, emit `completed` (`audio_tts.py:187-222`). States:
generating → speaking → completed | closed. Close reasons: `tts_cancelled`, `tts_generation_timeout`,
`tts_generation_failed`, `tts_audio_format`, `tts_audio_too_long`, `tts_playback_failed`, any `audio_*` code.
Concurrency shared with operator audio (`MAX_CONCURRENT_AUDIO = 3`, one per station, one per connection →
`audio_busy`) (`audio_tts.py:310-320`). Start errors: `unauthorized`, `tts_invalid_message`, `invalid_fields`,
`tts_engine_unavailable`, `station_unloaded`, `audio_busy`.
**Engines source.** `hass.states.async_entity_ids("tts")` plus `tts.async_default_engine(hass)`; languages via
`tts.helper.get_engine_instance` (`audio_tts.py:59-89`). No persistence.

## Module: `health_api.py` (media/call and media/signal in depth; rest summarized)
**Responsibility.** Dispatch for `health/*`, `acceptance/*` and all `media/*` commands that are not media settings
(`websocket.py:497-507`). First resolves `manager._station(station_id)` and the config entry (`health_api.py:20-27`).

| Command | Input | Output | Classification | Permission | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hikvision_intercom/media/call` | `{station_id:str}` + `api_contract:1` (not in READ_COMMANDS) | `{call_commands:[subset of "answer","reject","hangUp"], state:"idle"|"ringing"|"in_call"|"unknown", checked_at:ISO, last_result: CallResult|null, busy: bool}` | READ (device: deviceInfo, callSignal capabilities, callStatus) | overview:view OR stations:view | `health_api.py:35-51`, `client/media.py:116-126` |
| `hikvision_intercom/media/signal` | `{station_id:str, command:str ∈ answer|reject|hangUp}` + `api_contract:1` | `{command, acknowledged: true|null, physical_result:"unverified", before_state, observed_state, observation:"state_changed"|"unchanged"|"unavailable", checked_at}` | PHYSICAL (call signalling at the door) | overview:manage OR stations:manage | `health_api.py:52-81`, `client/media.py:128-190` |

**media/call details.** Per-station single read and max 3 concurrent reads (`device_busy`) (`health_api.py:38-41`);
15 s budget: confirm identity, `GET /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal/capabilities?format=json` (commands from
`CallSignal.cmdType.@opt`), `GET /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callStatus?format=json` (`client/media.py:116-126`).
`last_result` = cached last signal result for the same runtime; `busy` = a signal in progress for the station.
**media/signal details.** Per-station single command (`device_busy`) (`health_api.py:55-58`). For `reject`/`hangUp`
the station's operator-audio and TTS sessions are cancelled and awaited first (`:60-66`). Device sequence
(`client/media.py:128-158`): 15 s budget — confirm identity; command must be advertised
(`HikvisionUnsupportedError` → `device_unavailable`); current state must be `ringing` for answer/reject or
`in_call` for hangUp (`HikvisionValidationError` → `device_unavailable`); then exactly one
`PUT /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal?format=json` body `{"CallSignal":{"cmdType":"<command>"}}`
(`application/json`, 10 s); every `statusCode` must be "1" else error; connection loss/timeout → `acknowledged:null`
(no retry). Observation (`:160-190`): up to 3 `callStatus` reads 0.5 s apart within 5 s. Result cached in
`hass.data[DOMAIN]["call_results"][station]`; running task in `call_operations` (cancelled on unload).
**Errors.** `station_unloaded`, `device_busy`, `device_unavailable` (any HikvisionError), `unauthorized`,
`invalid_fields`, `api_incompatible`, station lookup errors from the access manager.
**Rest (brief).** `health/refresh` (≤3 concurrent, 35 s): clock refresh + `MediaClient.inspect()` (call commands,
`/ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels` list, capabilities) cached as `media_evidence`; `health/get` and
`health/refresh` return config-entry diagnostics + `clock` subset + `media` evidence + `audio: {active, source:
"tts"|"operator"|null, last_result}` + `format:"hikvision_intercom.compatibility"`, `integration_version`,
`evidence_scope:"software_observation_not_physical_acceptance"` (`health_api.py:82-148`). `acceptance/get|update`
delegate to `Acceptance`.

## Module: `client/media.py`
Read-only media evidence and explicit call signals: `call_commands()` (`:26-30`), `audio_channels()` (`:33-55`,
codecs allowlist `G.711ulaw, G.711alaw, G.726, AAC, MP2L2, PCM`), `MediaClient.inspect()` (`:64-114`, 25 s,
per-channel capability fallback), `call_context()` (`:116-126`), `signal()` (`:128-158`), `_observe()` (`:160-190`).
All use a separate `HikvisionClient` sharing the session and expected identity (`:59-62`). ISAPI endpoints:
`/ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal/capabilities?format=json`, `/ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal?format=json` (PUT),
`/ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callStatus?format=json`, `/ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels`,
`/ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels/capabilities`, `/ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels/{n}/capabilities`,
`/ISAPI/System/deviceInfo`.

## Module: `runtime.py` (door release runtime, services, lifecycle) + release path in `client/client.py`
**Responsibility.** Per-station runtime (`IntercomRuntime`, `runtime.py:47-65`): client, httpx session,
coordinator, profile, managed locks, `pulse_seconds`, access manager, events, clock, relay state sets
(`unlocking_relays`, `released_relays`, `relay_timers`).

**Release path.** WS `stations/test_unlock` (`websocket.py:907-934`): entry must exist with runtime and
`coordinator.last_update_success` else `station_offline`; calls `runtime.async_unlock(msg["lock"])`; returns
`{"accepted": true}` (`websocket.py:986`). Error mapping: HomeAssistantError translation keys `release_in_progress`,
`release_unconfirmed`, `connection_closed`, `lock_not_managed` → same code; others → `action_failed`.
`IntercomRuntime.async_unlock(physical_index)` (`runtime.py:72-121`): closed → `connection_closed`; not managed or
non-int → `lock_not_managed`; already unlocking → `release_in_progress`; marks unlocking and updates listeners
(lock entity shows `unlocking`); calls `client.async_unlock(selected.api_id)`; HikvisionError →
`release_unconfirmed`; runtime closed after success → `release_unconfirmed`; success → relay added to
`released_relays` and a timer of `pulse_seconds` (default 5.0, option `pulse_seconds` range 1-30,
`configuration.py:51-62`) clears it (`_finish_relay`, `:123-129`). The timer only drives the displayed optimistic
lock state ("displayed return is a timer, not a physical door sensor", `lock.py:1`).
`HikvisionClient.async_unlock(door_id)` (`client/client.py:349-372`): `door_id` must be in `enabled_doors`
(API ids of managed locks); serialized by `_write_lock`; per-door 1 s debounce → `HikvisionBusyError`;
`async_confirm_identity()` (`:342-347`, `GET /ISAPI/System/deviceInfo`, serial/MAC identity must equal entry
unique_id); single `PUT /ISAPI/AccessControl/RemoteControl/door/{door_id}` with body
`<RemoteControlDoor version="2.0" xmlns="http://www.isapi.org/ver20/XMLSchema"><cmd>open</cmd></RemoteControlDoor>`
(`application/xml`, 10 s); every `statusCode` must be "1" else `HikvisionDeviceError`. No retry anywhere
("never retry physical writes", `client/client.py:131`). The physical relay open duration is not sent; it is
whatever the device is configured with. `_request` maps HTTP 401/403 → auth error, 404/405/501 → unsupported,
429/503 → busy (`client/client.py:173-227`).
Door id discovery (`client/client.py:295-308`): `GET /ISAPI/AccessControl/RemoteControl/door/capabilities`;
doors = `doorNo.@min..@max` within 1..2 if `cmd.@opt` contains `open`. Physical index ↔ API id map from config
(`runtime.py:192-198`).

**Lifecycle.** `async_close()` (`runtime.py:131-164`): cancels relay timers, cancels and awaits the station's
audio/TTS sessions and running call signal, drops cached call/audio results and media evidence, closes clock,
events, access attachment, coordinator, session. Setup (`runtime.py:174-290`) verifies identity and relay mapping
(repair issues `identity`, `relay_mapping`), records `capability_baseline` `{snapshot, stream, call_states}` in entry
data (CONFIG-WRITE to HA config entry, first run only) and raises `capability_regression` issue on loss.

**HA services registered.**
| Service | Fields | Behaviour | Classification | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hikvision_intercom.unlock_door` (admin-only service) | target: lock entities of the integration (`services.yaml:1-5`) → config entry ids; `lock`: `1`/`2` (int or string, default 1) | validates all targets first (`target_required`, `invalid_target`, `target_unloaded`, `target_lock_not_managed`), then `runtime.async_unlock(lock)` sequentially per entry | PHYSICAL | `runtime.py:300-349`, `services.yaml:1-14` |
| `sync_user` / `sync_station` / `sync_all` / `rescan_station` | per `services.yaml:16-36` | registered in `access_runtime.py` (handler `:286-290`), outside this part | (see access part) | `services.yaml:16-36` |

## Module: `coordinator.py`
Polls `GET /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callStatus?format=json` (`client/client.py:258-271`) per station. Intervals: idle
default 2.0 s (option `idle_interval` 1.5-30), active default 0.75 s (option `active_interval` 0.5-1) while
`ringing|in_call|ending`; per-entry jitter `sha256(entry_id)[0]/2550` s; failure backoff
`min(60, idle*2^failures)` (failures ≤6); auth failure → `ConfigEntryAuthFailed` (`coordinator.py:21-63`,
`configuration.py:51-62`). Tracks `last_seen`, `last_poll_ms`. `normalize_call_state` maps `idle→idle`,
`ring→ringing`, `onCall→in_call`, anything else → `unknown`; raw value kept (redacted to `REDACTED` if it contains
the device username/password) (`client/client.py:99-113,258-271`).

Common (`entity.py:11-25`): `has_entity_name`, `unique_id = f"{entry.unique_id}_{key}"`, `translation_key = key`,
device `identifiers={("hikvision_intercom", entry.unique_id or entry.entry_id)}`, `name=entry.title`,
`manufacturer="Hikvision"`, `model`, `sw_version=firmware`. `entry.unique_id` is the device serial number or
`mac_<12 hex>` (`client/client.py:241-252`) — a private identifier embedded in every unique_id. Platforms:
`binary_sensor, sensor, camera, lock, event` (`const.py:5`).

## Module: `frontend/audio-worklet.js` (compiled)
Single-line compiled output of `frontend/src/audio-worklet.ts` + `encodeMuLaw` from `audio-codec.ts`: registers
AudioWorkletProcessor `hikvision-microphone` that returns false unless `sampleRate === 8000`, μ-law-encodes channel 0
and posts each full 800-byte `Uint8Array` (transferred). Loaded by `audio-controls.ts:653-658` with the panel's
query string. Source: `audio-worklet.ts:9-27` (file lines), codec `audio-codec.ts:2-15`.

## Open questions

1. go2rtc stream naming: WisKey passes the full RTSP URL (with credentials) as `src` to `<go2rtc>/api/ws`. The code
   comment says go2rtc "GetOrPatch" does not persist configuration; whether go2rtc keeps an in-memory stream named by
   that URL (visible in go2rtc `/api/streams` of the shared lab server that also hosts the intercom project) is not
   determinable from this repo and must be verified on the lab host. WisKey uses no stream-name namespace.
2. With `go2rtc_url` empty and RTC mode, HA core's WebRTC provider (e.g. HA go2rtc integration) registers streams;
   the names it uses are HA-core behaviour, not in this repo.
3. `audio/stop` is in the frontend cleanup allowlist (`api-contract.ts:82`) but has no backend handler; stopping is
   by unsubscribing. Dead entry or planned command — unknown.
4. `call_status` sensor lists option `ending`, and the coordinator switches to the active interval on `ending`, but
   `normalize_call_state` never produces `ending` (`client/client.py:107-113`).
5. `media/call` needs only view permission, but the panel renders call controls only for manage-level users
   (`panel.ts:2095`). Intended for a view-only surface elsewhere? Not found.
6. The physical relay open time is not set by WisKey (`pulse_seconds` only drives the optimistic lock state); the
   actual door-open duration depends on device configuration (not read in these files). Hold-open
   (`hold-open.ts`, technical API) is outside this part.
7. Opening an ISAPI two-way audio session writes continuous silence frames to the door speaker channel and streams
   the door microphone; whether the station shows any visible/audible indicator is not stated in code
   (`physical_result`/`physical_audibility` always "unverified").
8. When the camera stream carries audio, "Start listening" uses the video stream audio (no device session); the
   ISAPI session is opened only while talking, but the backend still starts its device receive task for that
   session (`client/audio.py:142-146`).
9. `rtc_api.py` raises code `mse_provider_unavailable` when no go2rtc provider exists; the frontend
   `AddonSignaling` does not forward server error codes (any error → generic `signaling_failed`).
10. The MSE/RTC 9-socket caps are per view and global across all users; interaction with the camera wall budget (9)
    when several operators watch simultaneously is not handled beyond HTTP 429.
11. `tts/start` sends the message text to whichever HA TTS engine is selected; if that engine is a cloud provider,
    the text leaves the premises (EXTERNAL). No provider allowlist exists.
12. `provider_discover` hard-codes the add-on slug prefix `a889bffc`; other go2rtc installs are not discovered.

# Part D1 — People, credentials, groups/profiles, identity lifecycle, bulk & CSV

Source: WisKey (`hikvision_intercom`) reference repo, read-only extraction. All paths are relative to
the repo root `R`. Frontend = `R/frontend/src/`, backend = `R/custom_components/hikvision_intercom/`
(abbreviated `B/`). Line numbers refer to the file as checked out.

Conventions used below:
- WS type string is always `hikvision_intercom/<command>`; the tables list `<command>`.
- Every WS command also accepts the envelope fields `id` (int), `type` (str) and optional `api_contract`
  (int). Commands not in `B/api_contract.py:34-84` `READ_COMMANDS` must send `api_contract: 1`
  (`validate_client`, `B/api_contract.py:87-91`), otherwise error `api_incompatible`. The panel adds
  `api_contract: 1` automatically to every command that is in the server's `api.commands` list
  (`frontend/src/api-contract.ts:83-123`, `contractHass`).
- Request size limit 65,536 bytes of JSON, except `users/csv_preview`, `users/csv_apply`,
  `users/csv_inspect` = 1,048,576 bytes (`B/websocket.py:1040-1046`) → `request_too_large`.
- Errors: `AccessError` codes are sent as the WS error `code` (generic message, translation placeholder
  `reason=<code>`); `vol.Invalid` → `invalid_fields`; any `HikvisionError` → `device_unavailable`;
  anything else → `action_failed` (`B/websocket.py:1053-1070`). Per-HA-user admin rate limiter
  (`AdminLimiter`, `B/websocket.py:1047-1052`). Authorization is checked before field validation
  (`B/websocket.py:1022-1033`) → `unauthorized`.
- Permission area/level = `B/panel_permissions.py:289-314` (`requirements`). HA administrators pass
  everything (`command_allowed`, `:329-339`).
- Classification labels: READ / CONFIG-WRITE / PHYSICAL (see task brief). "Device push" = the change is
  written to intercoms by the reconciliation worker (`AccessManager.request()` → `_worker` →
  `SyncEngine.async_reconcile`, `B/access/manager.py:149-162, 251-333`).
  - "immediate queue" = the handler calls `request()`/`request_user()` right away; the worker starts at
    once (asynchronously; the WS response does not wait for device writes).
  - "periodic" = the change is persisted only; the worker picks it up on its next periodic run (default
    re-run delay 300 s after the previous run, shorter when timing renewals are due,
    `B/access/manager.py:316-333`).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Screen: User details / person card (`wiskey-user-details`, `frontend/src/user-details.ts`)

### Purpose
Read-only "person card" for one managed user: identity, status, custom profile fields, groups, PIN
configured flag, masked cards, validity and timing-policy summary, enabled door grants with a
synced/pending badge, portrait. Also hosts the WhatsApp "send access details" composer and the stored
WhatsApp conversation viewer. Footer "Edit" hands off to the main person editor (panel.ts, other part).

### Entry point
Custom element defined at `user-details.ts:921`. Embedded twice in `panel.ts`:
1. Inline, in the Users tab "people workspace" (right-hand details pane), `panel.ts:3077` →
   `accessPersonDetails()` `panel.ts:3236-3247`: attribute `embedded`,
   `.canEdit=${this.canManage("users")}`, `.hass=${this.protectedHass}`, `.person`,
   `.stations=${_data.stations}`, `.policy=${_data.profile_settings}`; events `@details-close` (clears
   `_detailsUser`), `@details-edit` → `this.edit(person)`.
2. Modal dialog, `panel.ts:4825-4840`, rendered when `_detailsModalUser` is set (set by
   `openPersonDetails()` `panel.ts:3205-3213`, called from list rows `3106/3143/3278/3683` and from the
   identity-lifecycle screen's `open-user` event). Props: `.v4=${isWiskeyAppearance(...)}`, `.canEdit`,
   `.hass`, `.person=${detailPerson(...)}` (the `users/get` record, cached 60 s, max 100 entries,
   `panel.ts:3217-3235`), `.stations`, `.policy`.
`protectedHass` is a Proxy that reports `user.is_admin = true` once the server contract is loaded and
injects `api_contract` (`api-contract.ts:83-123`); so the component's own `is_admin` checks do not
restrict non-admin panel users — the server permission check does.

### Layout & visual notes
- Native `<dialog>`; modal (`showModal()`) unless `embedded` (then `role="region"`, static, close button
  hidden) (`:595-627, :721-727`). `dir=rtl` when HA language starts with `he`.
- Header: portrait (`<img>` from `users/photo_get` if `person.photo_configured`, else first letter of
  the name in a circle), name `<h2>`, phone formatted by `mobileDisplay` (LTR `<bdi>`), close ✕.
- Nav tabs: "User details" | "WhatsApp conversation" (disabled unless WhatsApp available, an account is
  selected, the person has a phone, history supported, not busy) (`:736-746`).
- Details tab (`:750-827`): two-column `.person-grid` (v4: 0.9fr/1.1fr; single column ≤700 px).
  `<dl>` rows: Employee ID; Status (active/inactive); each **enabled** custom profile field
  (`policy.fields.filter(enabled)`, value or "—"); Groups (labels of `policy.groups` whose id is in
  `person.group_ids`); PIN ("configured"/"not configured"); Cards (`masked_number || label`, comma
  list); Validity (`valid_from → valid_until`, raw ISO strings) plus, when `access_timing_policy` is
  set, a line `timezone · days+dates` (weekday names translated) and a line of periods `start–end`.
  Notice "A draft schedule exists; it is not enforced." when `access_timing_draft` is set and
  `access_timing_policy` is null (`:808`).
  Grants list (`.rights`): one item per assignment with `enabled === true`: `"<station name or id> ·
  <allowed_locks joined>"` and a badge "synced" if `sync_state === "synced"` else "pending"
  (`:811-825`). Disabled assignments and override sources are not shown.
- WhatsApp block (`:849-904`): account `<select>` (only if accounts exist; auto-selected when exactly
  one), hints "Add a mobile number in Edit to use WhatsApp." / "Configure and connect the WhatsApp
  integration in Home Assistant.", green button "Send access details via WhatsApp" (disabled unless ready
  and `canEdit`). After preview: compose section with recipient, notice "Nothing is sent until you
  confirm. Check the recipient and access details.", editable `<textarea maxlength=12000>` prefilled with
  the server message, buttons "Confirm and send" / "Cancel".
- Chat tab (`:828-847`): hint (≤200 stored messages), Refresh, `.chat` log (bubbles; outgoing shown
  green), quotes, captions, per-message attachment loader (image/video/audio inline, else download link
  via blob URL).
- Status lines: busy "wait", sent "The WhatsApp integration accepted the send. Delivery is not verified
  here.", errors translated from the error code.
- Footer: "Edit" (disabled unless `canEdit`) → dispatches `details-edit`, closes if modal.
- Responsive: ≤600 px single column, full-width buttons; embedded variant compact paddings; v4
  appearance widens the dialog to 1160 px.

### Data model
- Input `person: Person` — `frontend/src/types.ts:28-62` (see "Public projection" under Module
  `access/models.py`). Used fields: `id, display_name, phone, employee_no, active, profile, group_ids,
  pin_configured, cards[{masked_number,label,...}], valid_from, valid_until,
  access_timing_policy{mode, schedule{mode,timezone,days,dates,periods}, bindings},
  access_timing_draft, assignments{sid:{enabled, allowed_locks, sync_state,...}}, photo_configured,
  revision`.
- `policy: ProfilePolicy` — `profile-settings.ts:25-31`.
- Local interfaces `Message {quote?, id, outgoing, timestamp, text, caption, kind, filename,
  media_token}`, `Preview {token, recipient, message}`, `Status {available, history,
  accounts[{id,name}]}` — `user-details.ts:10-30`.

### User actions
| Action | Classification | Command(s) (exact + fields) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open card (load) | READ | `whatsapp/status` {} → `{available, history, accounts}`; if `photo_configured`: `users/photo_get` {`user_id`} → `{photo: string\|null}` | none; reloads when `person.id` or `person.revision` changes | `user-details.ts:609-622, 650-672` |
| Prepare WhatsApp message | READ (issues a single-use token; returned message text **contains the plaintext PIN** when one is set, `B/whatsapp_api.py:84-90`) | `whatsapp/preview` {`user_id`, `account`, `language`} → `{token, recipient, message}`; token valid 600 s, bound to actor/user/revision/phone/account (`B/whatsapp_api.py:201-236`) | button disabled unless available + account + phone + `canEdit` | `user-details.ts:673-678` |
| Confirm and send | EXTERNAL side effect (sends a WhatsApp message via HA service `whatsapp.send_message`, `B/whatsapp_api.py:238-260`); no WisKey/device state change | `whatsapp/send` {`user_id`, `account`, `token`, `message` (non-empty, ≤12000), `confirmed: true`} → `{accepted: true}` | two-step: prepare → review/edit → "Confirm and send"; preview cleared before sending; any error other than `whatsapp_preview_expired` shown as `whatsapp_send_uncertain` | `user-details.ts:688-701, 893-900` |
| Open conversation / Refresh | READ | `whatsapp/history` {`user_id`, `account`} → `{recipient, messages[]}` | tab disabled unless ready and history supported | `user-details.ts:679-687` |
| Load attachment | READ | `whatsapp/media` {`user_id`, `account`, `token` (= `message.media_token`)} → `{mime, data (base64)}` | per-message button | `user-details.ts:702-716` |
| Edit | none (navigation) | — (emits `details-edit`) | disabled unless `canEdit` | `user-details.ts:907-917` |
| Close | none | — (emits `details-close`) | also auto-closes on HA disconnect or HA user change | `user-details.ts:559-565, 595-603` |

Permissions: `whatsapp/status|history|media`, `users/photo_get` = users:view; `whatsapp/preview|send` =
users:manage (`B/panel_permissions.py:145-189`). WhatsApp backend (`B/whatsapp_api.py`) belongs to
another part; shapes above were read from `whatsapp_api.py:185-319`.

### Live update behaviour
No subscription of its own. The parent re-renders with a new `person` after the panel's
`hikvision_intercom/subscribe` refresh event (`B/websocket.py:1077-1125`); a changed `revision` resets
the tab, preview, messages and photo and reloads (`:609-622`). All requests are scoped
(`ScopedRequests`) and cancelled on close/reset; media object URLs are revoked.

### Notes / quirks
- The grant list shows desired state only (enabled assignments) with a binary synced/pending label;
  `last_error`, desired/applied revisions and override sources are not shown here.
- Validity values are printed raw (ISO UTC) — no time-zone formatting in this component.
- The `whatsapp/preview` message body is the only place in this part's scope where a PIN value leaves
  the server.

## Screen: User access timing editor (`hikvision-user-timing`, `frontend/src/user-timing.ts`)

### Purpose
Sub-editor inside the person editor for a person's weekly or specific-date access schedule
(`access_timing_draft`) and, with a chosen enforcement mode, its enforced form
(`access_timing_policy`). Pure form component: emits change events; the parent editor saves.

### Entry point
`panel.ts:3878-3885`, inside the editor's validity section, rendered only when
`draft.access_timing_draft` is set. The validity mode `<select>` (panel) offers `always | period |
weekly | dates`; `weekly`/`dates` are disabled unless `api.capabilities` includes `user_timing_draft`
(`panel.ts:3843-3856`). Props: `.enforcement=${this._timingEnforcement}` (`"draft" | "ha" |
"native"`), `.canEnforce=${api.capabilities.includes("user_timing_enforcement")}`, `.language`,
`.value=${draft.access_timing_draft}`. Events: `@timing-change` → `patchDraft("access_timing_draft",
detail)`; `@timing-convert` → `convertTiming()` (panel, other part).
The enforcement `<select>` (placeholder "choose" while `draft`, "HA windows" = `ha`, "Station-local
plan" = `native`) is rendered by panel.ts (`:3861-3877`) only with capability `user_timing_enforcement`.
Below it the panel lists per-station `timing_readbacks` (`panel.ts:3886-3893`): station, mode,
synced/pending (synced iff readback `revision === draft.revision` and assignment `sync_state ===
"synced"`), `checked_at`, and the last installed `valid_from — valid_until` window.

### Layout & visual notes (`user-timing.ts:84-247`)
- Amber notice (`role=note`) keyed by enforcement: `draft` → `user_timing_choose_notice` (if
  `canEnforce`) else `user_timing_draft_notice`; `ha` → `user_timing_ha_notice`; `native` →
  `user_timing_native_notice` (`i18n.ts:106,135,137,170`). Examples: HA — "Save and synchronize to
  apply. The station enforces one finite window at a time; HA renews subsequent windows. If HA or the
  network is unavailable, the current window still expires and later access may be denied."; native —
  "…deploy and read back the station-local plan. Unknown resource references, unsupported calendar
  exceptions or clock differences block activation; an existing managed grant is set to expired when
  deployment fails."; draft — "Timing draft — not enforced by the intercom yet…".
- Time-zone text input (LTR, IANA name).
- Weekly mode: seven day checkboxes Monday…Sunday. Dates mode: date input (2000-01-01…2037-12-31) +
  "Add date" (disabled if empty/duplicate/≥64) and removable chips "`YYYY-MM-DD` ×".
- "All day" checkbox (checked iff exactly one period 00:00–24:00; toggling sets `[{00:00,24:00}]` or
  `[{09:00,17:00}]`).
- Not all-day: rows of `start`/`end` `type=time` inputs (UI end "00:00" is stored as "24:00") with
  Remove (disabled when only one); midnight hint; "Add period" (disabled at 8) appends 18:00–20:00.
- `<details>` "Preview": date + time inputs; output inside/outside via `timingPreview()`
  (`timing-validity.ts:30-41`), which also validates zone and local instant.
- In dates mode + `enforcement === "draft"` + no enforcement capability: "Convert" button (enabled only
  when `timingValidity()` succeeds, i.e. all selected date×period intervals form one continuous
  interval, `timing-validity.ts:44-71`) → emits `timing-convert`.

### Data model
`UserTimingDraft` (`types.ts:21-27`): `{ mode: "weekly" | "dates"; timezone: string; days: string[];
dates: string[]; periods: {start: string; end: string}[] }`. Server rules: Module
`access/user_timing.py`.

### User actions
| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edit zone/days/dates/periods | none (local draft) | — emits `timing-change` with the full merged draft | client validation only in preview/convert | `user-timing.ts:75-83` |
| Preview a date/time | none | — | — | `:98-113, 176-203` |
| Convert dates → single validity | none (local) | — emits `timing-convert` | disabled unless continuous | `:204-215` |
| Save (parent editor) | CONFIG-WRITE | parent sends `users/update` / `users/create` with `access_timing_draft` (whenever capability `user_timing_draft`) and `access_timing_policy` = `{mode, schedule: draft, bindings}` when enforcement ≠ `draft`, else `null` (`panel.ts:1363-1381`). `access_timing_draft` alone: WisKey storage only, never sent to devices. `access_timing_policy`: device push (timing modules); grants/limits physical access by time. | parent save flow | `panel.ts:1363-1381` |

### Live update behaviour
None; re-renders from `value`.

### Notes / quirks
- The component never calls the backend.
- On save, `bindings` are carried over only when the previous policy had the same mode, else `{}`
  (`panel.ts:1370-1375`); server requires `bindings == {}` for mode `ha`.

## Screen: User photo (`hikvision-user-photo`, `frontend/src/user-photo.ts`)

### Purpose
(a) In the person editor: take a portrait with the browser camera, preview, use/retake/remove.
(b) Compact avatar that lazily loads a stored portrait (people list, events).

### Entry point
- Editor: `panel.ts:2258-2268`, only when `policy.photo_enabled`: `.hass=${protectedHass}`,
  `.userId=${draft.id ?? ""}`, `.configured=${draft.photo_configured ?? false}`,
  `.revision=${draft.revision ?? 0}`, `.image=${draft.photo}`; `@photo-changed` →
  `patchDraft("photo", detail)` (detail = data URL string, or `null` to remove).
- Compact avatar: `panel.ts:3141` (list row) and `personAvatar()` `panel.ts:3167-3175` when
  `profile_settings.photo_enabled && person.photo_configured` (`compact`, `.configured=true`,
  `.revision`); `events.ts:828, 857, 1115` using `row.portrait.{user_id, revision}` (from `events/list`,
  `B/websocket.py:762-776` → `repository.event_portrait`).

### Layout & visual notes (`user-photo.ts:250-294`)
- Compact: circular `<img>` sized by CSS var `--wiskey-photo-size` (default 60 px), or a "●" placeholder.
- Full: section "Profile photo", current image (≤256 px square, rounded), then one of three states:
  idle row [Open camera] [Remove photo (if image or configured)]; capturing: live `<video>` + [Capture]
  (enabled after `loadedmetadata`) [Cancel]; preview: captured image + [Use photo] (primary) [Retake]
  [Cancel]. Hint "The photo is saved with the user. The camera stops after capture or closing this
  editor." Errors: `photo_https` (insecure context / no `getUserMedia`), `photo_camera_failed`,
  `invalid_photo`, `photo_load_failed`. Buttons min-height 44 px.
- Camera: `getUserMedia({video:{facingMode:"user", width:{ideal:512}, height:{ideal:512}},
  audio:false})`; stopped on tab hidden, HA disconnect, epoch change, component removal.
- Capture: centre-square crop drawn to a 256×256 canvas; JPEG at qualities 0.8, 0.65, 0.5, 0.35, 0.2
  until data-URL length ≤ 43,715 chars; otherwise `invalid_photo` (`:215-245`).

### Data model
Photo = `data:image/jpeg;base64,...` string (server rules: Module `profile_settings.py`, `photo_value`).

### User actions
| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Guard | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lazy-load stored photo (visible via IntersectionObserver, admin, `configured`) | READ | `users/photo_get` {`user_id`} → `{photo: "data:image/jpeg;base64,…" \| null}` (always `null` while `photo_enabled` is false, `B/websocket.py:817-819`); 10 s timeout | non-JPEG data ignored | `user-photo.ts:98-149` |
| Open camera / Capture / Retake / Cancel | none (browser only) | — | secure context | `:167-245` |
| Use photo / Remove photo | none locally (emits `photo-changed`); persisted by editor save (`photo` field of `users/create`/`users/update`) → CONFIG-WRITE, **WisKey storage only** (never written to intercoms) | — | — | `:246-249, 279, 289` |

### Live update behaviour
Reload key `${actor}:${userId}:${configured}:${revision}`; any change clears the cache and reloads when
visible (`:117-133`).

### Notes / quirks
Server rejects a non-null `photo` with `photo_disabled` when `photo_enabled` is false
(`B/websocket.py:867-868`).

## Screen: Bulk user actions (`hikvision-bulk-users`, `frontend/src/bulk-users.ts`)

### Purpose
Apply one action to an explicit multi-selection of people with a mandatory server-side impact
preview, explicit approval checkbox, durable receipt, and recovery path for an uncertain apply.

### Entry point
`panel.ts:3049-3056` in the Users tab, inside a `<details>` under the selection toolbar:
`.hass=${protectedHass}`, `.policy=${_data.profile_settings}`, `.users=${_data.users}`,
`.selected=${[..._selectedUsers]}`, `.stations=${_data.stations}`; `@access-changed` → `refresh()`.
Selection is pruned to existing users on each data refresh (`panel.ts:600`).

### Layout & visual notes (`:339-479`)
`<details>` summary "Group action: N" (auto-open when the selection is non-empty, an unknown operation
is pending, or a receipt exists). Toolbar: action `<select>` with `enable, disable, assign, unassign,
delete, remove_pin, remove_cards, sync, profile, group_add, group_remove, reset_overrides` (`:361`);
for `assign`/`unassign` a station `<select>` (stations without a managed lock disabled for `assign`);
for `profile` a field `<select>` (enabled fields) + value input (maxlength 100); for
`group_add`/`group_remove` a group `<select>` (enabled groups; `group_remove` also lists disabled).
[Preview] (disabled unless 1–200 selected, required target chosen, online, and no unchecked unknown
operation) and [Recent operations].
Preview section: action title, "Changed: X / Y", scrollable rows (name, employee no, changed fields as
`audit_field_<f>` or "no change", affected station names; for `profile` before→after per field; for
group/override actions groups before→after, permissions before→after, override count before→after).
"Capacity" per station: `users now → projected / max; cards now → projected / max`, checked time or
"not verified", red warning "Estimated peak exceeds capacity; station synchronization may be blocked".
Approval checkbox + primary [Apply] (disabled until checked). Receipt notice "Saved · <changed>
<operation_id>". Recent list rows `<action> · changed · saved_at` + id. Uncertain-apply banner
("bulk_unknown") with [Check receipt] and the operation id.

### Data model
`Preview`, `Receipt` interfaces (`bulk-users.ts:8-48`); server shapes in Module
`access/bulk_operations.py`. Session-only recovery `pending: WeakMap<connection, {operation, actor,
checked}>` (`:49-55`) — holds no credentials or roster data and never replays a write.

### User actions
| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preview | READ (in-memory review only; `device_writes: 0`) | `users/bulk_preview` {`request`: {`action`, `selection: [{user_id, revision}]`, `station_id`? (assign/unassign), `profile`? `{<field_id>: <value>}` (profile), `group_ids`? `[<group_id>]` (group_add/remove)}}; 30 s timeout | a stamp of selection/action/target/value/policy revision; any change discards the preview | `:236-297` |
| Apply `enable` / `disable` | CONFIG-WRITE: storage + device push (immediate queue); disable removes the person from devices; enable re-grants physical access | `users/bulk_apply` {`operation_id`} → receipt; 60 s timeout | approval checkbox; operation recorded in session as pending before sending | `:244, 257-304, 448-464` |
| Apply `assign` / `unassign` | CONFIG-WRITE; device push; grants/revokes physical access at `station_id` | same | same | same |
| Apply `delete` | CONFIG-WRITE; removes users from WisKey (tombstone until each target station confirms removal) and from devices (immediate queue) | same | same (no extra confirm beyond the checkbox) | same |
| Apply `remove_pin` / `remove_cards` | CONFIG-WRITE; storage + device push; retired PIN/card reservations until removal confirmed | same | same | same |
| Apply `sync` | CONFIG-WRITE (device only): no user change; receipt saved; reconciliation queued for all affected stations | same | same | same |
| Apply `profile` | CONFIG-WRITE, WisKey storage only (profile values are not device fields) | same | same | same |
| Apply `group_add` / `group_remove` / `reset_overrides` | CONFIG-WRITE; storage; device push when effective door rights change (grant/revoke physical access) | same | same | same |
| Check receipt (after uncertain apply) | READ | `users/bulk_receipt` {`operation_id`} → receipt or `operation_not_found` | only when `_unknown` | `:245, 324-329, 426` |
| Recent operations | READ | `users/bulk_receipts` {} → ≤50 receipts of the caller, newest first | — | `:280-281, 297` |

Permissions: `users/bulk_preview|bulk_apply` = users:manage; `users/bulk_receipt(s)` = users:view.
Apply error handling: `bulk_review_expired, bulk_review_stale, manager_closed, unauthorized,
storage_write_failed, storage_stopping` → pending op forgotten; any other error keeps it as
"unknown — check receipt" (`:309-323`).

### Live update behaviour
On successful apply emits `access-changed` (parent refreshes overview). Disconnect → reset +
"connection_lost"; the pending op survives in the WeakMap for the same connection/actor.

### Notes / quirks
Client caps selection at 200 (server 1–200). Preview `rows` include unchanged users (`changed:false`).

## Screen: Profile fields, groups, onboarding templates & photo policy (`hikvision-profile-settings`, `frontend/src/profile-settings.ts`)

### Purpose
Define custom person fields, access groups (with door grants), onboarding templates, and whether
portraits are collected. Saving goes through a reviewed "policy impact" preview showing who gains or
loses door access.

### Entry point
Tab `profile_options` (`panel.ts:4735-4744`), listed in the Tools grid. Props: `.hass`,
`.settings=${_data.profile_settings}`, `.stations=${_data.stations}`; `@profile-saved` (detail = reloaded
policy) replaces `_data.profile_settings`. Quirk: frontend `tabArea()` does not list `profile_options`
(falls through to `"overview"`, `panel.ts:2624-2641`) while every backend command used here requires
the management area.

### Layout & visual notes (`:330-495`)
Title, hints (`profile_settings_hint`; `profile_legacy_hint`: "Existing values are preserved when a
field definition changes. New or changed values are validated; revoking access remains available.").
Form:
1. Fieldset "Fields": per field — Label (required, ≤64), Type `<select>` text/select/number/date,
   Required checkbox, "Suggestions" textarea (one option per line, trimmed, blanks dropped), "Collect"
   (= `enabled`) checkbox. [Add field] disabled at 12.
2. Fieldset "Groups": per group — Name (required, ≤64), Active checkbox, nested fieldset "Group doors"
   with hint ("Saving applies these doors to all group members and queues synchronization, including
   offline stations. An inactive group grants no access.") and one checkbox per station (disabled for
   stations without a managed lock unless already selected), plus "Removed station (<id>)" checkboxes
   for ids that no longer exist. [Add group] disabled at 64.
3. Fieldset "Onboarding templates": `<details>` per template — Name (required ≤64), Active, one input per
   enabled field (≤100), checkboxes for groups (enabled or already selected). [Add template] disabled at
   32.
4. "Collect profile photos" checkbox (`photo_enabled`); archive hint ("Hiding fields or photos preserves
   their data. Disabling a group also revokes its inherited permissions; personal exceptions remain.
   Rename definitions without losing their identities.").
5. [Save] (primary; disabled while busy/stale/reviewing) and [Reload].
All fieldsets are disabled while a review is open. No delete buttons exist.
Review section "Policy review": hint ("Review who gains or loses access. Personal exceptions are
preserved. Saving queues synchronization; it does not confirm physical access."), "Changed: n ·
Offline: <station names>", rows paged by 50: name, employee no, "Before: stations → After: stations",
personal overrides (station: denied/personal). Buttons [Apply reviewed policy] (primary), [Cancel].
After an uncertain apply: operation id + [Check receipt].
New ids are generated client-side as `"f_" | "g_" | "t_" + crypto.randomUUID()` without dashes
(`:94, 244`).

### Data model (`profile-settings.ts:7-46`)
```ts
interface ProfileDefinition { id: string; label: string; enabled: boolean; station_ids?: string[] }
interface ProfileField extends ProfileDefinition { options: string[]; type?: "text"|"select"|"number"|"date"; required?: boolean }
interface OnboardingTemplate { id: string; label: string; enabled: boolean; profile: Record<string,string>; group_ids: string[] }
interface ProfilePolicy { revision: number; fields: ProfileField[]; groups: ProfileDefinition[]; photo_enabled: boolean; templates?: OnboardingTemplate[] }
interface PolicyReview { operation_id: string; requires_confirmation: boolean; changed: number; offline: string[];
  rows: { user_id: string; display_name: string; employee_no: string; before: string[]; after: string[];
          overrides: Record<string,string>; changed: boolean }[] }
```

### User actions
| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reload | READ | `profiles/settings_get` {} → `{revision, fields, groups, photo_enabled, templates}`; 10 s | — | `:99-115` |
| Save → preview | READ (in-memory review; `device_writes: 0`) | `profiles/settings_preview` {`revision`: int (current), `values`: {`fields`, `groups`, `photo_enabled`, `templates`}}; 15 s | — | `:116-148` |
| Auto-apply (when `requires_confirmation === false`, i.e. no group's enabled flag or door set changed) or [Apply reviewed policy] | CONFIG-WRITE: WisKey storage (policy + every affected user's effective assignments, new user revisions); device push immediate-queue for affected stations; group door changes grant/revoke physical access for all members | `profiles/settings_apply` {`operation_id`}; 20 s; then reload | explicit review when groups changed; otherwise no confirmation | `:130, 149-170, 303-311` |
| Check receipt | READ | `users/bulk_receipt` {`operation_id`} | only for a pending (uncertain) op | `:171-187, 320-326` |
| Cancel review | none | — | — | `:312-318` |

Permissions: `profiles/settings_get` = management:view; `profiles/settings_preview|apply` =
management:manage; `users/bulk_receipt` = users:view.
Error mapping in `save()` (`:131-145`): `revision_conflict` → "media_conflict", `invalid_fields` →
"media_invalid", `station_not_found|unmanaged_lock|station_has_no_managed_lock` → translated code, other
→ "media_save_unknown"; every error except `invalid_fields` marks the draft stale (Reload needed).

### Live update behaviour
Draft is cloned from `settings` once; later external changes do not overwrite an open draft (manual
Reload).

### Notes / quirks
- This screen never uses `profiles/settings_update` (see Capability rows: NO SCREEN).
- Definitions cannot be removed server-side (`profile_definition_in_use`) — archive via `enabled=false`.

## Module: `B/access/models.py`

### Responsibility
Private user record (`ManagedUser`) with secret wrappers, the masked public projection, validation of
every user field (`build_user` with patch semantics), sync-state vocabulary, `AccessError`.

### Definitions
- `SYNC_STATES = {"synced","pending","syncing","offline","conflict","error","delete_pending"}`
  (`:16-18`).
- `class AccessError(Exception)`: `.code: str` only, never record data (`:21-26`). There is no central
  enumeration of codes; they are string literals across modules (see per-module lists and the "Error
  code index").
- `utc_now()` → `datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")` (`:29-30`).
- `uuid_text(v)`: canonical UUID string else `invalid_id` (`:33-39`).
- `text_field(v, maximum, *, empty=False)`: str, `len ≤ maximum`, non-blank unless `empty`, no control
  chars (< 0x20); returns stripped; else `invalid_text` (`:42-50`).
- `boolean(v)`: exact bool else `invalid_boolean` (`:53-56`).
- `valid_period(start, end)` (`:59-78`): both `None` → `(None, None)`; else both ISO strings with an
  offset, `1970-01-01T00:00Z ≤ start < end ≤ 2037-12-31T23:59:59Z`; returned normalised to UTC
  `isoformat(timespec="seconds")` (e.g. `2026-01-01T08:00:00+00:00`); else `invalid_validity`.
- `SecretValue(value)` — `str()` = "REDACTED" (`:81-86`).
- `ManagedCard` (`:89-115`): `id: str (uuid4)`, `card_no: SecretValue`, `label: str = ""`,
  `card_type: str = "normalCard"`, `enabled: bool = True`.
  `private()` → `{id, card_no, label, card_type, enabled}`;
  `public()` → `{id, masked_number, label, card_type, enabled}`, `masked_number = "•••• " +
  card_no[-4:]` if `len(card_no) > 4` else `"••••"`.
- `StationAssignment` (`:118-141`): `config_entry_id: str` (station id = HA config-entry id),
  `enabled: bool`, `allowed_locks: frozenset[int]` (subset of {1,2}), `schedule_template: str|None =
  None` (must stay None), `desired_revision: int = 1`, `applied_revision: int|None = None`,
  `sync_state: str = "pending"`, `last_sync_at: str|None`, `last_error: str|None`. `serialize()` → same
  keys, `allowed_locks` as sorted list.
- `ManagedUser` (`:144-204`): `id, employee_no, display_name, active, user_type, valid_from,
  valid_until, pin: SecretValue|None, cards: list[ManagedCard], assignments: dict[str,
  StationAssignment], revision: int, created_at, updated_at, identity_locked: bool = False, profile:
  dict[str,str], group_ids: list[str], photo: str|None, permission_overrides: dict[str,
  "allow"|"deny"], phone: str = "", access_timing_draft: dict|None, access_timing_policy: dict|None`.
  - `private()` (stored form, `:168-193`): all fields; `pin` plaintext or None; private cards; photo
    data URL.
  - **Public projection** `public()` (`:195-204`): all private keys **except** `pin`, `cards`, `photo`;
    adds `photo_configured: bool`, `pin_configured: bool`, `cards: [card.public()]`. Resulting keys:
    `id, employee_no, display_name, phone, access_timing_draft, access_timing_policy, active,
    user_type, valid_from, valid_until, assignments{sid: {config_entry_id, enabled, allowed_locks,
    schedule_template, desired_revision, applied_revision, sync_state, last_sync_at, last_error}},
    revision, created_at, updated_at, identity_locked, profile, group_ids, permission_overrides,
    photo_configured, pin_configured, cards[{id, masked_number, label, card_type, enabled}]`.
    `repository.public()` adds `timing_readbacks`; `manager.public()` (overview) adds `sync_reference`.
  - `from_private()` re-validates stored data through `build_user`; malformed storage →
    `invalid_storage` (`:206-238`).
- `phone_value(v)` (`:241-250`): str ≤32; empty allowed; otherwise `\+?[0-9 ()-]+` with 7–15 digits;
  normalised by `mobile_display`; else `invalid_phone`.

### `build_user(data, *, employee_no, now, previous=None)` — field rules (`:253-376`)
Patch semantics: absent keys keep the previous value.

| Field | Rule | Error |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_no` | `validate_identifier`: `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` (`B/client/access.py:58-66`) | `invalid_identifier` |
| `display_name` | `text_field(…, 32)`, non-empty | `invalid_text` |
| `active` | bool, default True | `invalid_boolean` |
| `user_type` | only `"normal"` | `unsupported_user_type` |
| `valid_from` / `valid_until` | `valid_period` (both or neither) | `invalid_validity` |
| `pin` | `None` (= remove) or `^[0-9]{1,128}$` | `invalid_pin` |
| `cards` | list ≤255 of dicts; `id` optional (uuid; with `id` and no `card_no` the stored secret is kept); `card_no` via `validate_card` `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`; `card_type` only `"normalCard"`; `label` ≤64 (may be empty); `enabled` bool; ids and numbers unique | `invalid_cards`, `invalid_id`, `invalid_identifier`, `unsupported_card_type`, `duplicate_card` |
| `assignments` | dict ≤100; key ≤64; value `{enabled: bool (default True), allowed_locks: distinct ints in {1,2} (default [1]), schedule_template: absent/None}`; enabled requires ≥1 lock; `desired_revision` = new revision; `applied_revision` carried over | `invalid_assignments`, `unmanaged_lock`, `schedule_unverified` |
| `profile` | `profile_values` (≤12 keys, id regex, values ≤100) | `invalid_fields` |
| `group_ids` | `group_values` (≤64 ids, unique; stored sorted) | `invalid_fields` |
| `photo` | `photo_value` (JPEG data URL; see profile_settings) | `invalid_photo` |
| `permission_overrides` | `overrides()`: dict ≤100 of `allow`/`deny`; default for a new user derived from assignments' enabled flags | `invalid_assignments` |
| `phone` | `phone_value` | `invalid_phone` |
| `access_timing_policy` | `timing_policy.policy()` | `invalid_timing_policy`, … |
| `access_timing_draft` | `user_timing.timing_draft()` | `invalid_user_timing`, … |

`revision` = previous + 1 (1 for new); `created_at` kept; `updated_at` = now; `id` = uuid4 for new.
`identity_locked` carried from previous (set by the repository once a device binding/intent exists).

## Module: `B/access/repository.py` (`AccessRepository`)

### Responsibility
Single durable store for users, device-ownership bindings, deletion tombstones, credential-removal
reservations, admin audit, operation receipts, the sync-operation journal and the central profile
policy. Every mutation is computed on a deep copy, collision-checked, journaled, audited and **saved
before it becomes visible** (`_commit`, `:264-296`; offloaded to a worker thread when >100 users or
>100 audit records). Network I/O never runs under the lock. Storage failures raise and halt.

### Persistence — `.storage/hikvision_intercom.users`
(`B/storage.py:34-35`: private, atomic writes, max file 32 MiB). Full `_state` (`:32-45`, schema 10):
```text
{
  "schema": 10,
  "fingerprint_key": "<64 hex>",   # HMAC-SHA256 key: device fingerprints, CSV review tokens, bulk stamps
  "profile_settings": null | {"schema": 2, "revision": int, "values": {fields, groups, photo_enabled, templates}},
  "users": { "<user uuid>": ManagedUser.private() },       # pin & card_no in clear, photo data URL
  "bindings": { "<station id>": { "<user uuid>": {
        "employee_no": str,
        "fingerprint": str|null,             # HMAC of last observed canonical device record
        "intent": null | {"operation": "create"|"update"|"delete", "revision": int,
                          "desired_fingerprint": str, "before_fingerprint": str|null},
        "adopted": bool,
        "identity_observed_at": ISO|null,    # start of proven ownership (event name/portrait attribution)
        "sync_state"?: <SYNC_STATE>, "last_error"?: str|null,
        "timing_readback"?: {"mode": "ha"|"native", "valid_from": ISO|null, "valid_until": ISO|null,
                             "revision": int, "checked_at": ISO} } } },
  "tombstones": { "<user uuid>": {
        "user_id", "employee_no", "targets": [station ids], "confirmed": [station ids], "created_at",
        "stations": { "<sid>": {"sync_state": ..., "last_error": ...} },
        "record": ManagedUser.private() with photo=None, profile={}, group_ids=[], phone="" } },
  "ignored": { "<station id>": [employee_no, ...] },        # unmanaged device users hidden by an admin
  "retired_cards": { "<uuid>": {"user_id", "card_no", "targets": [...], "confirmed": [...]} },
  "retired_pins":  { "<uuid>": {"user_id", "pin", "targets": [...], "confirmed": [...]} },
  "admin_audit": {"next": int, "records": [ {sequence, time, actor, action, user_id, stations, fields,
                  before, after, revision_before, revision_after} ]},   # ≤5000 records, 30-day retention
  "operation_receipts": { "<operation_id>": {operation_id, actor, action, saved_at, user_ids, changed, stations} },  # ≤1000
  "sync_operations": { "<user_id>/<station_id>": {id, user_id, station_id, intent (hex HMAC), queued_at,
                  updated_at, state: "pending"|"failed"|"verified"|"settled", verified_at} }   # ≤1000 completed kept
}
```
- Audit `before`/`after` summaries contain no secrets: `{display_name, employee_no, active, user_type,
  valid_from, valid_until, pin_configured, card_count, enabled_cards, assignments{sid:{enabled,
  allowed_locks}}}` (`B/access/admin_audit.py:74-91`). `fields` = changed names (device-desired fields
  + `profile, group_ids, photo, permission_overrides, phone, access_timing_draft`, or `["ownership"]`)
  (`admin_audit.py:94-169`). Audit `action` = the WS command when it is in `ACTIONS`
  (`admin_audit.py:18-50`: `profiles/settings_update, users/create, users/update, users/delete,
  users/set_active, cards/add, cards/remove, users/csv_apply, users/adopt, users/delete_unmanaged,
  users/ignore, cards/capture_confirm, conflicts/resolve, conflicts/resolve_deletion, bulk/enable,
  bulk/disable, bulk/assign, bulk/unassign, bulk/delete, bulk/remove_pin, bulk/remove_cards,
  bulk/sync, bulk/profile, bulk/group_add, bulk/group_remove, bulk/reset_overrides, bulk/group_policy,
  bulk/csv_import, system`), else `system`. Actor = HA user id; reconciliation tasks never inherit it.
- `sync_operations` (`B/access/sync_tracking.py:56-127`): one row per pending (user, station); `failed`
  when the station/binding/tombstone state is `error`/`conflict`; `verified` only after device readback;
  `settled` when pending work disappears without readback. Public projection omits `intent`.
- Migrations schema 1→10 (`:47-177`); load validates everything and fails closed (`invalid_storage`,
  HA repair issue `users_storage_corrupt`); `syncing` states are reset to `pending` on load. The legacy
  store `.storage/hikvision_intercom.profile_settings` is only read when `profile_settings` is still
  null (`B/access_runtime.py:116-145`).
- Photo cap: sum of all users' photo string lengths ≤ 24 MiB (24×1024×1024) → `photo_storage_full`
  (`:300-301`).

### Key operations
| Method | Behaviour | file:line |
|---|---|---|
| `_validate_collisions` | `employee_no` unique across users + tombstones (`employee_conflict`); PIN unique across users + tombstones (`pin_conflict`); card number unique (`card_conflict`); a retiring PIN/card still owned by another user blocks reuse (`pin_removal_pending` / `card_removal_pending`) | `:298-332` |
| `pin_available(pin, exclude_user_id)` | digits 1–128 else `invalid_pin`; free across users, tombstones and retired PINs (excluding the given user); unknown exclude id → `user_not_found` | `:347-362` |
| `generate_unique_pin(exclude_user_id)` | 6-digit `100000–999999` via `secrets`, ≤1024 attempts → `pin_generation_failed`; not reserved (final write rechecks) | `:364-373` |
| `public()` | `{users: [public + timing_readbacks{sid: readback}], sync_operations, revocations: [{station_id, user_id, sync_state, last_error}] (bound stations no longer assigned), card_removals: [{id, user_id, targets, confirmed}], pin_removals: [...], tombstones: [without "record"]}` | `:375-425` |
| `permission_data(data, previous)` | `access_policy_revision` (if sent) must equal the current policy revision else `group_policy_changed`; validates `profile` against definitions for new users or when `profile` is in data; then `group_permissions.prepare` | `:439-460` |
| `async_create(data)` | auto `employee_no` = random unused 9-digit `100000000–999999999`, used only when `data` has no `employee_no` | `:520-533` |
| `_update_user` | `expected_revision` must match (`revision_conflict`); if device-desired fields are unchanged the assignments keep their state and revisions advance together (no sync needed); `employee_no` change forbidden when `identity_locked` (`identity_migration_required`); old PIN → `retired_pins`, removed card numbers → `retired_cards` for all current/bound stations; re-adding cancels a retirement | `:542-587` |
| `_delete_user` | revision check; targets = assignments ∪ bound stations ∪ retirement targets; with targets → tombstone (credentials kept, photo/profile/groups/phone scrubbed) with per-station `delete_pending`; the user disappears from `users` immediately | `:663-699` |
| `bulk_stamp()` | HMAC over users' (employee_no, revision, identity_locked), tombstone ids, binding keys, retirements, profile revision — ignores sync progress | `:589-604` |
| `async_bulk_apply` (CSV) | stamp must match (`csv_review_stale`); creates/updates; per-user validate; optional receipt; receipts capped at 1000 (oldest `saved_at` evicted) | `:629-658` |
| `async_apply_operation` (bulk) | idempotent by `operation_id` (same actor → existing receipt; other actor → `operation_not_found`); stamp must match (`bulk_review_stale`); applies deletes/updates; saves receipt | `:701-737` |
| `async_profile_settings(data, validate, stamp, receipt)` | idempotent by receipt id; stamp check (`bulk_review_stale`); revision must be prior + 1 (`revision_conflict`); stores policy; re-derives every user via `permission_data({}, old)`; users whose device-desired fields change get a new revision; returns changed ids; optional receipt | `:462-518` |
| `event_portrait(station, employee_no, occurred_at)` | only when `photo_enabled`; exactly one bound owner observed at/before the event time and having a photo → `{user_id, revision}` | `:763-792` |
| Sync/conflict internals (other part) | `event_audience`, `event_person_name`, `async_bind`, `async_record_observation`, `async_mark`, `async_confirm_absent`, `async_ignore`, `async_confirm_pin_removals`, `async_confirm_card_removals`, `async_adopt`, `async_write_intent`, `async_resolve`, `async_resolve_deletion` | `:739-1255` |

### Error codes raised
`already_managed, bulk_review_stale, card_conflict, card_removal_pending, csv_review_stale,
deletion_not_pending, employee_conflict, group_policy_changed, identity_migration_required,
invalid_operation, invalid_pin, invalid_storage, invalid_sync_status, operation_not_found,
ownership_missing, photo_storage_full, pin_conflict, pin_generation_failed, pin_removal_pending,
revision_conflict, user_not_found` (+ all `build_user` codes).

| `users/csv_apply` | `csv: str`, `mode: str`, `review_token: str`, optional `column_map: dict` | `{counts, saved, operation_id, durable}` | CONFIG-WRITE; storage + immediate queue for access-changing rows | users:manage | `:211, 754-761` |
| `cards/reader_capabilities` | `station_id: str` | `{readers: [int], card_min, card_max}` | READ (device GETs) | users:manage | `:197, 524-525` |
| `cards/capture_start` | `station_id`, `user_id`, `revision: int`, `reader_id: int` | session | PHYSICAL (reader enters card-collection mode; see enrollment) — no storage write | users:manage | `:198, 526-533` |
| `cards/capture_status` | `session_id: str` | session | READ | users:manage | `:199, 534-535` |
| `cards/capture_cancel` | `session_id: str` | `{cancelled: true}` | ends the HA session (aborts the pending device GET) | users:manage | `:200, 536-538` |
| `cards/capture_confirm` | `session_id: str`, `label: str` | user public | CONFIG-WRITE (adds card; immediate queue); grants physical access | users:manage | `:201, 539` |
| `sync/user` | `user_id: str` | `{accepted: true}` | CONFIG-WRITE (device only): queues reconciliation of stations where the user has jobs | users:manage | `:235, 980-981`; `manager.py:184-190` |

Extra checks on `users/create|update` when `profile`, `group_ids` or `photo` is present
(`websocket.py:844-868`): profile keys must be defined field ids; group ids must be defined group ids;
a non-null photo requires `photo_enabled` (`photo_disabled`); no policy → `profile_settings_unavailable`.
`AccessManager.async_create/async_update` (`manager.py:725-757`) also run `_validate`
(`manager.py:336-347`): each enabled assignment's station must exist (`station_not_found`) and have a
managed lock (`station_has_no_managed_lock`); when the station's capabilities are known the person must
fit them (`desired_person`/`desired_cards`: `person_exceeds_capabilities`, `pin_device_managed`,
`pin_exceeds_capabilities`, `card_capacity`, `card_exceeds_capabilities`, `unmanaged_lock`).
`cards/capture_*` additionally require a non-empty actor (`unauthorized`).

### Device interaction
None directly in the handlers; the reconciliation engine (other part) writes ISAPI `UserInfo`
Record/Modify/Delete and `CardInfo` Record/Modify/Delete (`B/client/access.py:352-470`) from
`normalize.desired_person/desired_cards`. A person is present on a station iff `user.active and
assignment.enabled` (`B/access/engine.py:173`); otherwise the device record is removed.
