## Module: be/hardening.py

**Responsibility.** Admission control and metrics.
- `AdminLimiter` (hardening.py:48-75), shared instance `hass.data[DOMAIN]["admin_limiter"]`, applied to every COMMANDS request (not subscribe): per HA user id token bucket burst **30**, refill **2 tokens/s**, max **8 concurrent** handlers per user; ≤ **128** tracked identities (new identity beyond → `rate_limited`); entries idle (no active) > **600 s** evicted. Failures → `rate_limited`.
- `RequestMetrics` (19-38): per station client, samples ≤ 100: `{requests, failures, sample_count, last_ms, p95_ms}` (surfaced in diagnostics `requests`).

## Module: be/log_filter.py

`AccessWebSocketFilter` installed on logger `homeassistant.components.websocket_api.http.connection` (log_filter.py:39-43; called from `async_register_websocket`). Redacts in log args: any dict whose `type` starts with `hikvision_intercom/` → `{id, type, payload:"REDACTED"}`; bytes/str containing `hikvision_intercom.audio` → `"Hikvision audio payload REDACTED"`; dicts whose `event` or `result` has `format=="hikvision_intercom.audio"`; lists recursively. No commands.

## Module: be/events.py (event normalization + bounded cache)

**Responsibility.** Allowlisted event record projection and the 5 000-record / 30-day cache.

**Event kind mapping** (`KINDS`, events.py:18-33) — only for `major == 5` (Access Control); otherwise `("unknown","unknown","unknown")`:

| minor | event_type | result | authentication |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | access_granted | granted | card |
| 9 | access_denied | denied | card |
| 21 | door_unlocked | unknown | unknown |
| 22 | door_locked | unknown | unknown |
| 25 | contact_open | unknown | unknown |
| 26 | contact_closed | unknown | unknown |
| 92 | unlock_exception | unknown | unknown |
| 148 | attempt_limit | denied | pin |
| 150 | access_denied | denied | pin |
| 181 | access_granted | granted | pin |
| 214 | unlock_record | unknown | from `unlockType`: "card"→card, "password"→pin, else unknown |
| 215 | door_not_opened | unknown | unknown |
| 216 | door_not_closed | unknown | unknown |
| 229 | access_granted | granted | pin |

`EVENT_TYPES` = sorted {unknown, access_granted, access_denied, door_unlocked, door_locked, contact_open, contact_closed, unlock_exception, attempt_limit, unlock_record, door_not_opened, door_not_closed} (events.py:34). Ring rows use `event_type "ring"` (created in event_manager).

**Record schema** (`FIELDS`, events.py:35-53; produced by `normalize_event`, 80-178):
```
id            64 hex; HMAC-SHA256(fingerprint_key, json([station_id, device_time_iso|None, major, minor, serialNo|None, api_door, employee, card] (+ received_iso if no time and no serial) (+ occurrence if historical)))
station_id    config entry id
timestamp     ISO; device time if present else received time
received_at   ISO (HA receive time)
time_source   "device" | "received"
employee_no   employeeNoString or employeeNo (string, ≤32; leading zeros kept) | null
person_name   device `name` (≤128) or later resolved from WisKey repository | null
door          physical lock index mapped from api_door via runtime locks (stream) | null (history: selected_api=None → always null)
api_door      1 | 2 | null (doorNo)
authentication "card" | "pin" | "unknown"
result        "granted" | "denied" | "unknown"
event_type    see table, or "ring"
major, minor  int | null
card          masked "••••" + last 4 digits (or "••••") | null   (PIN never retained)
recovered     bool: historical, or not currentEvent, or no device time, or (received - device time) ∉ [-5, 90] s
source        "stream" | "query" | "call_status"
```
Live stream documents must be `EventNotificationAlert.eventType == "AccessControllerEvent"` and `eventState == "active"`, fields under `AccessControllerEvent` (`majorEventType`, `subEventType`, `dateTime` outer); history rows use `major`, `minor`, `time` directly.

**EventCache** (181-386): `limit=5000`, retention 30 days by `received_at` (prune removes older, then oldest-inserted beyond 5000). `add` returns False for duplicate id. `latest_access(station_ids)` (260-299): per station the latest of event types {access_granted, access_denied, attempt_limit, unlock_record} by event time (not later than now+5 s), ranked (time, has identity, is auth event); returns `{timestamp, time_source, person_name, employee_no, authentication, result, event_type, recovered, door}`.

**Query filters** (`query`, 301-386) — allowed keys exactly: `station_id` (text ≤128), `person` (text ≤128; case-insensitive substring of "employee_no person_name"), `result` ∈ {granted, denied, unknown}, `authentication` ∈ {card, pin, unknown}, `door` int ∈ {1,2} (compares the mapped physical `door`), `start`/`end` (aware ISO ≤40 chars, start < end; compared to `timestamp`), `limit` int 1..200 (default 100), `before` (event id cursor; unknown id → error "Event cursor expired"). Plus `current_group`/`current_profile` stripped earlier by reporting.audience_filter. Any other key or invalid value → `HikvisionValidationError` → WS `invalid_fields`. Sort: timestamp desc, id desc. Output `{records, next: last id if more else null, retention_days: 30, capacity: 5000}`.

## Module: be/event_manager.py

**Responsibility.** Owns the event cache and persistence, per-station live alert stream + history recovery tasks, ring synthesis from call status, publication to HA event entities.

**Commands handled** (through websocket.py):

| exact string | input | output | class. | perm | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `events/list` | `filters` (keys above + `current_group:str`, `current_profile:{field_id:str}`) | `{records:[row + evidence + portrait], next, retention_days:30, capacity:5000, membership_basis:"current_observed_owner"\|null, storage_failed:bool, stations:{<station_id>: status}}`; `portrait = repository.event_portrait(...)` → `{user_id, revision}` or null (only when `employee_no` and `time_source=="device"` and photos enabled and station ownership proven at event time) | READ | events:view | event_manager.py:142-154; websocket.py:762-778 |
| `events/detail` | `event_id` | `event_support(row)` + `source_identity` (trace evidence for this id, if still in the 128-entry evidence LRU, else null) + `record` (full row) | READ | events:view | event_manager.py:202-215 |
| `events/support` | `event_id` | same without `record`: `{format:"hikvision_intercom.event_support", version:1, integration_version, case_id: id[:16], event:{timestamp, received_at, event_type, major, minor, authentication, result, recovered}, evidence, source_identity}` | READ | events:view | event_manager.py:202-215; event_diagnostics.py:53-74 |
| `events/report` / `events/export` / `events/print` | `filters` (same as list; `limit`/`before` rejected) | reporting.build_report(...) + `{membership_basis, filters, retention_days, capacity, storage_failed, stations}`; export adds `csv`, print adds `print_records` | READ | events:view | event_manager.py:156-193 |

`status()` per station (272-280): `{stream, history, reconnects:int, last_frame_at:ISO|null, telemetry: EventTelemetry.public(), recovered_until: cursor ISO|null}`. `stream` ∈ {connecting, connected, disconnected, authentication_failed, unavailable, stopped}; `history` ∈ {pending, offline, unavailable, recovered, authentication_failed, incomplete}.

**Persistence.** `.storage/hikvision_intercom.events` (AccessStore, private, atomic). Data: `{"schema": 1, "records": [<FIELDS rows>], "fingerprint_key": "<64 hex = 32 bytes>", "cursors": {<station_id>: "<ISO end of last complete history window>"}}` (event_manager.py:73-78; events.py:257-258). Loaded strictly (every record validated); corrupt → repair `events_storage_corrupt` and setup raises (event_manager.py:513-523). Save debounced 2 s after `changed()`; on failure `storage_failed=true`, logs once, retries every 30 s; forced strict save on shutdown (94-113, 223-233). Prune timer hourly (62-71). Retention: 5 000 records / 30 days.

**Device interaction** (client/events.py):
- Live stream: `GET /ISAPI/Event/notification/alertStream` on a dedicated httpx client (1 connection, Digest auth, `Accept-Encoding: identity`, timeout 65 s read / 5 s connect) (client/events.py:30, 106-155). Multipart framing parsed by `EventFrames` (Content-Length per part; JSON/XML parts ≤ 256 KiB parsed, other parts ≤ 4 MiB skipped; header ≤ 8 KiB). Loop (`_stream`, event_manager.py:349-405): confirm identity; renew stream every 1 800 s; flood guard > 1 200 frames within 60 s → `unavailable`; 401/403 → `authentication_failed` (retry 300 s); 404/405/501 → `unavailable` (300 s); other errors → `disconnected`; backoff 2 s doubling to 300 s + per-station jitter 0-1 s; `reconnects` counter.
- History recovery (`_history`, 407-493): skipped when coordinator offline (`offline`); needs `GET /ISAPI/AccessControl/AcsEvent/capabilities?format=json` with `AcsEventCond.maxResults.@max` 1..1000, `searchResultPosition.@max`, `startTime`,`endTime`, and `major.@opt` containing 5 → `page_size=min(max,30)`, `position_limit=min(max,1000)`, else `unavailable`. Window: `end = now-2 s`; `start = max(cursor or end-1 day, end-30 days)`; if start ≥ end → end-5 min; `end ≤ start+1 day`. Pages `POST /ISAPI/AccessControl/AcsEvent?format=json` with `{"AcsEventCond":{"searchID":uuid,"searchResultPosition":n,"maxResults":page_size,"major":5,"minor":0,"startTime":ISO,"endTime":ISO,"picEnable":false}}` (query starts 2 s before `start`), strict pagination validation (`numOfMatches`, `totalMatches` ≤5000 and constant, `responseStatusStrg` ∈ {OK, MORE, NO MATCH, NOMATCH}, no repeated page). If total > position_limit+page_size → `HistoryWindowFull` → window halved (min 1 s). 120 s timeout per pass. Offset-free device times are resolved with the station zone only for model `DS-KV6124-E1` firmware `V3.9.0 build 260115` with confirmed identity (client/events.py:241-262), zone re-read after search must match. Rows outside the window → `incomplete`. On success cursor := end, `history_state="recovered"`, `changed()`. Next pass after 300 s; 60 s if `incomplete`/`offline`; 5 s when recovered but cursor > 310 s behind (catch-up).
- Name resolution (ingest, 320-347): if row has `employee_no`, no `person_name`, device time → `repository.event_person_name(station, employee_no, timestamp)`.
- Ring synthesis (`_call_changed`, 282-318): coordinator listener; when call state becomes `ringing` from `idle`/`in_call`/`ending` and ≥2 s since last ring → row `{id: sha256("<station_id>:<now>:ring"), event_type:"ring", source:"call_status", time_source:"received", result/authentication "unknown", everything else null, recovered:false}`.

**Events/signals emitted.**
- No HA bus events are fired anywhere in the integration (no `hass.bus.async_fire`).
- Dispatcher `SIGNAL_EVENT = "hikvision_intercom_event"` (event_manager.py:31) with a copy of the row, only when the row is new **and `recovered == false`** (event_manager.py:115-127). Internal only (not reachable over WS).
- Dispatcher `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED` on every `changed()` (drives `subscribe` refresh).
- HA `event` entities (be/event.py) consume SIGNAL_EVENT — see Module event.py.

**HA repairs.** `events_storage_corrupt` (load), `events_storage_write` (AccessStore write failure, storage.py:75-77).
**Errors.** `event_not_found`; filter errors → `invalid_fields`; trace: `device_busy`, `revision_conflict`; `station_unloaded` (trace on unloaded station, websocket.py:509-511).

## Module: be/event.py (HA event entities)

Per station config entry two entities (event.py:14-17):
- **Doorbell**: unique_id `<entry.unique_id>_doorbell`, translation_key `doorbell` (name "Doorbell"), device_class `doorbell`, `event_types = ["ring"]`.
- **Access event**: unique_id `<entry.unique_id>_access`, translation_key `access` (name "Access event"), `event_types = EVENT_TYPES` (12 values listed above; not "ring").
Both extend `IntercomEntity` (be/entity.py: `has_entity_name=True`, device = station device `(hikvision_intercom, entry.unique_id)`) and `CoordinatorEntity` (availability follows the call-status coordinator). Enabled by default.
`_receive(row)` (event.py:32-53): ignores rows of other stations; routes `ring` → doorbell entity, all others → access entity; calls `_trigger_event(row["event_type"], {employee_no, person_name, door, authentication, result, major, minor})` and writes state. Resulting HA state: state = ISO timestamp of the trigger (HA EventEntity), attributes `event_type` + those 7 keys (+ `event_types`, `device_class`, `friendly_name`). Only **live** (non-recovered) rows fire; the event `id`, `station_id`, device `timestamp`, `card`, `recovered`, `source` are not exposed on the entity. A client can therefore subscribe to HA `state_changed` for `event.*` entities (e.g. `subscribe_entities` / `subscribe_events{event_type:"state_changed"}` / `subscribe_trigger`) to receive live access events with person/employee/door/result data, but cannot correlate them to `events/detail` ids. These entity ids are not included in overview `stations[].entities`; find them via the entity registry by unique_id suffix `_doorbell` / `_access` and platform `hikvision_intercom`.

## Module: be/event_trace.py

`EventTrace` (51-173), one per StationEvents (in memory; discarded on reload):
- `start(initial_state)` → `device_busy` if recording; run `{capture_id: uuid hex, state:"recording", started_at, duration_seconds:90, records:[], dropped:0}`; appends baseline call observation.
- `stop(capture_id)` → `revision_conflict` if id mismatch; state "stopped" if still recording (auto "complete" after 90 s).
- `public()` → `{format:"hikvision_intercom.event_trace", schema:1, capture:<run or null>, remaining_seconds, physical_result:"unverified"}`.
- Records (≤300, consecutive identical observations merged with `count`, `at`, `last_at`; overflow counted in `dropped`): call observations `{kind:"call_baseline"|"call_poll", state: idle|ringing|in_call|unknown|unavailable}`; event observations `{kind:"history"|"stream", family: AccessControllerEvent|heartBeat|VideoIntercomEvent|callStatus|voiceTalkEvent|other, voice_command: request|cancel|answer|reject|hangUp|null, device_time, major, minor, authentication, result, live_automation: !recovered, identity: {source_fields:{employeeNoString|employeeNo|name: missing|empty|provided|invalid_type}, normalized_employee, normalized_name, normalized, time_interpretation: verified_device_zone|source_timestamp, central_name_resolved}}`.
- Identity evidence kept per event id in an LRU of 128 (used by `events/detail`/`support` as `source_identity`) — recorded whether or not a trace is running.

## Module: be/event_diagnostics.py

- `explain_event(row)` (14-50) → `{identity_state: identified|id_only|identity_unavailable, origin, arrival_delay_seconds: received-device seconds (device time only), time_source, source, live_automation: !recovered}`; origin ∈ `history_query` (source query), `call_poll` (call_status), `device_time_missing`, `device_time_ahead` (lag < -5), `delayed_stream` (lag > 90), `device_not_current` (recovered), `live_stream`.
- `event_support(row, version)` (53-74) — see events/support.
- `EventTelemetry.public()` (104-122): `{started_at, seen, accepted, duplicates, origins:{origin:n}, identities:{state:n}, last_received, last_live, stream_arrival_delay:{samples, min, max, median, p95}}` (≤100 stream delay samples; process lifetime).

## Module: be/client/history_diagnostics.py (`events/history_inspect`)

`inspect_history(client, start, end)` (18-110): requires aware ISO range, 0 < span ≤ 1 day (`HikvisionValidationError` → WS `device_unavailable`, see Open questions). Uses a separate reader client sharing the session; 45 s timeout. Device reads: identity confirm, `GET /ISAPI/System/time` (clock; failure → `clock_error:"clock_read_failed"`), AcsEvent capabilities (not advertised → `HikvisionUnsupportedError`), AcsEvent search pages (as above). Never moves cursors or emits events. Output:
```
{format:"hikvision_intercom.history_inspection", schema:1, start, end, generated_at,
 complete:bool, filter_honored:bool|null, records:int, groups:[{major, minor, authentication, result, has_employee, has_name, count}] (≤64 groups),
 clock:{checked_at, skew_seconds, time_mode}|null, clock_error?, recovery_cursor_changed:false, live_events_emitted:0,
 device_local_times?:int, invalid_records?:int, ungrouped_records?:int, error?:"history_window_full"}
```
Websocket guards (websocket.py:478-496): station must be loaded (`station_unloaded`); `hass.data[DOMAIN]["history_inspections"]` set: same station busy or ≥3 concurrent → `device_busy`.

## Module: be/reporting.py

- `audience_filter(filters, profile_policy, audience)` (15-63): strips `current_group` (must be an existing group id) and `current_profile` (non-empty dict ≤12 entries; keys must be ids present in `profile_settings.fields` — the `enabled` flag is not checked server-side; values str 1..100, no control chars) → match function requiring device time, employee_no, an audience entry `(station_id, employee_no)` observed at/before the event, membership in group and equal profile values. Invalid → `HikvisionValidationError` ("Invalid current membership filter").
- `event_report(rows, now, zones)` (66-113): counts per totals / station / local day: `records`, `authentication` (event_type access_granted|access_denied), `granted`, `denied`, `unknown`, `other`, `recovered`; `methods` = authentication method counts for auth events. Output `{generated_at, day_timezone:"station"|"UTC", oldest, newest, totals, methods, by_station:[{station_id, ...counts}], by_day:[{day, ...counts}]}`. `zones` = `{station_id: clock.public()["zone"]}` for stations with a clock; missing stations fall back to UTC; `day_timezone` is "station" whenever zones is not None (always, from EventManager).
- `build_report(...)` (116-193): runs in executor. `printable` → `print_records[]` = `{employee_no, person_name, event_type, authentication, result, door, card, recovered, time_source, station:<entry title or id>, timestamp, display_timestamp (station zone), display_timezone (zone name)}`. `export` → `csv` via `access.csv_transfer.csv_text` with headers `timestamp, station, employee_no, person_name, event_type, authentication, result, door, masked_card, recovered, time_source, display_timestamp, display_timezone`.

## Module: be/access/admin_audit.py

**Responsibility.** Bounded administrative change evidence for managed-user changes.
**Authorship.** `audit_actor(actor, action)` context var (56-63): `action` is the WS command if in `ACTIONS`, else `"system"`; `current_actor()` returns ("", "system") for child tasks (reconciliation). `append_changes(old, new, actor, action)` (110-169) is called by the repository on save: for every user id changed (and tombstones for delete_unmanaged / resolve_deletion) appends a record when revision changed or (for conflicts/resolve, resolve_deletion, users/adopt) bindings changed.
**ACTIONS** (18-50): `profiles/settings_update, users/create, users/update, users/delete, users/set_active, cards/add, cards/remove, users/csv_apply, users/adopt, users/delete_unmanaged, users/ignore, cards/capture_confirm, conflicts/resolve, conflicts/resolve_deletion, bulk/enable, bulk/disable, bulk/assign, bulk/unassign, bulk/delete, bulk/remove_pin, bulk/remove_cards, bulk/sync, bulk/profile, bulk/group_add, bulk/group_remove, bulk/reset_overrides, bulk/group_policy, bulk/csv_import, system`.
**Persistence.** Inside `.storage/hikvision_intercom.users` (default AccessStore key) under `state["admin_audit"] = {"next": int ≥1, "records": [...]}` and `state["operation_receipts"]` (be/access/repository.py:43-44). Record schema (validate_storage 172-321):
```
{sequence:int (strictly increasing, < next), time:ISO(seconds, UTC), actor: HA user id or "" (system), action ∈ ACTIONS,
 user_id, stations:[station ids], fields:[subset of employee_no, display_name, active, user_type, valid_from, valid_until, pin, cards,
 assignments, ownership, profile, group_ids, photo, phone, access_timing_draft, access_timing_policy, permission_overrides],
 before: summary|null, after: summary|null, revision_before:int≥1|null, revision_after:int≥1|null}
summary = {display_name, employee_no, active, user_type, valid_from, valid_until, pin_configured:bool, card_count, enabled_cards,
           assignments:{station_id:{enabled, allowed_locks:[]|[1]|[2]|[1,2]}}}
```
Receipts: `{operation_id:{operation_id, actor, action (bulk/*), saved_at, user_ids[], changed:int, stations[]}}` ≤1000 (limits 200 / 500 csv / 10000 group_policy).
Retention: records older than 30 days dropped on append and filtered on query; max 5 000 (`LIMIT`, `DAYS`, 16-17).
**Commands.**

| exact string | input | output | class. | perm | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audit/list` | `filters` keys ⊆ {user_id, station_id, action (∈ ACTIONS), actor, start, end (aware ISO; start ≤ end), before (int sequence ≥1; default next), limit (int 1..100, default 50)} | `{records (newest first, sequence < before), next_cursor: last shown sequence if more else null, total, retention_days:30, retention_limit:5000, actors:{uid: HA user name|null}}` (actors resolved for up to 100 distinct ids) | READ | management:view | admin_audit.py:335-383; admin_operations_api.py:56-68 |
| `audit/export` | same filters (before/limit ignored — all matching) | list output + `format:"hikvision_intercom.admin_audit"`, `schema:1`, `csv` headers `time_utc, actor_id, action, user_id, name, employee_no, stations (;-joined), changed_fields (;-joined), revision_before, revision_after` | READ | management:view | admin_audit.py:386-419 |

Errors: `invalid_fields` (bad filters), `unauthorized` (no actor).

## Module: be/access/operations_report.py (`operations/query`)

`query(state, actor, filters, offset, limit, snapshot)` (67-178):
- Validation: filters keys ⊆ {kind ∈ {all,sync,bulk,csv} (default all), state ∈ {all,pending,failed,verified,settled,saved} (default all), user_id (≤128, may be ""), station_id (≤128, may be ""), query (str ≤128)}; `offset` int ≥0; `limit` int 1..200; `snapshot` str ≤128 → else `invalid_fields`.
- Rows: every sync operation (`state["sync_operations"]` minus `intent`: `{id, user_id, station_id, queued_at, updated_at, state, verified_at}`) as `{id, kind:"sync", action:"sync/user_station", state, created_at: queued_at, updated_at, changed:1, user_ids:[u], station_ids:[s], progress:{total:1, pending, failed, verified, settled}, children:[op]}`; plus the **caller's own** bulk receipts (`_receipt_row`, 26-64): children = sync ops of receipt users×stations updated at/after `saved_at`; state failed > pending > verified (all) > settled > saved (no children); kind "csv" for `bulk/csv_import` else "bulk"; children capped at 200.
- Search: case-folded substring of `id action user_ids station_ids`.
- Sort by updated_at desc; `snapshot` = sha256 of `[(id,state,updated_at)]`; offset clamped to last page.
- Output `{records, total, offset, limit, next_offset, previous_offset, snapshot, stale: request snapshot non-empty and ≠ current, summary:{pending, failed, verified, settled, saved}}`.
Classification READ; perm management:view; runs in a thread (admin_operations_api.py:44-55).

## Module: be/admin_operations_api.py

## Module: be/health_api.py

`dispatch_health(hass, command, msg)` (20-148). Common: `manager._station(station_id)` (unknown → error from manager), entry missing → `station_unloaded`.

| exact string | input | output | class. | perm | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `health/get` | `{station_id}` | diagnostics (Module diagnostics) + `clock:{source, zone, device_zone, status, checked_at, skew_seconds, error, measurement, next_transition, drift_state, time_mode}` + `media` (last cached `health/refresh` media evidence for the same runtime, else null) + `audio:{active, source:"tts"\|"operator"\|null, last_result}` + `generated_at`, `format:"hikvision_intercom.compatibility"`, `integration_version`, `evidence_scope:"software_observation_not_physical_acceptance"` | READ (no device I/O) | stations:view | 109-148 |
| `health/refresh` | `{station_id}` | same as get, after device reads | READ + device load | stations:manage | 82-108 |
| `acceptance/get` | `{station_id}` | `{revision, steps:[13], results:{step:{state, checked_at, basis}}, basis:"operator_report"}` | READ | stations:view | 28-34 |
| `acceptance/update` | `{station_id, step, state, revision}` | same (after save) | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage only) | stations:manage | 28-33 |
| `media/call` | `{station_id}` | `{call_commands, state, checked_at, last_result, busy}` | READ + device load | overview:view OR stations:view | 35-51 |
| `media/signal` | `{station_id, command}` | signal result `{command, acknowledged, physical_result:"unverified", before_state, observed_state, observation, checked_at}` | PHYSICAL | overview:manage OR stations:manage | 52-81 |

`health/refresh` device reads (35 s): `runtime.clock.async_refresh()` (`GET /ISAPI/System/time`) and `MediaClient.inspect()` (`GET /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal/capabilities?format=json`, `GET /ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels`, `GET /ISAPI/System/TwoWayAudio/channels/capabilities` or per-channel capabilities) (be/client/media.py:64-114); media failure stored as `{checked_at, errors:{probe:"media_read_failed"}}`; cached in `hass.data[DOMAIN]["media_evidence"][station]=(runtime, media)`. Busy: `health_reads` same station or ≥3 → `device_busy`. `media/signal` does `PUT /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/callSignal?format=json` `{"CallSignal":{"cmdType":command}}`, one attempt, and cancels operator/TTS audio bridges on reject/hangUp (details in media part).
Errors: `station_unloaded`, `device_busy`, `acceptance_unavailable`.

## Module: be/access/acceptance.py

`STEPS = (relay, pin_create, pin_replace, pin_remove, user_delete, card, ring, answer, audio, video_desktop, video_mobile, webrtc, offline_recovery)`; `STATES = (unverified, passed, failed, deferred)` (13-28). Operator attestations only; never runs device actions.
**Persistence.** `.storage/hikvision_intercom.acceptance`: `{"schema":1, "revision":int, "stations":{<station_id ≤128>:{<step>:{"state", "checked_at": aware ISO, "basis":"operator_report"}}}}`, ≤100 stations (37-65). Corrupt → repair `acceptance_storage_corrupt`, `hass.data[DOMAIN]["acceptance"]=None` → `acceptance_unavailable` (access_runtime.py:196-205).
**Revision.** A single global revision for all stations (75-97): update requires `revision == data.revision` else `revision_conflict`; new station beyond 100 → `capacity_reached`; bad step/state → `invalid_fields`; revision+1 per save. Does not call `changed()` (no subscribe refresh).

## Module: be/issues.py (HA Repairs)

`issue(hass, key, active, entry_id=None)` (17-34): issue id `"<entry_id>_<key>"` or `key`; severity ERROR, not fixable, not persistent, translation_key = key, placeholder `station` = entry title, learn-more URL to project HARDENING.md. `RepairWatcher` (37-111) re-evaluates on `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED` (1 s debounce) and every 60 s, per station: `sync_conflict` (a conflict state persisting ≥300 s), `access_auth` (station error `authentication_failed`), `access_capacity` (any assignment last_error `person_capacity`/`card_capacity`).
All translation keys present (translations/en.json `issues`): `acceptance_storage_corrupt, acceptance_storage_write, access_auth, access_capacity, capability_regression, events_storage_corrupt, events_storage_write, identity, media_settings_storage_corrupt, migration, panel_permissions_storage_corrupt, profile_settings_storage_corrupt, relay_mapping, schedule_baselines_storage_corrupt, schedule_baselines_storage_write, schedule_journal_storage_corrupt, schedule_journal_storage_write, schedule_operations_storage_corrupt, schedule_operations_storage_write, schedule_plans_storage_corrupt, schedules_storage_corrupt, schedules_storage_write, sync_conflict, users_storage_corrupt, users_storage_write`. `AccessStore` also raises `<suffix>_storage_corrupt` / `<suffix>_storage_write` generically (storage.py:41, 75-77), so `whatsapp_templates_*`, `ntp_settings_*`, `panel_permissions_storage_write` etc. can be created without a translation.

## Module: be/clock_api.py

`dispatch_clock(hass, command, msg)` (43-96). Requires `hass.data[DOMAIN]["ntp_settings"]` NtpSettings else `invalid_storage`. Supervisor helper `supervisor(hass, path, data)` (18-40): requires env `SUPERVISOR_TOKEN` and `hassio` component (else `operation_unsupported`); `GET`/`POST http://supervisor<path>` Bearer token, 15 s; non-200 → `operation_unsupported`; body `result != "ok"` → `invalid_response`.

| exact string | input | output | class. | perm | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clock/settings_get` | `{}` | `{revision, server, port, interval}` | READ | management:view | 47-48 |
| `clock/settings_update` | `{revision:int, values:{server, port, interval}}` | same | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage) | management:manage | 49-50 |
| `clock/host_status` | `{}` | `{supported: "ntp" in /host/info features, synchronized: dt_synchronized, use_ntp, config: /time/info .config (if supported)}`; on any Supervisor failure `{supported:false, synchronized:null, config:null}` | READ (Supervisor GET /host/info, /time/info) | management:view | 51-63 |
| `clock/host_apply` | `{revision:int}` | `{configuration_verified:true, config:{servers:[server], fallback_servers:[]}}` | CONFIG-WRITE (**HA host**: `POST /time/options {"servers":[server],"fallback_servers":[]}`, readback `/time/info`) | management:manage | 68-81 |
| `clock/station_sync` | `{station_id, revision:int, copy_system:bool}` | see client/ntp `synchronize` | CONFIG-WRITE (**device**) | management:manage | 82-96 |

Guards: revision must equal stored (`revision_conflict`) for host_apply/station_sync (settings frozen for the operation); host_apply additionally requires `ntp` host feature and `port == 123` (`operation_unsupported`), config readback equality (`readback_mismatch`). station_sync: station loaded (`station_unloaded`); `clock_writes` busy set: same station or ≥3 → `device_busy`; after write `runtime.clock.async_refresh()`.

## Module: be/ntp_settings.py

Defaults `{"server":"time.windows.com","port":123,"interval":60}` (14). `normalize(values)` (17-40): exactly keys server/port/interval; server 1..64 chars, IPv4 (not unspecified/multicast) or hostname labels `[A-Za-z0-9](...)`, not all-numeric; port int 2..65535; interval int 1..10080 (minutes); server lower-cased. Persistence `.storage/hikvision_intercom.ntp_settings`: `{"schema":1, "revision":int, "values":{server, port, interval}}`. `update` (72-91): normalize, revision match (`revision_conflict`), save only if changed (revision+1) then `changed()` (SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED); shielded commit. Invalid storage → `hass.data[DOMAIN]["ntp_settings"]=None` → clock commands `invalid_storage`. Saving never changes a device.

## Module: be/client/ntp.py (`synchronize`)

`synchronize(client, values, copy_system)` (63-134), under `client._write_lock`, 50 s:
1. Identity confirm; `GET /ISAPI/System/time/capabilities` — `timeMode.@opt` must contain `NTP` (and `manual` when copy_system) else `operation_unsupported`.
2. `GET /ISAPI/System/time` — `timeZone` string required (`invalid_response`), parsed with `device_zone`.
3. `GET /ISAPI/System/time/ntpServers/capabilities` and `GET .../ntpServers` — exactly one NTPServer with id 1 (else `operation_unsupported`); port and interval within `@min/@max` (`invalid_fields`); addressing format ipaddress/hostname advertised.
4. `PUT /ISAPI/System/time/ntpServers` XML `<NTPServerList><NTPServer><id>1</id><addressingFormatType/><ipAddress|hostName/><portNo/><synchronizeInterval/>[<enabled>true</enabled>]</NTPServer></NTPServerList>`; statusCode must be 0/1 else `ambiguous_write`; readback must match (`readback_mismatch`).
5. If copy_system: `PUT /ISAPI/System/time` `<Time><timeMode>manual</timeMode><timeZone>…</timeZone><localTime>HA now in device zone</localTime></Time>`, then (always, in finally) `PUT /ISAPI/System/time` `timeMode NTP` + same timeZone; else only the NTP PUT. Readback must be NTP + same zone.
6. Clock read. Output `{configuration_verified:true, server, clock:<measured clock>, clock_verified: measured and |skew|+uncertainty ≤ 5 s, copied_system: bool}`.
Station time zone and DST rules are preserved (never written with a different value).

## Module: be/clock.py

Display-zone utilities. `UTC_ZONE={"kind":"iana","name":"UTC"}`. `named_zone(value)` → IANA zone dict. `device_zone(text)` (54-77) parses Hikvision `timeZone` syntax `CST-2:00:00DST01:00:00,M3.5.5/02:00:00,M10.5.0/02:00:00` → `{kind:"device", name, standard (seconds, sign reversed), delta, start:[month, week, weekday(Sun=0), seconds]|null, end}`. `offset_at`, `localize`. `parse_clock(payload,now)` (117-141) from `GET /ISAPI/System/time` `Time{timeZone|IANA, localTime (must carry an offset matching the zone), timeMode}` → `{zone, device_time, checked_at, skew_seconds, time_mode ∈ NTP|manual|satellite|platform|NONE|GB28181|unknown}`. `resolve_device_local_time` (144-169) for offset-free history times (rejects DST folds/gaps).

## Module: be/clock_health.py

`measured_clock(payload, started, received, elapsed)` (12-42) adds `measurement:{status:"measured"|"host_clock_changed", duration_seconds, estimated_skew_seconds (HA reference, midpoint), uncertainty_seconds}` and `next_transition` (`{status:"scheduled", at, before_seconds, after_seconds}` | `{status:"fixed"}` | `{status:"not_computed"}`; IANA zones other than UTC → not_computed). `ClockTrend` (78-114): tolerance ±90 s using skew±uncertainty: states `not_measured`, `within_tolerance`, `uncertain`, `ahead`, `behind`, `repeated_ahead`/`repeated_behind` (second same-direction observation ≥300 s and ≤2 700 s after the baseline, same zone/mode).

## Module: be/clock_runtime.py (`StationClock`)

Per station runtime (runtime.py:287; `manual` zone from config entry option `display_time_zone == "manual"`). `_read()` (49-62): 20 s timeout `ClockClient.async_read()`; error → `error:"clock_read_failed"`, trend reset; always dispatches `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED` and schedules next read in **900 s**. `async_refresh()` cancels the timer and awaits a read. `public()` (68-89): `{source: "manual"|"device"|"fallback", zone, status: "ready"|"stale" (observed but last read failed)|"unavailable", error, device_time, checked_at, skew_seconds, time_mode, device_zone, measurement, next_transition, drift_state}` — exposed as overview `stations[].clock`, `stations/clock_refresh` result, and a subset in `health/get`.

## Module: be/client/clock.py

`ClockClient.async_read()` (12-27): separate reader client (own lane, shares session), identity confirm, `GET /ISAPI/System/time`, measured in a thread via `measured_clock`. Read-only.

## Module: be/whatsapp_api.py

**Responsibility.** Admin WhatsApp actions via the separately installed `whatsapp` custom integration (services `whatsapp.send_message`, `whatsapp.get_chat_messages`; module `custom_components.whatsapp.get_client_for_account`).
Accounts = loaded config entries of domain `whatsapp` → `[{id: entry_id, name: title}]` (172-177).
Token cache `hass.data[DOMAIN]["whatsapp_previews"]` (≤400 → `rate_limited`): token `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)`, TTL 600 s, bound to `{actor, user id, user revision, normalized phone, account}` and kind "send"/"media"; `consume` pops (single use) and checks binding → `whatsapp_preview_expired`.

| exact string | input | output | class. | perm | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `whatsapp/status` | `{}` | `{available: has send_message service and ≥1 account, history: has get_chat_messages, accounts:[{id,name}]}` | READ | users:view | 192-193 |
| `whatsapp/preview` | `{user_id, account, language}` | `{token, recipient: "+<E.164>", message: rendered text}` | READ (in-memory token) | users:manage | 227-237 |
| `whatsapp/send` | `{user_id, account, token, message (1..12000, non-blank), confirmed: true}` | `{accepted:true}`; service call `whatsapp.send_message {account, target: number without "+", message}` blocking, 45 s; any failure → `whatsapp_send_uncertain` | **EXTERNAL side effect** | users:manage | 238-260 |
| `whatsapp/history` | `{user_id, account}` | `{recipient, messages:[{id, outgoing, timestamp (epoch s), text ≤12000, caption ≤2000, kind: text\|image\|video\|audio\|document\|sticker\|location\|contact\|pollCreation, quote, filename, media_token\|null}]}` (≤200, oldest first; ephemeral/view-once skipped; only the user's JID); old media tokens for this viewer replaced | READ (external service `get_chat_messages {account, target, limit:200}` return_response, 25 s) | users:view | 261-285; whatsapp_messages.py:6-87 |
| `whatsapp/media` | `{user_id, account, token}` | `{mime, data: base64}`; GET `<provider host><media path>` with `X-Auth-Token` api key, 30 s, ≤8 MiB, mime ∈ {image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, video/mp4, video/webm, audio/ogg, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, application/pdf} | READ (external host) | users:view | 286-321 |
| `whatsapp/templates_get` | `{}` | `{revision, organization, he_unrestricted, he_scheduled, en_unrestricted, en_scheduled, defaults:{...5 keys}, placeholders:[14 names]}` | READ | management:view | 182-186 |
| `whatsapp/templates_update` | `{revision:int, values:{organization, he_unrestricted, he_scheduled, en_unrestricted, en_scheduled}}` | same as get | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage) | management:manage | 187 |

Preconditions for preview/send/history/media: `send_message` service exists and `account` is a loaded account else `whatsapp_unavailable`; user from repository; phone normalized by `phone.whatsapp_number` (Israeli `05xxxxxxxx` → `+9725…`, `00` → `+`, E.164 `+[1-9]\d{7,14}`; else `whatsapp_invalid_phone`).
**Message rendering** `access_message(user, stations, language, settings)` (24-169): language `he*` → Hebrew; enabled assignments listed as numbered door lines (`<station name> (Doors 1, 2)`), pending sync stations noted; schedule days/dates/hours from `access_timing_policy.schedule`; validity from `valid_from/valid_until`; credential section contains **the plain PIN** (`user.pin.value`) when set, else card text, else "no PIN or card"; template key `<he|en>_<scheduled|unrestricted>` (scheduled when timing policy or validity exists); prepended notices: inactive, draft schedule not enforced, awaiting sync.
Errors: `whatsapp_unavailable, whatsapp_invalid_phone, whatsapp_preview_expired, whatsapp_send_uncertain, whatsapp_history_unavailable, whatsapp_media_unavailable, whatsapp_templates_unavailable, rate_limited, invalid_fields`.

## Module: be/whatsapp_templates.py

Defaults (13-48): organization `"מתנ״ס אפרת"`, 4 templates using `{{name}}`, `{{organization}}`, `{{credential_section}}`, `{{doors_section}}`, `{{access_window_section}}` (scheduled), `{{security_notice}}`. `PLACEHOLDERS` = name, organization, pin, credential_section, security_notice, status, doors, doors_section, days, dates, hours, validity, timezone, access_window_section (50-67).
Validation `normalize` (71-95): exactly the 5 keys; organization ≤120, templates ≤12 000, non-blank, no control chars except `\n\t`; templates must use only known placeholders, include `name` and one of `pin`/`credential_section`; scheduled templates must include `access_window_section`; no stray `{{`/`}}`. `render_template` literal substitution, collapses whitespace, ≤12 000.
Persistence `.storage/hikvision_intercom.whatsapp_templates`: `{"schema":1, "revision":int, "values":{5 keys}}`; update requires revision match (`revision_conflict`), saves only if changed, calls `changed()` (SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED). Invalid storage → `hass.data[DOMAIN]["whatsapp_templates"]=None` → `whatsapp_templates_unavailable` (preview then uses DEFAULTS).

# 4. Open questions

1. `events/detail` has no frontend caller; is it intended for a future inspector, and is `record` (full row incl. masked card) acceptable to show to events:view users?
2. `events/history_inspect` raises `HikvisionValidationError` for a bad/over-long range (be/client/history_diagnostics.py:20-24). Unlike `events/list`/`report`, the websocket branch does not map it to `invalid_fields`, so the client receives `device_unavailable` (`HikvisionValidationError` subclasses `HikvisionError`, be/exceptions.py:37). Unsupported history (`HikvisionUnsupportedError`) likewise surfaces as `device_unavailable`.
3. Frontend area/permission mismatches: tab `audit` is gated by `events` view but `audit/list|export` need `management:view`; `health` tab is gated by `stations` view but embeds event tools (`events:manage`) and fleet tools (`management:view`); `stations/clock_refresh` (a pure read) needs `management:manage`. Intentional?
4. Overview trimming does not remove `stations[].last_access` (latest person name / employee number) for users without `events` access.
5. `events/trace_stop` and `events/trace_get` are in `READ_COMMANDS` (skip api_contract check) though stop changes state; harmless but inconsistent.
6. Acceptance uses one global revision across all stations; concurrent operators saving different stations will conflict. Acceptance changes do not trigger `subscribe` refresh.
7. `event_report` sets `day_timezone:"station"` even when some stations have no clock (those days are computed in UTC).
8. `checkedReportQuery` rejects door 2 (fe/report-tools.ts:45-46) though the filter UI offers it — saved presets with door 2 fail to load.
9. WhatsApp: if a user has no phone, `whatsapp_number(None)` would raise a TypeError (be/phone.py:18-23 uses `re.fullmatch` on the value) → generic `action_failed`; the UI prevents this by disabling the button when `person.phone` is empty.
10. Storage keys `whatsapp_templates`, `ntp_settings` can raise `<key>_storage_corrupt`/`_storage_write` repairs through AccessStore, but there are no translations for them.
11. HA `event` entities expose `person_name`/`employee_no` in state attributes (recorded by HA recorder by default) while the WisKey event cache is bounded to 30 days — retention policies differ. Entities do not carry the WisKey event id, so live entity events cannot be joined to `events/list` rows except by time/station/employee heuristics.
12. `subscribe` refresh is triggered by any access/event/clock/settings change (including every 900 s clock read per station); there is no event-specific push channel over WS.

# Part E — Doors / station technical settings, door programs (HA hold-open), public codes, schedule library, deployment plans, schedule operations, permission audit

Source root R = `wiskey-ref/repo`. Frontend paths are relative to `R/frontend/src/`; backend paths relative to `R/custom_components/hikvision_intercom/`. All WS types are `hikvision_intercom/<command>`. Line numbers are from the files as read.

## 0. Cross-cutting facts (apply to every command in this part)

- **Registration / field schema**: `websocket.py:989-1074` `_command_handler`. Every key listed in `COMMANDS` (`websocket.py:66-250`) is `vol.Required` with the listed Python type; `api_contract` is `vol.Optional(int)`. `int`/`bool` fields are additionally checked with `type(x) is kind` (so `true` is not an int, `1` is not a bool) → `invalid_fields` (`websocket.py:1037-1039`). No extra-field rejection at this layer (schema is built without `extra=`, i.e. voluptuous default PREVENT_EXTRA → extra top-level keys raise `vol.Invalid` → `invalid_fields`).
- **Authorization order**: permission check first (`command_allowed`) → `unauthorized`; then schema; then `validate_client(api_contract)` (`api_contract.py:87-91`): commands in `READ_COMMANDS` skip; for all others `api_contract` must be int in `0..1` (default 0 when omitted) else `api_incompatible`. So `api_contract` is effectively optional (0 or 1 accepted).
- **Size limit**: whole message JSON ≤ 65 536 bytes → `request_too_large` (`websocket.py:1040-1046`). (Schedule import document is therefore bounded by 64 KiB at the WS layer even though `MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES` is 8 MiB — see Open questions.)
- **Rate limit**: `AdminLimiter` per HA user: burst 30, 2 tokens/s, ≤ 8 concurrent handlers, ≤128 tracked users → `rate_limited` (`hardening.py:48-75`).
- **Error mapping** (`websocket.py:1053-1070`): `vol.Invalid` → `invalid_fields`; `AccessError(code)` → error code = `code`; any `HikvisionError` (incl. `HikvisionValidationError`, e.g. "Door parameters changed; reload before saving") → `device_unavailable`; any other exception (incl. un-caught `TimeoutError` from `asyncio.timeout`) → `action_failed`.
- **Permission levels** (`panel_permissions.py:204-314`): `_READ_STATIONS` → `stations:view`; `_WRITE_STATIONS` → `stations:manage`; `_READ_MANAGEMENT` → `management:view`; `_WRITE_MANAGEMENT` → `management:manage`. HA admins always pass. Note `schedules/preview` (pure local evaluation) is classified `management:manage` (`panel_permissions.py:283`).
- **Frontend request helpers**: every component here uses `ScopedRequests.run(message, timeout)` (`request.ts:43-80`): rejects client-side with `{code:"connection_lost"}` unless `hass.user.is_admin` and connected; aborts on detach/disconnect; re-checks actor/connection after the response. Components receive `panel.protectedHass` (`panel.ts:203-209` → `api-contract.ts:83-126` `contractHass`), a Proxy that (a) reports `user.is_admin = true` whenever an API contract is loaded (so panel-permission users pass the client-side admin gate), (b) rejects commands not in `overview.api.commands` with `unauthorized`, (c) adds `api_contract: CLIENT_API` to every command present in the contract command list (reads and writes alike).
- **Live updates**: backend `changed()` (`access_runtime.py:49-51`) dispatches `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED`; the `hikvision_intercom/subscribe` WS subscription (`websocket.py:1077-1125`) sends data-free `{kind:"refresh"}` (coalesced 250 ms) or `{kind:"access_revoked"}`. In this part only `ScheduleLibrary` saves and `ScheduleWorkQueue` state changes call `changed()`. None of the Part-E components subscribe; they refresh only on user action, except `hikvision-schedule-operations`, which polls `operations_list` every 1.5 s while any job is `queued`/`checking` (`schedule-operations.ts:184-190`).
- **Storage**: every store is `AccessStore(hass, key="hikvision_intercom.<name>")` = HA `Store` version 1, `private=True`, `atomic_writes=True`, strict JSON load with duplicate-key rejection (`storage.py:33-55`). Files: `.storage/hikvision_intercom.hold_open_drafts`, `.hold_programs`, `.schedules`, `.schedule_baselines`, `.schedule_plans`, `.schedule_journal`, `.schedule_operations` (`access_runtime.py:145-244`). Corrupt load raises a HA repair issue `<key>_storage_corrupt` and sets `hass.data[DOMAIN][key] = None` (commands then fail with `invalid_storage` / `schedule_baseline_unavailable` / `schedule_plan_storage_unavailable` / `schedule_operations_unavailable`). Exception: `hold_open_drafts` and `hold_programs` load failures are not caught in `access_runtime.py:147-174` (would abort setup).
- **Commit pattern** (all stores): build a deep-copied candidate state, `save()` it inside `asyncio.create_task` + `asyncio.shield`, publish in-memory state only after the save succeeds; cancellation waits for the save.

# SCREENS

## Screen: Station technical settings container (`hikvision-station-technical`, `station-technical.ts`)

**Purpose (end-user)**: Per-station technical area: read station capability flags, public-PIN slot status (booleans only), per-door parameters (door name, open duration, relay reverse), edit the relay mapping (which physical outputs WisKey manages), and host the door-programs and public-codes sub-components.

**Entry point**: Tools → "devices" tab (`panel.ts:2700-2713` tool cards; `tabArea("devices") = "stations"`, `panel.ts:2627`) → `devicesView()` (`panel.ts:3344`) → per station `stationSettings(station)` (`panel.ts:3364`). Rendered at `panel.ts:3491-3497`:
```
<hikvision-station-technical .mode=${modern ? tab : "all"} .hass=${protectedHass} .station=${station}>
```
`modern = appearance === "modern" || accessMode` (`panel.ts:3365`). In modern mode a per-station tab bar `["overview","programs","public_codes","settings"]` (`panel.ts:3391-3403`) sets `tab`; the technical element is visible only for `settings` and `public_codes` (`panel.ts:3491`); `programs` renders `<wiskey-door-programs>` directly (`panel.ts:3490`). WisKey-v4 appearance also shows shortcut buttons to `programs`/`public_codes` (`panel.ts:3470-3485`).
Props: `mode` ("all" / "settings" / "public_codes" / other), `hass`, `station: Station` (uses `station.id`, `station.integrated_locks: {physical_index, api_id, name?}[]` from `types.ts:113`).

**Layout & visual notes** (`station-technical.ts:377-410`):
- `mode === "public_codes"` → renders only `<wiskey-public-codes .hass .station>` (`:371-378`).
- `mode === "settings"` → heading `station_tab_settings`, intro `technical_intro` ("Read settings before editing. Changes apply to the selected door."), button `technical_read`; after read: relay editor + door editors only (no PIN status/feature list) (`:379-384`).
- `mode === "all"` (legacy/current appearance) → two collapsible `<details>`: "Opening schedules" (lazily mounts `<wiskey-door-programs>` when opened) and "Public codes" (lazily mounts `<wiskey-public-codes>`), then a `<details>` "technical_title" with read button, `wait` status, error, and `reportView()` (`:385-409`).
- `reportView()` (`:350-370`): relay editor; public PIN summary `technical_pin_<configured|absent|unknown>` + scope hint `technical_pin_scope`; `<details>` listing every `PASSWORD_FIELDS` state as configured / not_configured / not_verified; one `<section>` per door (heading "physical_lock · API n"); `<details>` capability list (`family · name ✓/—`); `checked_at` raw.
- Relay editor (`:224-292`): for physical index 1 and 2: checkbox (managed or not), when checked: name input (maxlength 64) and API id select (1/2). Confirmation checkbox `technical_relays_confirm` ("I verified the physical relay mapping. Save and reload this integration.") gates the save button `technical_relays_save`. Any edit resets the confirmation.
- Door editor (`:294-349`): fields generated from `door.constraints` — boolean → checkbox; integer → number input with min/max; text → text input with maxlength = cap.max. Fields disabled unless the door's API id is in `station.integrated_locks[].api_id`; unmanaged door shows `technical_unmanaged` instead of confirm/save. Managed door: confirmation checkbox `technical_confirm` ("Apply these settings. Reversing the relay may change the physical lock state.") + Save (submit). Any field edit resets that door's confirmation (`:414-417`).
- Door read error shows `t(door.error)`.
- Errors: `technical_read_failed` ("Could not read settings. PIN absence is unknown."), `technical_write_unknown` ("Change not confirmed. Read the station before retrying."). On any write failure the whole report and drafts are discarded (`:184-190`, `:212-217`).
- State reset on `hass.user.id/station.id` change (`:111-126`).

**Data model** (`station-technical.ts:9-28`):
```ts
interface Door { door: number; error?: string;
  values?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;          // keys ⊆ doorName, openDuration, relayReverseEnabled
  constraints?: Record<string, { type: string; min?: number; max?: number }>; }  // type: "text" | "integer" | "boolean"
interface Relay { physical_index: number; api_id: number; confirmed: boolean; name?: string; }
interface Report { relay_selection: Relay[]; checked_at: string; doors: Door[];
  passwords: null | { public_pin_state: string; states: Record<string, boolean | null> };
  password_error: string | null;
  features: { family: string; name: string; supported: boolean }[]; }
```

**User actions**

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Read settings | READ (device reads: AccessControl + VideoIntercom capabilities, PrivilegePasswordStatus, DoorParam 1 and 2 + their capabilities; holds per-station technical busy slot) | `stations/technical_get` `{station_id}`; client timeout 80 s | none; button disabled while busy | `station-technical.ts:131-155` |
| Save door parameters | CONFIG-WRITE to intercom device (PUT `/ISAPI/AccessControl/Door/param/{door}`). `relayReverseEnabled` change can flip the physical lock output immediately (UI text says so) — ambiguous PHYSICAL side-effect; `openDuration` changes the length of every future release | `stations/technical_update` `{station_id, door:<API door 1/2>, expected:<door.values as last read>, changes:{<only changed keys>}, confirmed:true}`; client timeout 50 s | per-door checkbox `technical_confirm` must be ticked; only managed API doors editable; no-op if nothing changed | `station-technical.ts:156-194` |
| Save relay mapping | CONFIG-WRITE, HA config entry only (`entry.data.locks`); no device write; triggers integration reload (lock entities re-created) | `stations/technical_relays` `{station_id, expected:<report.relay_selection as read>, locks:[{physical_index:1/2, api_id:1/2, confirmed:true, name?}]}`; client timeout 15 s | checkbox `technical_relays_confirm`; report cleared after success (must re-read) | `station-technical.ts:195-223` |
| Open "Opening schedules" / "Public codes" details | none (mounts child) | — | lazy mount | `:386-401` |

**Live update behaviour**: none; manual re-read. After relay save the report is cleared; the backend reloads the config entry asynchronously.

**Notes/quirks**:
- `technical_get` reads DoorParam for API doors 1 and 2 unconditionally, even unmanaged ones (`technical_api.py:192-198`).
- The PIN status block only appears if the VideoIntercom capabilities contain exactly one `isSupportPrivilegePasswordStatus=true` (`technical_api.py:177-191`).
- `expected` in `technical_relays` must deep-equal `entry.data["locks"]` (list of dicts incl. `confirmed` and optional `name`) → else `revision_conflict`.
- `hold-open.ts` is imported here (`:1`) but the `<hikvision-hold-open>` element is never rendered anywhere (see its section).

## Screen: Door programs / "Opening schedules" (`wiskey-door-programs`, `door-programs.ts`)

**Purpose (end-user)**: Per station, one HA-executed "opening program" per managed door: a weekly timetable + date exceptions in an IANA timezone during which Home Assistant keeps the door **held open** (`alwaysOpen`) and then returns it to normal control (`close`). Programs are stored and executed by HA (not on the station). Also lists legacy "saved" hold-open drafts.

**Entry point**: (a) modern station tab `programs` → `panel.ts:3490` `<wiskey-door-programs .hass=${protectedHass} .station=${station}>`; (b) inside `hikvision-station-technical` mode "all", `<details>` "Opening schedules" (`station-technical.ts:386-393`). Props: `hass`, `station`.

**Layout & visual notes** (`door-programs.ts:319-480`):
- Header "Opening schedules" (`programs_title`), Refresh, "New program" (primary; disabled until loaded and while every integrated lock already has a program).
- Hint `hold_dependency`: "HA and network connectivity are required throughout the opening window. During an outage the door may remain unlocked until communication returns; this does not replace a local station schedule."
- Program cards: name; status text = `program_removing` ("Removal pending") / `technical_write_unknown` (if `error`) / `program_active` ("Enabled in HA") / `program_inactive` ("Saved · inactive"); door name (lock name or "physical_lock n") · "Home Assistant" · timezone; execution status `program_<status>`: idle "No hold-open command is currently owned by this program.", opening "Sending hold-open command", held_acknowledged "Hold-open command acknowledged; physical state not verified.", restoring "Returning to normal control", unknown "Command outcome unknown; restoration pending."; `checked_at` ("Last transition recorded"); `<details>` days/times; buttons Edit (disabled if removing), Pause (disabled unless enabled), Remove (danger).
- Legacy saved drafts (from `hold_open_drafts`, only for doors without a program): name, text `program_legacy` ("Previously saved, not activated. Open to edit and activate explicitly."), Edit (opens editor with revision 0 → creates a new program) and Remove.
- Editor form (scrolls into view on open): name (required, maxlength 32); physical lock select (disabled when editing an existing program; doors that already have a program are disabled for new ones); "Home Assistant — Stored and executed by Home Assistant."; timezone text input (required; default = HA `hass.config.time_zone` returned by list); 7 day sections (Sunday-first order in UI) each with enable checkbox (default window 08:00–17:00) and period rows: "all day" button (sets 00:00–24:00), start/end `<input type=time>` (end "24:00" is displayed as "00:00" and "00:00" entered as end is stored as "24:00"), remove, "add period" (max 8); "Specific dates / exceptions" list: start date, end date, periods, remove; "add date" pushes `{name:"Date", start:"", end:"", periods:[{08:00–17:00}]}`; hint `program_end_hint`; buttons "Save and activate" (submit → enabled=true), "Save without activation" (enabled=false), Cancel.
- Errors shown as `t(code)`; e.g. `hold_pause_before_edit` "Pause the program and confirm restoration before editing."

**Data model** (`door-programs.ts:6-25`):
```ts
const days = ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"];
type Period = { start: string; end: string };           // "HH:MM", end may be "24:00"
type Policy = { timezone: string;
  schedule: { name: string; weekly: Record<string, Period[]>;
              holidays: { name: string; start: string; end: string; periods: Period[] }[] } };
interface Program { door: number; revision: number; policy: Policy; enabled: boolean; removing: boolean;
  error: string | null; checked_at: string | null; execution: { owned: boolean; status: string }; }
```
Backend program record (listing strips `identity`): `{station_id, door, api_id, revision, policy, enabled, removing, execution:{owned, attempted, status}, error, checked_at}` (`hold_programs.py:77-82`, `:138-153`). `door` = physical index; `api_id` = ISAPI door number.

**User actions**

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load / Refresh | READ (WisKey storage only; no device I/O, but takes the per-station technical busy slot) | `stations/technical_program_list` `{station_id}` → `{programs:Program[], saved:Draft[], timezone, native_supported:false}` | auto on mount / identity change | `door-programs.ts:138-164` |
| Save and activate | PHYSICAL (scheduled). Stores program with `enabled:true`; the HA 15-s timer then sends `alwaysOpen` to `PUT /ISAPI/AccessControl/RemoteControl/door/{api_id}` when "now" is inside a window, and `close` at window end. If saved while inside a window, the door is held open within ≤15 s. Save itself does device reads (identity + RemoteControl capabilities) only | `stations/technical_program_save` `{station_id, door:<physical_index>, revision:<0 new / current>, policy:{timezone, schedule:{name, weekly:{Monday..Sunday:[{start,end}]}, holidays:[{name,start,end,periods}]}}, enabled:true}` → `{programs}` | none beyond form submit; for an active program the edit path forces a prior pause (below) | `door-programs.ts:222-246`, submit `:385-389` |
| Save without activation | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage only; `enabled:false`, no device I/O) | same with `enabled:false` | none | `:465-466` |
| Edit (program enabled or execution owned) | PHYSICAL (immediate): pause → if WisKey currently owns a hold-open, sends `close` to the door now | `stations/technical_program_action` `{station_id, door, revision, action:"pause"}` (client timeout 70 s), then opens editor with returned paused program | `confirm(program_edit_pause)`: "Pause this program and restore normal door control before editing? It remains paused until you save and activate it." If the returned program is still enabled/owned/removing → error `hold_pause_before_edit` | `door-programs.ts:165-200` |
| Edit (inactive, not owned) | none (opens editor locally) | — | — | `:167-170` |
| Pause | PHYSICAL (immediate if held): `enabled:false`, then immediate tick → `close` if owned | `stations/technical_program_action` `{…, action:"pause"}` | `confirm(program_pause_confirm)`: "Pause this program and request return to normal control if held open?" | `:265-290` |
| Remove | PHYSICAL (immediate if held) + CONFIG-WRITE: `removing:true, enabled:false`, immediate tick → `close` if owned; record deleted once not owned; if close fails the record stays `removing` and is retried every 15 s | `stations/technical_program_action` `{…, action:"remove"}` | `confirm(program_remove_confirm)`: "Remove this program? If WisKey holds the door open, it will first request return to normal control. An unconfirmed return stays pending." | `:265-290` |
| Remove legacy saved draft | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage only, `hold_open_drafts`) | `stations/technical_hold_delete` `{station_id, door, revision}` → `{deleted:true}` | `confirm(program_delete_saved_confirm)`: "Delete this inactive saved program? No station command will be sent." | `:247-264` |
| Edit legacy saved draft | none locally; saving it = `technical_program_save` with `revision:0` (creates program and deletes the legacy draft server-side) | — | — | `:376`, `technical_api.py:72-75` |

There is **no "resume/start" action**: backend `action` accepts only `"pause"` and `"remove"` (`hold_programs.py:157-158`); reactivation = edit + "Save and activate" (allowed only when not enabled, not owned, not removing).

**Live update behaviour**: none (no polling). Execution status changes made by the 15-s timer are visible only after Refresh.

**Notes/quirks**:
- Editor weekly map is Sunday-first in UI, backend normalizes to exact 7-key set (order irrelevant).
- Every date exception gets the fixed name "Date" from the UI; backend requires `holiday.name` non-blank ≤32.
- Errors from pause/save show the backend code; action failures show `technical_write_unknown`.
- One program per door (key `station_id/door`).

## Screen: Public codes (`wiskey-public-codes`, `public-codes.ts`)

**Purpose (end-user)**: View the 16 station-stored public PIN slots (configured / not configured / not verified — digits are never returned) and add, replace or remove a public code for a chosen managed door. Public codes are not tied to a person.

**Entry point**: modern station tab `public_codes` → `hikvision-station-technical` with `mode="public_codes"` → `<wiskey-public-codes .hass .station>` (`station-technical.ts:371-378`); or mode "all" `<details>` "Public codes" (`station-technical.ts:394-401`). Props `hass`, `station`.

**Layout & visual notes** (`public-codes.ts:169-296`):
- Heading "Public codes", intro `public_pin_intro` ("Public codes are stored on the station and are not assigned to a person. The station reports which slots are configured, without returning their digits. Replacing or deleting a code requires the current code."), Refresh button, error (`role=alert`), success message `public_pin_saved` ("The station acknowledged the change and its slot status was read back. Test the code at the station to verify actual access.").
- If capabilities `advertised === false`: checkbox `public_pin_compatibility` ("Try the compatible public-code interface even though this station does not advertise it. The station may reject the operation."); toggling clears editor.
- Grid of 16 cards "Public code n" with state text; buttons: "Add code" (if not configured) or "Edit" (if configured) + "Remove" (danger, only if configured). A slot is disabled when busy, state not boolean, slot not in `capabilities.slots`, not advertised and compatibility unchecked, or station has no integrated locks.
- Editor form (scrolls into view): legend "Public code n · edit/remove"; for replace/remove: "Current public code" (password, numeric, required, minlength 4, maxlength 16, pattern `[0-9]+`); for add/replace: "New public code" (password, minlength/maxlength = capabilities min/max), "Repeat new code", lock select (options value = `api_id`, label = lock name or "physical_lock n"); submit ("Save"/"Remove") and Cancel. Old-code challenge: replace and remove REQUIRE the current code (device verifies it).
- Client mismatch check → `public_pin_mismatch`. Then `confirm(public_pin_confirm)`: "Apply this public-code change to the selected station?". PIN strings are cleared from component state before the request and from the message object after it (`:150`, `:163-166`).
- Responsive grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))`.

**Data model** (`public-codes.ts:6-9`, editor `:68`):
```ts
interface Report {
  status: { states: Record<string, boolean | null>; checked_at: string };   // backend also returns public_pin_state
  capabilities: { advertised: boolean; slots: number[]; min: number; max: number }; // backend also returns locks?:boolean
}
editor?: { slot: number; action: "add" | "replace" | "remove"; expected: boolean };
```
Backend write result adds `acknowledged: true, physical_verified: false` (`public_codes.py:134-139`).

**User actions**

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load / Refresh | READ (device: identity, `GET /ISAPI/VideoIntercom/PrivilegePasswordStatus`, `GET …/PrivilegePasswordCfg/capabilities?format=json`) | `stations/technical_codes_get` `{station_id}` (client timeout 70 s) | auto on mount | `public-codes.ts:106-129` |
| Add code | CONFIG-WRITE to intercom device — grants physical access (anyone with the code can open the selected door) | `stations/technical_codes_write` `{station_id, slot:1..16, action:"add", expected:false, door:<api_id>, old_pin:"", new_pin:"<digits>", compatibility:bool, confirmed:true}` | repeat-code match + `confirm(public_pin_confirm)` | `:130-168`, `:210-218` |
| Replace code | CONFIG-WRITE to device — grants physical access with new code / revokes old | same with `action:"replace", expected:true, old_pin:"<current>", new_pin:"<new>"` | current code required; repeat match; confirm | same |
| Remove code | CONFIG-WRITE to device — revokes access | same with `action:"remove", expected:true, old_pin:"<current>", new_pin:""` (door still sent = selected `this.door`, must be a managed API door) | current code required; confirm | `:221-233` |

**Live update behaviour**: none; result report replaces state; on error report is cleared (must refresh).

**Notes/quirks**:
- `old_pin` and `new_pin` are required string fields for every action (voluptuous `Required(str)`), so empty strings are sent when unused.
- `door` is the **API** door id (`integrated_locks[].api_id`), validated against `client.enabled_doors`.
- UI `expected` is derived from last read state; server re-reads and rejects mismatch as `revision_conflict`.

## Screen: Schedule library (`hikvision-intercom-schedules`, `schedules.ts`)

**Purpose (end-user)**: Create/edit named weekly time-window schedules with holiday/date exceptions stored in Home Assistant; evaluate a draft at a date/time; import/export drafts as JSON; read-only station checks (search inventory/readiness, capacity assessment vs a draft, user dependency audit, multi-station compatibility queue) and save/clear a station comparison "baseline". Hosts deployment proposals and schedule operations. Intro `schedule_intro`: "Prepare named weekly schedules and holiday exceptions. These drafts are stored in Home Assistant only; they are not assigned to users or enforced by stations."

**Entry point**: Tools → "schedules" tool card (`panel.ts:2701-2713`, area `management` `panel.ts:2636`) → `panel.ts:4811-4815` `<hikvision-intercom-schedules .hass=${protectedHass} .stations=${_data.stations}>`. Panel navigation calls `canLeave()` on it before leaving the tab (`panel.ts:366-368`). Props `hass`, `stations: Station[]`.

**Layout & visual notes** (`schedules.ts:1068-1314`):
- Renders nothing unless `hass.user.is_admin` (true for contract users via proxy).
- Two-column grid: library aside (230 px) + editor; collapses to one column under 700 px container width (`:220-227`).
- Library: Reload, New (primary), "Export drafts", file input "Import" (`accept=application/json,.json`), one button per schedule (sorted by server), empty text.
- Import preview section (`:521-544`): count, name collisions, hint, per-item name/window count/holiday count, "Import (n)" and Cancel.
- Editor form: name (required, max 32), hint, "Clone" button, "Copy windows" fieldset (source weekday select, target weekday checkboxes, apply), 7 weekday fieldsets Monday..Sunday with period rows (text inputs `HH:MM`, end pattern allows `24:00`, placeholders 09:00/17:00, remove, "add period" max 8, "closed day" text when empty), holiday fieldsets (name max 32, first/last date 2000-01-01..2037-12-31, periods, remove), "add holiday" (max 64, default today/today no periods), Save (primary) and Delete (if saved).
- Preview section: date + time inputs, Evaluate → shows inside/outside, source weekly/holiday + holiday name, the day's periods.
- `<hikvision-deployment-plans .hass .stations .source=${dirty ? undefined : draft} @plan-busy>` (`:1234-1241`).
- Station check section (`:1242-1313`): station select (only `lock_enabled`, offline disabled), "Check" (readiness), "Assess" (draft vs station), readiness result rows + export JSON, "Dependencies" button, "Assess all stations" (batch), batch view, dependencies view, assessment view (limits, inventory rows, baseline sub-section, blockers, export JSON with `token` stripped). Footer hint `schedule_apply_blocked`: "Applying schedules remains unavailable until template ownership, writes, user linkage and physical enforcement are verified. Successful reads alone do not enable assignment. Existing permissions keep their current behavior."
- Unknown-outcome lock: `_uncertain` set when a mutation fails with a code not in the known list → message `schedule_save_unknown` ("The save result is unconfirmed. Reload drafts and inspect the saved list before making another change.") and most actions disabled until Reload (`:581-610`).

**Data model** (`schedules.ts:10-130`):
```ts
const days = ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"];
interface Period { start: string; end: string }
interface Holiday { name: string; start: string; end: string; periods: Period[] }
interface Schedule { id?: string; revision?: number; name: string; weekly: Record<string, Period[]>; holidays: Holiday[]; updated_at?: string }
interface Preview { within_window: boolean; source: string; holiday: string | null; periods: Period[]; date: string; time: string }  // backend adds weekday, basis:"draft_local_time", applied:false
interface Readiness { read_method?: string; checked_at: string; can_apply: false;
  checks: { kind: string; advertised: boolean | null; capabilities: { ids: number[]; max_periods?: number; precision?: string } | null;
            sample_id: number | null; read?: number; total?: number | null; coverage?: string; read_state: string; error: string | null }[] }
interface Baseline { state: string; revision: number; checked_at: string | null; token: string | null;
  checks: { kind: string; state: string; modified: number; added: number; removed: number; modified_ids: number[]; added_ids: number[];
            removed_ids: number[]; unverified_new: number; unverified_missing: number; coverage_complete: boolean; capability_changed: boolean }[] }
interface ImportPreview { token: string; count: number; name_collisions: number; expires_in: number; items: { name: string; weekly_periods: number; holidays: number }[] }  // backend adds mode:"append"
interface BatchRow { id: string; name: string; state: "queued"|"running"|"done"|"failed"|"skipped"|"cancelled"; report?: Assessment; error?: string }
interface Dependencies { checked_at: string; mapping_complete: boolean;
  users: { state: string; error: string | null; read: number|null; explicit: number|null; implicit: number|null; malformed: number|null };
  checks: { kind: string; coverage: string; referenced: number|null; observed: number|null; not_observed: number|null; disabled: number|null; ids: number[]; not_observed_ids: number[] }[] }
interface Assessment { baseline?: Baseline; checked_at: string; complete: boolean; can_apply: false;
  checks: { kind: string; state: string; error: string|null; read: number; total: number|null; enabled: number|null; disabled: number|null; referenced: number|null }[];
  assessment: { state: string; can_apply: false; limits: { key: string; needed: number; available: number|null; state: string }[]; blockers: string[] } }
```
All schedule API calls go through `api(command, data)` → type `hikvision_intercom/schedules/${command}`, timeout 120 s for readiness/assess/dependencies else 60 s (`:331-336`).

**User actions**

| Action | Classification | Command(s) | Confirmation / guard UX | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Load / Reload library | READ (storage) | `schedules/list` `{}` → `Schedule[]` (full records `{id, revision, updated_at, name, weekly, holidays}`) | `schedule_discard` confirm if dirty: "Discard the unsaved changes to this draft?" | `:343-364` |
| New / select schedule | none (local) | — | dirty confirm | `:365-376` |
| Edit fields / clone / copy windows | none (local) | — | copy: if any target non-empty `confirm(schedule_copy_confirm)` "Replace all windows on {days}? A closed source day will clear these days." | `:377-422` |
| Save (create) | CONFIG-WRITE (WisKey storage `schedules` only; no device, not enforced anywhere) | `schedules/create` `{data:{name, weekly:{Monday..Sunday:[{start,end}]}, holidays:[{name,start,end,periods}]}}` → Schedule | form submit | `:545-570` |
| Save (update) | CONFIG-WRITE (storage only) | `schedules/update` `{schedule_id, revision, data:{…}}` → Schedule | form submit; `revision_conflict` → `schedule_revision_conflict` text | same |
| Delete | CONFIG-WRITE (storage only) | `schedules/delete` `{schedule_id, revision}` → `{deleted:true}` | `confirm(schedule_delete_confirm)` "Delete this local schedule draft?" | `:611-639` |
| Evaluate preview | READ (pure computation; classified management:manage) | `schedules/preview` `{data, date:"YYYY-MM-DD", time:"HH:MM"}` | — | `:640-658` |
| Export drafts | READ (storage) | `schedules/export` `{}` → `{format:"hikvision_intercom.schedule_drafts", version:1, schedules:[{name,weekly,holidays}]}`; downloaded as `hikvision-schedule-drafts.json` | — | `:462-480` |
| Import file → preview | READ-ish (stores a 5-min in-memory pending token; no persistence) | `schedules/import_preview` `{document:<file text>}` (client rejects files > 8 MiB) | — | `:481-501` |
| Apply import | CONFIG-WRITE (storage only; appends new UUID copies) | `schedules/import_apply` `{token}` → Schedule[] | explicit "Import (n)" button | `:502-520` |
| Check station (readiness) | READ (device: capability + paged POST Search reads of 4 schedule resource families; per-station/fleet busy limits) | `schedules/readiness` `{station_id}` | only online, lock-enabled station | `:659-677` |
| Assess draft vs station | READ (same device reads + in-memory baseline token issuance) | `schedules/assess` `{station_id, data:{name,weekly,holidays}}` → Assessment | disabled while busy/uncertain | `:686-722` |
| Assess all stations (batch) | READ (sequential per station, 2 client workers) | repeated `schedules/assess` `{station_id, data}`; offline/unloaded/no-lock stations marked `skipped` | Cancel marks queued rows cancelled; in-flight finish | `:723-776` |
| Export batch / assessment / readiness / dependencies JSON | none (client download; `token` stripped from batch/assessment exports) | — | — | `:808-822`, `:1019-1028`, `:1292-1296`, `:891-895` |

This replaces any previous reference, including with partial coverage. No station configuration will be changed." | `:898-945` |

No station records or access rights will be changed." | same |

**Live update behaviour**: none; `ScheduleLibrary` mutations trigger `SIGNAL_ACCESS_CHANGED` (panel refresh) but this component does not reload itself. Any draft change or station change invalidates assessment/batch/dependencies (`invalidateAssessment`, `:678-685`). Late responses are dropped via `_epoch`/sequence counters.

**Notes/quirks**:
- Client-side mutation "known" codes list (`:583-604`): unknown codes put the component into `_uncertain` (read-only until Reload).
- Baseline error "known" list (`:929-938`); others → `schedule_baseline_unknown`.
- Deployment proposals receive `source = undefined` while the editor is dirty.
